m110001.――おや、これは予想以上では……？: ――Well now, this is more than I expected…?
m110001.――ここが英傑の塔じゃな？\n目の前に見えるのは異界の門かのう。: ――So this is the Heroic Tower, huh? What we see before us must be a gate to another world.
m110001.――ふふふ、ようこそ英傑の塔へ。: ――Heh heh, welcome to the Heroic Tower.
m110001.――まさかあれは、皇帝陛下！？\nそれに王子殿下の幻まで……！: No way… is that the Emperor?! And even an illusion of the Prince…!
m110001.――塔の階層を制したご褒美に、\n「英傑結晶」をあげちゃいます。: —as a reward for conquering the tower's floors, I'll give you a "Heroic Crystal."
m110001.――失礼します。\n少しお時間頂いても宜しいでしょうか。\n王子にご紹介したい方:
――Excuse me.
May I have a moment of your time?
There's someone I'd like to introduce to the Prince—
m110001.――戯れが過ぎるのではありませんか？\nソラス様が王子に試練を課したと聞いて来ま: Isn't this getting a bit frivolous? I heard Solais-san set a trial for the Prince, but now's not the time for a little test of strength…
m110001.――王子君、あなたのご先祖さま、\nそして私達の仲間であった英雄王なんですよ。:
—Prince, it's your ancestor, 
and the Hero King who was also our comrade.
m110001.――簡単なことです。\n千年戦争の終結から幾星霜。\n私は長い時を、この塔の封印: ――It's simple. Since the end of the Millennium War, countless ages have passed. I spent those long years sealed within this tower.
m110001.――英傑の塔は、\n２０層が最上階だと思っていましたが……。: I always thought the Tower of Heroes topped out at the 20th floor…
m110001.……いつの間にこんな塔が？\nこの場所に、こんな建築物はなかったはずですが……。:
…When did this tower appear?
There shouldn't have been any such structure here before….
m110001.……かつての、敵？\nソラス殿、何故\n白の帝国と王国の関係を知っているのでしょ: …Former enemies? Solais-dono, why do you know about the relationship between the White Empire and the Kingdom?
m110001.……これは、過酷ですね。\nまさかこれまでの戦いの情報まで、\nソラス殿に収集さ: …That's harsh. I never imagined you'd have collected all the battle data…
m110001.……コホン。\n王子、ソラスさんの身元に間違いはないようです。\n先程シャディア:
…Ahem.
Prince, it seems Solais's identity is correct.
Shadia just confirmed it a moment ago.
m110001.……王子達の力が及ばぬなら、\nここであなたが彼らを蹴散らし、\nこの世界を諦め: …If the Prince and his allies can't reach that level, you'll drive them away and tell the world to give up?
m110001.あ、ちょっとうれしそうですね。\nほっぺが緩んでますよ？: Ah, you look a bit happy. Your cheeks are all relaxed.
m110001.あなたがあの人の\n――英雄王の子孫、王子君ですね？:
You must be that person—
the descendant of the Hero King, Prince?
m110001.あの英雄王の力を持ってしても、\nそれでも届かなかった魔王討伐……。: Even the Hero King's power couldn't bring the Demon King down…
m110001.あらあら、ここで諦めても良いのですよ？: Oh dear, you could give up right here if you like.
m110001.いつの間にそんな施設を……。\nえぇと、つまり力を証明することで、\nあなたが魔: Since when did we have a place like that…? So, by proving our strength, you'll help us defeat the Demon King?
m110001.えぇ。遠い昔に私が魔術で作り出した塔で、\n魔王と戦わんとする者のためのものです:
Yes. A tower I created with magic ages ago, meant for those who would battle the Demon King.
I think it'll be of great help to you, Prince.
m110001.えーけつけっしょう……？\nえぇと、それはいったい……？: Huh, a heroic crystal…? Wait, what exactly is that?
m110001.おぉ、ソーマちゃん興味津々ですか？\nふふふ、この塔はかつて魔王を封印せし折に、:
Oh, Soma-chan, you're curious, huh?
Hehehe, this tower was built when we sealed the Demon King, at the Hero King's request, and I constructed it.
m110001.けれど、ひとまずは休息を。\n戦士には戦うだけでなく、休むことも必要ですからね？: But for now, take a rest. A warrior needs to rest as well as fight, you know?
m110001.けれど、もし『魔王以上の脅威』が迫ったなら……。\nそんな時に備えて、塔が最適な: But if a threat greater than the Demon King appears… I prepared the tower to self-replicate into the optimal form for such a situation.
m110001.この中には、階層のひとつひとつに、\n英雄の力をはかる様々な試練が用意されている: Within, each floor holds various trials to measure a hero's power.
m110001.これは、英雄王の戦友たる私からの、\n当代の英雄への挑戦――と思っていただければ: Consider this a challenge from me, a comrade of the Hero King, to the heroes of this age.
m110001.さて、それは王子君たちの実力次第♪\nそのための英傑の塔、というわけですからね。: Well then, that all depends on your abilities, Prince-kun. That's why we have the Heroic Tower, after all.
m110001.さて。ここは王子君を鍛錬するための場所ですから、\n私としても手加減することはで: Now then. This place exists to train you, Prince-kun, so I won't hold back. If you're going to give up, now's the time.
m110001.そう、この塔は世界の危機を退けうる、\n英雄を鍛え上げ、\n力を与えるための装置: Indeed, this tower is a device to forge heroes capable of repelling world crises, granting them power.
m110001.そうして純粋な力や、様々な状況に\n対処する柔軟性を見せてくれたなら――: And if you demonstrate pure strength and the flexibility to handle all sorts of situations—
m110001.そうそう。その光に触れている間は、\n特別な加護を受けることができますよ。\n上: Ah, right. While you're touching that light, you'll receive a special blessing. Use it wisely.
m110001.それでは、どうぞ、英傑の塔へ――。: Then, go forth—into the Heroic Tower.
m110001.それでは、覚悟が出来ましたら\n「英傑の塔」の入り口へと参りましょうか♪: So, if you're ready, shall we head to the entrance of the “Tower of Heroes”♪
m110001.それでは王子君、これまでの戦いの道程と、\n自分と、それに匹敵する好敵手の映し身: Then, Prince, confront the path of battles you've walked and the mirror image of a worthy opponent equal to yourself. Defeat it splendidly…!
m110001.それでは２１層の試練を起動しますよ！\n王子君、戦闘準備をお願いします！: Then I'll activate the trial of the 21st floor! Prince, prepare for battle!
m110001.ですからまずは、その過程で収集した情報から、\n最初の試練を与えることにしましょ: So first, based on the information we've gathered, let's give you the initial trial. You'll be facing—
m110001.でもこれだけでは物足りませんよね……。\nここはひとつ、天使に、デーモンに……。: But that alone isn't enough, is it… Let's throw in an angel, a demon… —that'll do♪
m110001.どんな助力かはお楽しみに、ですけどね。\n何しろ私も、まだ半信半疑なのです。: What kind of help, you'll have to wait and see. After all, I'm still half-skeptical myself.
m110001.なるほど……。\nその階層を乗り越えていくことで、\n英雄としての強さを示す……:
I see…
By overcoming each floor, we demonstrate our strength as heroes… is that right?
m110001.なるほど……。\nならば、この塔に入る資格があると認めましょう。: I see… Then I'll acknowledge that you have earned the right to enter this tower.
m110001.なるほどな……。\nあいつが王子を助けようとしてくれてるってことか。: I see… so he's trying to help you, Prince.
m110001.なれば、王子君達に\nその実力の片鱗だけでも見いだせなければ、\nここで諦めるよ: So if we can glimpse even a fraction of that power in you, Prince-kun, it's our duty as predecessors to guide you—perhaps even to tell you to give up here if you can't.
m110001.はい♪ お人好しはご先祖様譲りですね、王子君♪: Yes♪ Kindness runs in your blood, Prince.
m110001.ふふ、その時のアンナちゃん良い反応でしたね。\nそれに引き換え王子君は、\nうー:
Heh, Anna-chan gave a good reaction back then.
In contrast, Prince, you seem… hmm? Not flustered at all….
m110001.ふふ、それは私が隠していたからですね。\n何しろ真なる英雄以外が、\nこの塔に迷:
Heh, that's because I kept it hidden.
After all, if anyone but a true hero wanders into this tower, it would be disastrous….
m110001.ふふ、やはり。\nあなたなら、かの魔王を\n滅ぼすことがかなうかもしれませんね。: Heh, just as I thought. You might actually be able to bring down that Demon King.
m110001.ふふ、ケイティちゃんも飲み込みが早い！\nちょうど良い機会なので、\n英傑の塔の: Heh, Katie-chan, you catch on quickly! Since the timing is perfect, let me explain the tower's special mechanisms.
m110001.ふふふ、かつての敵からも信頼が厚いとは、\nそういうところもあの人にそっくりです: Heh heh, even former enemies trust you so much—just like that person, you see.
m110001.ふふふ、さすがに塔が\n自分でそこまで判断はしませんよ♪: Heh heh, even the tower won't make such a judgment on its own♪
m110001.ふふふ。お見事！\nこの階層は制覇されました。: Heh heh. Well done! This floor is cleared.
m110001.ふむ……。\n塔に入るには相応の実力を見せよ、というわけじゃな。\n王子よ、油断: Hmm… To enter, you'll need to show appropriate strength. Don't let your guard down, Prince.
m110001.ふん、上等だ。\nさぁ王子、英雄王にお前の実力を見せてやろうぜ！: Hmph, fine enough. Come on, Prince, let's show the Hero King what you've got!
m110001.まぁ、新しい修行の場が増えるのは良いことだけどな。\nそれより、塔なんかに\nお: Well, more training grounds can't be bad. Still, I don't like being told I'm not strong enough for a tower.
m110001.まずは王子君と、王子君が信じる仲間達が、\nこの塔に入るだけの資格があるかどうか: First, Prince-kun and the comrades you trust must prove they're worthy of entering this tower. My guardians and I will see if you qualify.
m110001.もちろん、\n★の獲得数もスコアの評価対象になりますからね？: Of course, the number of ★ you earn also counts toward your score, you know?
m110001.よく来ましたね王子君。\nここが英雄たる者の器を試し、\n応えた者には更なる力を:
Well done arriving, Prince.
This is the Tower of Heroes, where a true hero's mettle is tested, and those who answer are granted greater power.
m110001.よろしい。\n狭間より現れる守護者と、私の魔術。\n見事退け、実力を見せてくださ: Very well. Face the guardians that emerge from the void and my own sorcery. Defeat us and show your true power!
m110001.わぁ……足場が浮いています……！\n魔界とも物質界とも違う、不思議な感じです……: Wow… the ground is floating! It feels strange—like neither the demon realm nor the material world.
m110001.シャディアちゃんは相変わらず心配性ですねぇ。\n何も自分の興味本位で、\nこんな: Shadia-chan, you're as worry-prone as ever. It wasn't my personal curiosity that led to building this tower, you know?
m110001.ワシらを見くびっては困る。\nこれより過酷な戦場はいくつもあったぞい。: Don't underestimate us. There are far harsher battlefields ahead.
m110001.今の私達では、天界の異変に対抗できないと……。\nそれで突然、２１層に続く階段が: With our current strength we can't counter the celestial disturbance… So a staircase suddenly appeared leading to the 21st floor?
m110001.何とも不思議な術です……。\n……おや？\nソラス殿、あの中央で光輝いているもの: What a bizarre technique… …Hmm? Solais, what's that glowing thing in the center?
m110001.冷静なところは、あの人そっくりですね。\nまぁそれはさておき、私がここへ来たのは:
Your composure is just like that person's.
Anyway, I'm here to guide you to the “Tower of Heroes”.
m110001.名前はあくまで、私がつけた仮のものですけどね。\nその正体は、いわば\n実力を示: The name's just a placeholder I came up with. Think of it as a certificate that proves your abilities.
m110001.塔が起動するまで身動きは取れませんでしたが、\nずっと、この世界を見守り続けてい: I was unable to move until the tower awakened, but I kept watching over this world—and the conflict between your two nations.
m110001.塔の試練を乗り越えたことを証明できれば、\n「英傑結晶交換所」で\n色々な報酬と: If you can prove you've cleared the tower's trials, you can trade it at the "Heroic Crystal Exchange" for all sorts of rewards.
m110001.王子君が、英雄王に匹敵する器なのかどうか。\n魔王を征し、物質界を守護する英雄足: Whether the Prince is truly worthy of matching the Hero King, and whether he can become a hero who subdues the Demon King and protects the material world.
m110001.異界の門を知っているなんて、\n当代の魔術師も捨てたものではなさそうですね。\n: Knowing about a gate to another world, huh? Even today's magi aren't without their tricks. In a way, it's similar—a liminal space connecting elsewhere.
m110001.私はソラス。\n英雄王と共に、かつて魔王を討伐した者のひとりです。:
I am Solais.
I was one of those who, alongside the Hero King, once defeated the Demon King.
m110001.私は彼の未来を想う願いを再現できるように、\nこの塔を設計したに過ぎませんからね: I only designed this tower so I could bring his wish for the future to life!
m110001.私もそのつもりでしたよ？\n２０層まで上り詰めれば、魔王ガリウスに\n対抗できる: I thought the same. I figured reaching the 20th floor would give us the power to stand against the Demon King Garius.
m110001.私達も、あの魔王を真に滅ぼすことは出来ませんでした。\nただアイギス様のお力を借: We couldn't truly defeat that Demon King ourselves. All we did was, with Aegis-san's help, temporarily seal him and push the problem into the future.
m110001.興味がありましたら、\nいつでも「英傑の塔」にいらしてください。\nふふ、王子君:
If you're interested, feel free to come to the Tower of Heroes anytime.
Heh, with your strength, it shouldn't be a problem.
m110001.英傑の塔の意思というべきもの。\n次代の英雄にあらゆる智慧と武技を授けんと、\n: You could call it the will of the Tower of Heroes. It wove a management magic to grant future heroes all wisdom and martial skill, encouraging their growth—
m110001.試練に臨む場合、\n出撃する人数、消費するコストが少ないほど、\nクリア時に記録: When you take on a trial, the fewer people you send out and the lower the cost you spend, the higher your "score" will be recorded upon clearing it.
m110001.諦めるなど……。\n我ら帝国が実力を認めた王子は、\nこんな所で引き返すような器: Give up? The Prince whom our Empire has recognized for his strength is not one to turn back now.
m110001.迷い込んだら、大変……？\nいったい中に何があるというのですか？: Wander in and it would be disastrous…? What exactly lies inside?
m110001.魔法都市に似ているような気もしますけど、\n見たことのない構造物ばかりです……。: It reminds me of a magical city, but everything here is unlike anything I've ever seen…

m200260.ありがとう、エイミーちゃん。\nこの銃、しばらく借りるわね。: Thanks, Amy-chan. I'll borrow this gun for a while.
m200260.いえ、こちらこそありがとうございました！\n温かいお風呂をいただいたばかりか、\: No, thank *you*! Not only did you give us a warm bath, but a delicious meal as well—I'm truly grateful!
m200260.いわば、クラリス殿は事態の中心にいたのだ。\n核心の地に現れたのも仕方があるまい: In other words, Claris was at the heart of it all. It's no surprise she appeared at the core.
m200260.ううん、私も行くわ。\nこの世界にはさっきみたいな魔物がいるんでしょ？\nだった: No, I'll go too. There are monsters like that in this world, right? I want to help however I can.
m200260.えっと……質問なんですけど、\n世界を越えて共鳴しちゃうほど、\n私の魔術って凄:
Um… I have a question.
Since my magic resonated across worlds, does that mean it's that powerful?
m200260.この世界には、たびたび別の世界から\n迷い込まれる方がいらっしゃいます。: People often get lost here from other worlds.
m200260.さあ、話は終わりだ。\n旅人たちよ、門をくぐり元の世界に戻るがいい。:
Now the story ends.
Travelers, step through the gate and return to your world.
m200260.そっか……。\n私、別の世界に飛ばされちゃったんだ……。: I see… I've been whisked away to another world…
m200260.それじゃあ王子、\n一緒にクラリスを探しに行きましょう！: Then, Prince, let's go find Claris together!
m200260.ちなみに、先ほど伺った話によると、\nクラリスさんという方も一緒にいたんですよね: By the way, you said someone named Claris was with you, correct?
m200260.でしたら、その方も\nこちらの世界に飛ばされている可能性が高いです。: If that's the case, she's probably also been sent here.
m200260.では、答えよう。\n答えは「否」だ。:
Then I'll answer.
The answer is “no.”
m200260.はい……。\n皆さん、本当にありがとうございました！:
Alright…
Everyone, thank you so much!
m200260.はい、見ました！ ハッキリと！\n小町さんに使ってもらえるなら、\nその銃も喜ぶ: Yes, I saw! Clearly! If you let me use it, the gun will be thrilled!
m200260.はい。\nですから、小町さんも、きっと元の世界に戻れます。: Yes. So you'll be able to go back, too.
m200260.みなさん、今回は本当にありがとうございました。: Everyone, thank you so much for everything this time.
m200260.アンナさんたちは、こういうの初めてじゃないんだ……。\nちょっとホッとするかも。: So you're not the first… That's a bit of a relief. Everyone who's come before has been able to return, right?
m200260.クラリス殿の魔術とダークエルフの魔術。\nこの二つが世界を越えて共鳴したためダー: Claris's magic and the dark elf's magic resonated across worlds, causing the dark elf's spell to go berserk and sending Claris and the others soaring through worlds.
m200260.助けられっ放しは、性に合わないしね。\nそれに、私の銃の腕はさっき見てくれたでし: Being rescued all the time isn't my style. Besides, you saw how good I am with a gun earlier, didn't you?
m200260.君の魔術が『そよ風』のようなものであったからこそ、\nただ門を開ける鍵になり得た:
Because your magic was more like a gentle breeze, it could only serve as the key to open the gate.
That, in its own way, was a fortunate turn of events.
m200260.君の魔術がダークエルフの魔術に匹敵するものであれば、\nダークエルフの村も、君の: If your magic had been on par with the dark elf's, both the dark-elf village and your body would have vanished.
m200260.小町さんがいた場所の近くにいる可能性もありますので、\nこれから探しに行こうと思: She might be nearby where you were, so we'll go look for her. You just rest here for now.
m200260.小町さんもその、先ほど伺ったデルーガ？\nという怪物との戦闘中に、\nこちらの世: It looks like you were thrown into our world during that battle with the monster Deluga you mentioned earlier.
m200260.最初に出会ったのがダークエルフだった私は、\n全然良くなかったですけど！: I first ran into a dark elf, and that was… not great at all!
m200260.本当にお世話になったわね。\nこの世界に来て最初に出会った人が、\nあなたたちで: You really took care of us. I'm glad the first people I met in this world were you.
m200260.私も、小町さんたちに出会えて良かったです！: I feel the same—I'm glad I met you all, Komachi-san!
m200260.答えを聞きたいかね？: You want to hear the answer?

m200384.――あ、あなたたち！\nこっちには前チャンプ、アナトリア様がいるんですよ！？\n: —Ah, you there! Over here we have the former champion, Lady Anatolia! At the very least, let's try to negotiate—
m200384.――あ、あれ？\nあの雪上部隊って、帝国軍とは違うよね……。\nベラート伯爵の紋: ——Huh? That snow-troop isn't Imperial, is it? They're bearing Count Berault's crest…
m200384.――あえて、帝国の布陣が完了するのを待つとは。\n盟友ハイドース殿は、\n奴らに: Segnand —So you actually wait for the Empire's formation to finish? Your ally, Lord Hydos, intends to give them no excuse at all.
m200384.――あれ、その王子殿下と皇帝陛下は？: —Hey, what about that Prince and the Emperor?
m200384.――あれは……大変です！\nもう戦闘が始まりそうですよ！: —That… that's bad! A battle looks about to start!
m200384.――いえ、王国との連携はより強化すべきです。\nこの戦争は、国家同士のものとは\:
—No, we should strengthen our coordination with the Kingdom.
This war is so different from a war between nations that the premise is entirely unlike.
m200384.――いや、いるよ。\n正規軍は忠誠心の高い兵士ばかりだけど、\nそうじゃない連中: —No, there is. The regular troops are loyal, but there are those who aren't, and they exist within the Empire.
m200384.――うぅぅぅ、どうしよ、どうしたらいい？\nボクにできること、何かない！？:
——Uuuuh, what do I do, what should I do?
Is there anything I can do!?
m200384.――えっ、こんな北の僻地まで、\n王国軍が視察に来てるの？: ???: —Huh, the Kingdom's army is scouting all the way out here in this northern backwater?
m200384.――おお、久方ぶりの物質界だ。\nここは白の帝国だな。\nははは、昔もこの辺りま: Ah, it's been ages since I've set foot in the material world. This is the White Empire, huh? Hahaha, I once pushed this far back in the day!
m200384.――おっと、ここにいたか！\nそろそろ戦闘が始まるぜ、\n連中が砦の「城門」に押: —Whoa, there you are! The battle's about to start, they're swarming the fortress's “gate”!
m200384.――おや、皆さんお揃いのようですね。\n女神アダマス様は、先程お眠りになりました: —Well, it seems everyone's here. Goddess Adamas has just fallen asleep.
m200384.――けっ、これだから気に入らねぇんだ。\n思いやりと慈しみなんかで、\n無数に増: ――Damn it, this is why I can't stand you. You think compassion and love can handle an endless tide of the dead?
m200384.――ここが、憎きアダマスを信仰する国、か。: —So this is the nation that worships the hated Adamas.
m200384.――この港が落ちるか否か。\nこの戦いが、帝国の試金石となる。: —Whether this port falls or stands. This battle will be the empire's litmus test.
m200384.――これで終わりか、冥界軍。\n皇帝の首はここだぞ。: —Is this the end, armies of the Underworld? The emperor's head ends here.
m200384.――さぁ、女神アダマスよ。\n此度の戦は始まったばかり。\nその首、どう落として: —Now, Goddess Adamas. This war has only just begun. How shall we decapitate her…?
m200384.――さて、そろそろ時間か。\n帝国軍、王国軍の目は洋上に引きつけた。\n……上手:
—Well then, it's about time.
The Imperial and Kingdom forces have drawn the enemy's gaze to the sea.
…Do your best, Lord Segnand.
m200384.――さて、どう出る冥界軍。\nこちらの備えは万全だぞ？: Now then, how will the Underworld army appear? Our preparations are flawless, you know.
m200384.――そこに、亜神にあってはならない、\n私怨が存在しないと本当に言い切れるのかし: —And you claim that, as a demigod, you have no personal grudges at all. Can you really say that?
m200384.――そして、今やその理想に呼応する者は、\nこの物質界だけに留まらないのだよ。: —And now, those who answer that ideal no longer remain only in this material world.
m200384.――そんなバカな。\n皆、気を抜くな！ オーク勇者が立ち上がった！:
—No way.
Everyone, stay sharp! The Orc hero has risen!
m200384.――だが、だからこそ、この戦はワシらのものよ。\n戦果を取られたくなければ、\n: —But that's exactly why this battle belongs to us. If you don't want us taking your victories, don't hold back—follow us, you modern Orcs!!
m200384.――だが、勝たねばならない。\n俺には、帝国の民を守る義務がある。: —But we must win. I have a duty to protect the Empire's people.
m200384.――だがなぁ、呼び声に応えてしまったワシらも悪いが、\nあまり死者に頼るでないぞ: —But, as much as it's our fault for answering the call, don't rely too much on the dead, youngster.
m200384.――つまり、これはある意味では好機ということね。\n時間を稼げたというのなら、\:
—So, in a way, this is an opportunity.
If we've bought some time, we can also make various preparations.
m200384.――では、また会いましょうぞ。\n白の王国を、取り戻すために。: Belart ——Then, let us meet again. To reclaim the White Kingdom.
m200384.――では、此度の大戦、\nもはや異種族と帝国の戦いには収まらないということか。\: —So this great war… it's no longer just a clash between races and the Empire. You're turning swords against your own country's soldiers, aren't you?
m200384.――でも、この戦いは勝てるよ。\n何しろ砦ひとつの防衛に、\n我が愛しの王子が参: —But we can win this. After all, our beloved Prince is joining the defense of this very fortress!
m200384.――ところで、リンクスよ。\nそろそろ、良いのではないか？:
—By the way, Lynx.
Isn't it about time?
m200384.――なぜ、私たちを置いていった。\n我が献身は、我が忠誠は、\n決してハイドース: ――Why did you leave us behind? My devotion, my loyalty was never meant for Hydos.
m200384.――ならば、冥界軍の蜂起に際して、\n君らも帝国に反旗を翻すと思っていたのさ。: —So, when the Nether-world army rose, I expected you'd turn against the Empire.
m200384.――なるほど、ね……。\n白の帝国だけならまだしも、\n王国がここまで厄介だなん: I see… If it were only the White Empire, that'd be one thing, but the Kingdom being this troublesome…
m200384.――ねぇレーネ、どうして追ってきたの？: —Hey Lehne, why are you chasing after us?
m200384.――ねぇ！ ちょっとー！\nアタシひとりじゃ限界があるんだけどー！！: Hey! Wait a sec! I can't do this alone!!
m200384.――はぁ……やれやれ……。\n獣人の誇りとか何とか、\nそんなのアタシだって分か: Hah… well, well… Pride and all that… I get it, I really do.
m200384.――はっ。\n総員、陣形を整えろ！\nまもなく敵の第二波が来るぞ！:
—Ha.
All units, form up!
The enemy's second wave is coming soon!
m200384.――ふむ、帝国軍ばかりか王国軍までも。\n帝都からにしては、随分と早い到着だ。: —Hmm, not just the Imperial troops but the Kingdom's as well. For a capital city, they arrived surprisingly quickly.
m200384.――ほら、そこから\nこちらを見張っている、伏兵がいたりするからね！: You never know—there could be ambushers watching us from over there!
m200384.――まったく、セグナンドにも呆れたものだな。\n前線に出た時の、あの表情を見たか: ——Good grief, I'm amazed at Segnand. Did you see the look on his face when he stepped onto the front lines?
m200384.――やられたことと、同じ手段をもって報復する。\nそれも正々堂々と、真正面から。: —We'll retaliate with the same methods they used against us, fair and square, head-on. That's why they've risen again.
m200384.――よし、敵拠点を潰せたか。\nこれで多少は動きやすくなるな。:
—All right, we've taken out the enemy base.
That should make movement a bit easier.
m200384.――オークの王よ、なぜこの地に留まる。: ???: ――Ogre king, why do you linger here?
m200384.――ダークエルフの部隊が、砂浜に上陸します！: —The Dark Elf troops are landing on the beach!
m200384.――ッ！\n貴様は……。\nなぜ生きている、その神器は何だ？:
—!
You…
Why are you still alive, and what is that relic?
m200384.――ディアナ様！\n王国の死霊魔術師より報告です！\n周辺から、異様な魔力を感知: —Lady Diana! A report from the kingdom's necromancer! Unusual magical energy detected nearby!
m200384.――ハイドースが黒炎をまとって……。\nいいえ、これは……！:
――Hydos is cloaked in black flame…
No, this can't be…!
m200384.――ハイドース様。\n帝国の防衛網が偏り始めたわ。:
—Lord Hydos.
The Empire's defensive network is beginning to tilt.
m200384.――ハハッ、今の世を生きる若人たちに、\nこんな捨て身の攻撃をさせるわけにはいか: —Haha, I can't let the youngsters of this age launch such a reckless attack.
m200384.――ベラート伯爵、善戦しているようだな。: —Count Belart, you seem to be fighting well.
m200384.――ベラート伯爵の領地は、\n暫定的にディアナに管理させることになった。: —The Count Belart's lands will, for the time being, be placed under Diana's administration.
m200384.――マルレーン！ 陛下っ！ 王子殿下ぁ！！\nはぁっ……はぁ……っ！！\nほ、報: ——Marleen! Your Majesty! Prince…!! Haa… haa…!! Re—port! It's a report!!
m200384.――リンクスよ、指揮官が前線に出るなとは、\n確かお前から聞いた言葉ではなかった: —Lynx, didn't you say the commander shouldn't go to the front lines?
m200384.――リンクス！\nようやく、ようやく追いつきました……。: —Lynx! At last, at last we've caught up…
m200384.――三代目、白の帝国皇帝。\n帝国領土を盤石のものとした、\n血と骸による勝利の:
――I am the third, the White Imperial Emperor.
The true emperor who stands upon victories of blood and bone,
who has turned the empire's lands into a solid foundation.
m200384.――下がって！\nなにぼーっとしてるの！？: Step back! What are you spacing out for!?
m200384.――亜神にその刃を届かせるか。\n見事だ、白の皇帝よ。:
—Will you let that blade reach a demigod?
Well done, White Emperor.
m200384.――人ガ空を飛ぶ時代カ……。\n不敬ダト言ってやりたいトコロダガ、\nむしろコレ: ——An age where people fly through the sky… I'd love to call it blasphemy, but perhaps this is exactly what human power is all about.
m200384.――伝令！ 伝令！\nオーク部隊に不穏な動きあり！\n敵部隊に――新たにオークの: —Messenger! Messenger! There's unsettling movement in the orc units! The enemy forces— a new orc hero has joined them!
m200384.――伯爵は上手くやっているようね。\n自尊心ばかり高い俗物かと思えば、\nそれな:
—The count seems to be doing well.
I thought he'd be a vain fool, but he's actually quite useful.
m200384.――傷つき、倒れ、命が散っていく。\n悲しいものだな、我が冥界の力が満ちるほどに:
—Wounded, fallen, lives scattered.
It's sad, how the more my underworld power fills, the more tragedy spreads across the surface.
m200384.――先代、まさか本当に蘇ってくるとは。: —Predecessor, I never imagined you'd truly return.
m200384.――全員等しく、オレが裁いてやるよッ！！: —I'll judge every single one of you!!
m200384.――兵には、小休止を取らせろ。\nこの男は、俺が弔う。: —Give the troops a short rest. I'll see to his funeral.
m200384.――兵には箝口令を敷け。\n特に貴族連中の耳には届かないように。: —Issue a gag order to the soldiers. Make sure it doesn't reach the ears of the nobles.
m200384.――冥界、どうやって行くんだろう。: ――The Netherworld… I wonder how we get there.
m200384.――冥界軍の最大の強みとは、何だと思う？: ――What do you think is the greatest strength of the Netherworld army?
m200384.――冥界軍を迎え撃つぞ、総員配置につけ！！: —All units, prepare to meet the Netherworld army!
m200384.――勝利より、兵を取りましたか。\nさすがは冥界の亜神。: ???: —Did you take troops instead of victory? As befits a demigod of the Underworld.
m200384.――単純に考えるのなら、\n亜神ハイドースの魔力の総量でしょうね。: If we think simply, it's probably the total magical power of the demigod Haidous.
m200384.――友を迎えるのが、随分と遅くなってしまった。\nちびっこではなく友として、\n: —It's taken me far too long to welcome a friend. No longer a child, but a comrade, a warrior who lets out a roar.
m200384.――否、ダ。\nハルモニアよ、こちらへ付くナラバ好きにシロ。\nそうでないならば: —No. Harmonia, if you come with me, you're free to do as you wish. If not, the locals here will all die by lightning.
m200384.――国とか種族とかどうでもいい。\nあたしが戦うのは、あたしの前で誰も死なせない: —Nation, race… none of that matters. I fight so no one dies in front of me.
m200384.――地下からでも、\n物質界に戻れるのではなくて？: So even from underground, we can get back to the material realm, can't we?
m200384.――報告！\n敵軍が回り込む形で、工場地帯に侵入とのこと！: —Report! The enemy is flanking, moving into the industrial zone!
m200384.――帝都を包囲していた冥界軍は、\n戦闘終了と同時に撤退、行方は目下捜索中です。: —The netherworld army that was besieging the Imperial Capital withdrew as soon as combat ended; their whereabouts are currently being investigated.
m200384.――必ず、この国が崩壊するより前に、\n祖国をこの歪みきった体制から解放するのだ: ――I'll free our homeland from this twisted regime before this country falls apart!!
m200384.――悔いておるのか、メリュジアナ。\nおぬしが王国に付くことを選んだその時に、\: —Do you regret it, Meliusiana? When you chose to side with the kingdom, you failed to deal with those little ones who slipped away.
m200384.――態勢を整えるため、あえて撤退した、\nといったところかな、あちらの部隊は。: —They withdrew on purpose to regroup, I suppose, that unit over there.
m200384.――我が兵よ、我が民たちよ、今行くぞ！\n黄金に輝く鋼の騎馬！\n最新鋭バトルタ: —My soldiers, my people, forward! The golden-shining steel cavalry! Behold the might of our newest battle tank!
m200384.――我が同胞たちよ、魔界の連中とは違う、\n物質界に生きる強きダークエルフの同胞: —My comrades, unlike the demons of the Netherworld, you are the strong Dark Elves of the material realm!
m200384.――我が悲願、その最初の一手。\n憎きアダマスの首が、今や目前にある。: This is the first move of my lifelong ambition. The hated Adamas's head is finally within reach.
m200384.――戦う理由、\nどうやら見つかったようだね、我が友よ。: —So the reason for fighting… seems we've finally found it, my friend.
m200384.――戦争など、強がりで参戦するものではない、か。\nそんなこと、最初から分かって: War isn't something you join just to show off, is it? I've known that from the start…
m200384.――敵は市街に侵入した可能性がある。\n帝国の兵よ、民を守ることを最優先としろ！:
——The enemy may have infiltrated the city.
Imperial soldiers, protect the civilians above all else!
m200384.――敵襲ー！ 敵襲です！！\nオークの部隊が動き始めましたー！！: Enemy attack! Enemy attack!! The orc troops are on the move!!
m200384.――未だコノ身、雷霆まとう竜には及ばヌが。\n闇水晶が力をモッテ、その一端を見せ: —Even now, I cannot match the thunder-clad dragon. The dark crystal holds power; let it show you a glimpse.
m200384.――本当に死者を、それもオーク勇者を蘇らせるとは。\nハイドースの権能は底なしな: —To actually revive the dead, even an Orc hero… Is Hydo's power limitless?
m200384.――次なる戦いに備えろ。\nどれだけの猶予があるか、分からないのだからな。: —Prepare for the next battle. We have no idea how much time we'll have.
m200384.――殿下、下がってください！\n何かが出現しようとしています！！:
――Your Highness, step back!
Something is about to appear!!
m200384.――法を破ったのは、どちらかしら。\nハイドース様……いえ、亜神ハイドースの侵攻: —Whoever broke the law, it must be one side or the other. Lord Haidous… no, Demigod Haidous's invasion—can we truly say it was in accordance with the law?
m200384.――王子、吹雪が迫ってるよ。\nこのままだと、遠距離がより狙いにくくなるかも……: ——Prince, a blizzard's closing in. If it keeps up, ranged units will become even harder to hit…
m200384.――王子様、城壁が破られました。\n獣人部隊の強襲……これは、リンクスの部隊です: Prince, the walls have been breached. Beastmen are launching a massive assault... this is the Lynx unit!
m200384.――王子！ 冥界軍が前線を下げ始めました！: Prince! The Netherworld troops are retreating from the front!
m200384.――現在、帝国軍の大半は帝都周辺の防衛に当たっている。\nだが、一部の部隊は敵軍: —Currently, most of the Imperial forces are stationed around the capital for defense. However, some units have become isolated by the enemy and are now stuck with no way out.
m200384.――私ならそうする、ということです。\nまだセグナンドは手の内を見せていない、\: ——If it were me, that's exactly what I'd do. Segnand hasn't shown his hand yet, so the only time to go all-out is the next battle.
m200384.――総員、迎撃準備！\nこの橋でベラートの兵を止める！: All units, prepare to intercept! We'll stop Berato's troops on this bridge!
m200384.――総員警戒！\n上空に飛空戦艦出現！:
——All units, on alert!
An airship warship has appeared overhead!
m200384.――美しい街だ。\n愛すべき、白の王国の街だ。:
——What a beautiful city.
A beloved city of the White Kingdom.
m200384.――聞け！ 百獣の民たちよ！: —Listen up! People of the Hundred Beasts!
m200384.――街周辺の被害は甚大だ。\n港としての機能も、しばらくは回復しないだろうね。: —The damage around the city is severe. The port won't be functional for a while.
m200384.――裏切られ、背後よりの凶刃に倒れ、\nさぞ無念な生だったことだろう。: —Betrayed, felled by a blade from behind… it must have been a bitter end.
m200384.――見せかけの安定を維持することだけ。\n真の平和を目指すのは、亜神の脅威が去っ: —maintain this façade of stability. True peace can only come after the demigod threat is gone. …It seems we're on the same page.
m200384.――見事。\n鬼にしておくニハ、勿体ない実力ダ。: ——Magnificent. To keep you as a demon would be a waste of such power.
m200384.――覚悟は決まったようだな。\nもはや領地に戻ることはできまい。\n冥界に拠点を:
――It seems your resolve is set.
You can't return to your lands any more.
We'll set up a base in the Underworld for you.
m200384.――誇り。\n誇りと言いましたか。これは笑わせる。:
— Pride.
You speak of pride? That's laughable.
m200384.――誰が、会わない方がいいヤツだ。\n親父、今度こそ死に様を看取ってやるぞ。: —Who's the one you don't want to meet? Father, this time I'll see you die.
m200384.――陛下、それに王子殿下！\nよかった……援軍が間に合ったのですね！: —Your Majesty, and Prince! Thank goodness… the reinforcements have arrived in time!
m200384.――陛下、伝令です！\n北部の街道にダークエルフの部隊が出現、\n陣地を強襲、占:
—Your Majesty, a messenger!
Dark-elf troops have appeared on the northern road, stormed the position and seized it!
m200384.――陛下、冥界軍を名乗る勢力は、\n遠間より帝都を包囲するつもりのようです。: —Your Majesty, the forces calling themselves the Netherworld army seem intent on surrounding the capital from afar.
m200384.――陛下！ 獣人の部隊が街道沿いに展開しています！\nこれは……帝国の庇護下にあ:
—Your Majesty! Beastmen units are deploying along the road!
These are… beastmen under the Empire's protection!
m200384.――随分と、久しぶりな気がするわ。\n静かで、冷たくて、時の止まったかのような場: —It feels like ages since I've been here. So quiet, so cold, as if time itself has stopped…
m200384.――集え、かつて白の王国を守護せし者たちよ。\n父祖の地を、数多の子らの大地を、: —Gather, those who once protected the White Kingdom. Reclaim the ancestral lands, the countless children's lands, with your own hands.
m200384.――騎士よ……ぐっ、ぐぉぉぉ……。\nティルト、よ……！ 見ているのだろう！？: —Knight… ggh… Tilt…! You're watching, aren't you?
m200384.――驚くことではない。\n近隣の砦を巡回中でな。\n悔しいが、あの元帥の策略だ。:
—It's no surprise.
We've been patrolling nearby forts.
Regrettable, but that's the marshal's scheme.
m200384.――黒き竜人の長ヨ、見事ナ散り様でアッタ。\n竜人勢力モ、順調に進行経路タル大穴: ——Lord of the black draconians, your spectacular downfall. The draconian forces are still widening the great chasms along their path.
m200384.……………あぁ。\nありがとう、砲を担う美しき騎士よ。: ……Ah. Thank you, beautiful knight who bears the cannon.
m200384.…………。\nそれは確かに、命を繋ぐに値する理由だ。:
………
Indeed, that is a reason worthy of keeping life.
m200384.…………。\n私ならば、後退を進言するところですね。: …If it were me, I'd recommend a retreat.
m200384.…………。\n置いていかれたく、なかった……。\n私が一番、ヘカティエ様のお力に: ……… I didn't want to be abandoned… I should have been the one to help Hecatie the most.
m200384.…………ああ、さらばだ、息子よ。\n――困った時には頼れよ、冥界から助けに来てや: ………Farewell, son. —If you're ever in trouble, call on me; I'll come from the Underworld to help.
m200384.…………いや……いやよ。\n私の憧れた勇者に、百獣の王者に、\nそんな姿は、見せ: ………No… no. I never wanted the hero I admired, the ruler of a hundred beasts, to look like that…
m200384.…………そういう話は、作戦室でするものだぞ。\n廊下で不穏な話題を撒き散らすな。: ………That kind of talk belongs in the war room. Don't spread unsettling rumors in the hallway.
m200384.…………っ！！\n誰もがあなたみたいに強い戦士じゃないのよ！\n言っても分からな: ………!! Not everyone can be a warrior as strong as you! If you can't understand even when I tell you—
m200384.…………ふむ。\n王子に打診してみるとしよう。: ………Hmm. I'll bring it up with the Prince.
m200384.…………やめろ、レオナ。\nもう、手遅れだ……前線の戦力を……無駄に使うな。: ………Stop, Leona. It's too late… Don't waste the front-line forces…
m200384.…………マルレーン、別人みたいだったな。\n軍人になると、変わっちゃうものなのか: ………Marleen, you were like a different person. I guess becoming a soldier changes you. It feels like the story of us getting scolded for stealing bread was a lie.
m200384.…………全軍、後退だ。\n陣形を乱すな。山腹に到着次第反撃に移る。: ………All troops, fall back. Keep formation. Once we reach the mountain slopes, we'll counter-attack.
m200384.…………我が同胞ながら、無茶ばかりするものだ。: ………Even our own kind can be so reckless.
m200384.…………本当に、いいの？\n白の帝国にすら、私たちは牙を向けて――: ………Really, is that okay? Even the White Empire, we'll turn our fangs on—
m200384.…………来るとは思っていたが、早すぎるぞ。\n帝国兵の手柄を奪うつもりだったか？: …I expected you'd come, but you're too early. Planning to steal the Imperial troops' glory?

m200384.……レオナ、兵に伝えろ。\n飛空戦艦は車両部隊を輸送しているはずだ。\n可能であ: …Leona, tell the troops: those airships are probably transporting ground units. If possible, shoot them down before the troops land.
m200384.……ワシの息子のくせに、頑張ったんだな。\n戦うことしか教えられなかったが、\n: …Even though he's my son, he did his best. All I could teach him was to fight, and… so he's become king…
m200384.……事実は変わらない。\nだが、冥界軍に与するというのなら、\n再び剣を向けるし:
…The facts remain unchanged.
But if you side with the Netherworld army,
we'll have no choice but to draw our swords again.
m200384.……亜神ハイドースを討つ、\nそれしかない、だろうな。: …We have to take down the demigod Hydros—that's the only way, I guess.
m200384.……人同士が殺しあった、憎しみと後悔、\n悲哀と苦痛の満ちるこの地より、\n冥界: …In this land soaked with hatred, regret, sorrow, and pain where humans slaughtered each other, the Gate of the Underworld once opened.
m200384.……以前ならば、躊躇なくそうしていただろう。\nだが、帝国は変わらねばならんと、: …In the past we would have done so without hesitation. But the Emperor wishes the empire to change.
m200384.……何が勇姿なものか。\n賄賂と不正で蓄えた資金の結晶だろう。: …What's so glorious about it? Just a crystal of money amassed through bribes and fraud.
m200384.……何が来ようと、することは変わらない。\nまずは兵に休息を取らせろ。: …Whatever comes, our orders remain the same. First, give the troops a rest.
m200384.……何を仰っているか、分からないわ。: …I don't understand what you're getting at.
m200384.……何を言ってイル。\n黒き竜人族ハ、モハヤお前の民ではナイ。: …What are you saying? The black draconians are not Mohaya's people.
m200384.……俺が言うまでもなかったか。\n敵とすれば怖ろしいが、\n味方となれば心強いも: …Didn't I make that clear? The enemy's terrifying, but an ally… that's reassuring.
m200384.……俺が退けば、民が死ぬ、か。\n――女神アダマス、力を借りるぞ。: ...If I retreat, the people will die, huh. —Goddess Adamas, lend me your power.
m200384.……先代も。\n最期にふさわしい、堂々たる戦いでした。:
……Even the predecessor.
It was a dignified battle worthy of the end.
m200384.……先輩方は、いったいどんな戦法で、\n帝国軍の足止めをしているのですか？: …Senior officers, what tactics are you using to hold back the Imperial army?
m200384.……兵を引き上げました、か。\n次の激突に、全戦力を当てるつもりでしょうね。: …You've pulled your troops back, then. You're planning to throw all your forces into the next clash, I assume.
m200384.……冥界から蘇った者たち、ね。\nでも力は不安定みたい。:
…Those who've risen from the Underworld, huh.
But their power seems unstable.
m200384.……冥界の亜神、ハイドースに与した者の中に、\n私の友人がいるんです。\nその子:
…Among those who serve the Underworld demigod Haidos, there's a friend of mine.
That child might be leading the unit.
m200384.……冥界軍、退いていきます。\nおそらく、次の侵攻が最大のものになるかと……。: …The underworld army will withdraw. The next invasion will likely be the biggest one…
m200384.……初めて斬り結んだが、\nこれが帝国、そして王国の精鋭たちか。: …This is my first time forging a bond, and these are the Empire's and Kingdom's elite.
m200384.……剣を向けたまま交渉を迫るのが帝国流では？\nなんて思っていたけれど、\n陛下:
…I used to think the Imperial way was to demand negotiations with swords still drawn.
But both Your Majesty and Diana have become surprisingly… soft.
m200384.……剣を向けて交渉って、\nそれ脅迫って言わないかしら？: …Negotiating with swords drawn—doesn't that sound more like intimidation?
m200384.……力に酔ったか、ダークエルフの長め。: …You've become drunk on power, Dark Elf leader.
m200384.……勝っても負けてもいいから、死ぬな、と。\nえぇ、分かったわ、ハイドース様。: …Win or lose, just don't die. Got it, Hydos.
m200384.……命までは、届かなかったか。\nしかしもう、その灯火も尽きかけている。: ...It didn't even reach your life. Yet that flame is already fading.
m200384.……国を奪われたのだろう？\n国とは故郷であり、骨を埋めるべき父祖の地だ。: …Your country was taken, wasn't it? A country is one's homeland, the land where our ancestors should be buried.
m200384.……声が、聞こえただけだ。\n帰ってこいと、俺を呼ぶ声がな。:
…I only heard a voice.
A voice calling me back, urging me to return.
m200384.……嬉しそうだな、ベラート伯爵。\nそんなに白の皇帝と戦いたかったのか？: ???: …You look pleased, Count Belart. Did you really want to fight the White Emperor that much?
m200384.……帝国に帰順するよりはマシな選択か。\n兵の中には、連中に恨みを持つ者もいるか: …Better than submitting to the Empire. Some of the troops still hold grudges against them.
m200384.……強く、なったのう。\n実に、竜人らしい苛烈な戦いじゃった……。:
……You've grown strong.
Truly, a fierce battle befitting dragons…
m200384.……彼の、最後の王命だ。\n臣下ならば、それに応えてみせよ。: …It's his final command. As his vassal, I'll obey.
m200384.……後少し、もう少し、\nほんの一歩が足りないというのか。: …Just a little more, just a step away.
m200384.……快復祝い、といったところか？\n生きるか死ぬかという状況だったというのに……: …A celebration of recovery, then? After all, they were on the brink of life or death…
m200384.……惜しい戦士だ。\nなぜお前ほどの実力を備えた男が、\n国家の長などに収まって:
…A worthy warrior.
Why does a man of your caliber serve as a head of state?
m200384.……想定以上に、帝国軍からの離反者は多いようだな。: …It seems there are more defectors from the Empire than we expected.
m200384.……慌てるな。\n戦闘の準備はできている。: …Don't panic. We're already prepared for combat.
m200384.……我が王のような、勇者では？\nいくつもの戦場を駆け抜け、\n勝利をその手にも: …Someone like our king—a hero? One who's raced through countless battles and seized victory with his own hands?
m200384.……戦が起きれば、民は困窮しますからな。\n怒りだけで戦うことはできない、\nそ: …If war breaks out, the people will suffer. We can't fight on pure rage alone; that's an undeniable truth.
m200384.……手遅れ、って可能性もあるけどね。: …There's a chance it might already be too late.
m200384.……指揮官はハイドース様ですから。\n私は前線指揮官、兵と共に最前線に立つのが役: The commander is you, Hydos. I'm the frontline commander; it's my duty to stand at the front with the troops.
m200384.……提督、もったいぶった言い方をする必要はない。\nあれは、元は帝国艦隊のひとつ: …Admiral, there's no need for such roundabout talk. It was originally part of the Imperial fleet.
m200384.……撃退した、というより――: …We didn't so much defeat them as—
m200384.……敵の配置が広範囲に渡っています。\nこれだけの広さの戦場では、\n遠方の部隊:
…The enemy's formation spans a wide area.
On a battlefield this large, supporting distant units will be difficult.
m200384.……敵勢力が多すぎる。\n白の王国時代の貴族どもめ、\nこれを好機と見て、反旗を: …The enemy forces are too many. Those nobles from the White Kingdom era have taken this as a chance to turn traitor.
m200384.……断る。\n私はもはや、貴様の一族ではない。\n庇護される幼き日々は、もう終わ:
…I refuse.
I am no longer of your clan.
The days of being sheltered are over.
m200384.……時が満ちようとしている、か。: …The time is about to come, is it?
m200384.……時は来た。\n先陣を切った獣人、オークの戦いぶりは聞いているな。:
…The time has come.
I've heard tales of the beastmen and orc's fighting spirit at the vanguard.
m200384.……東の山脈に隠れて、\n敵の全容が把握できない状況ですか。: …Hidden behind the eastern mountains, we can't get a full picture of the enemy.
m200384.……死者の世界を経由するとは、\nどれだけ便利だろうと、考えたくもないな。: …Using the realm of the dead as a shortcut—how convenient that would be, I don't even want to think about it.
m200384.……気のせいだ。\nこれは我らが怒りを突き立てるための戦い、\n享楽のための戦で: …Just my imagination. This is a fight to channel our wrath, not a battle for enjoyment.
m200384.……照れるなぁ、それ。\nさぁ、走るよ！ 物質界に帰ろう！: …Don't be shy about that. Come on, let's run! Back to the material realm!
m200384.……物質界のダークエルフ、\nその長が自ら出てきたか。: …The material-world Dark-elf chieftain has shown himself.
m200384.……王国としても、亜神が物質界に\n干渉しているとなれば、\nその目的を明らかに: ...Even as the Kingdom, if a demigod is meddling in the material world, we'll want to uncover its purpose.
m200384.……王子、冥界軍が動きます。: …Prince, the Underworld army is on the move.
m200384.……王子。なに、気にするな。\nかつて伝えられなかった別れの言葉を、\n今こうし: …Prince. Don't worry. The parting words we never got to say before can finally be spoken now.
m200384.……白の帝国の、雪上部隊のことですか？\nしかし、ベラート伯爵の領地には、\n積: …You're talking about the White Empire's snow-troop? But Count Berault's lands didn't include any snowy region…
m200384.……確かに、そうですな。\n白の王国を取り戻す、その理想のために、\n歩みを共に: …Indeed. To reclaim the White Kingdom, we must bear the pride of those who walked beside us.
m200384.……綺麗な顔を揃えておいて、話題はとことん不穏だな。: ……They all have such pretty faces, yet the topic is utterly unsettling.
m200384.……自分でここにいることを選んだ者が、\nいったいどれだけいるのか疑問だけれど。: Lynx —…I wonder how many actually chose to be here of their own volition.
m200384.……苦しい戦いではありますが、\nきっと、勝利をつかみ取りましょう！: …It's a grueling fight, but we'll seize victory together!
m200384.……行け。\nこの者は、俺たちが丁重に弔っておこう。: …Go. We'll see to his proper burial.
m200384.……覚悟はできているようだな。\nならば容赦は――:
…You seem prepared.
Then I shall show no mercy—
m200384.……親友だった、よ。\n王国の飼い猫になった無冠のチャンピオンは、\nもはや獣人: …We were friends, huh. The uncrowned champion turned palace cat is now nothing but a traitor who betrayed the beastfolk.
m200384.……言いたいことは、伝えておく……か。: …So I'm supposed to… make sure I tell them?
m200384.……言葉を交わす必要はない。\n彼女が嗅ぎつけてくるのも時間の問題だ。: ……No need for words. It's only a matter of time before she sniffs it out.
m200384.……記録不明。\nルインの記憶装置内には、該当する情報が存在しません。: …No record. My memory core contains no information on that.
m200384.……読まれていた、ということ？\n仕方ない、兵に撤退命令を。: …So they saw right through us, huh? Fine, order a retreat.
m200384.……諦めぬコトコソ、人の強さカ。\nナラバ同じ空デ、ソノ戦いぶりヲ見せてもらオウ: …That relentless resolve—that's human strength. Then let them show me that fighting style up here in the same sky.
m200384.……謙遜するな。\nその着眼点は、間違っていない。\n敵の動きは、最初から奇妙だ: ...Don't be modest. Your insight isn't wrong. The enemy's movements have been strange from the start.
m200384.……軍に敵対する貴族家に、\nその身柄を利用されないよう守るためだって、\n言っ: …If you just said it was to protect her from noble families that might use her as a pawn against the army…
m200384.……連中は庇護とは思うまい。\n侵略戦争を仕掛けたのは、俺たちなのだからな。:
…They won't think of it as protection.
We are the ones who launched the invasion war, after all.
m200384.……闇水晶の力だけデハ、ここが限界カ。\n冥界の亜神ヨ、私ハ退くぞ。: …With only the power of the Dark Crystal, I've reached my limit. I, a demigod of the Underworld, shall withdraw.
m200384.……陛下、冥界軍が動き始めました。: Leona —…Your Majesty, the armies of the Underworld have begun moving.
m200384.……骸帝。\nあの鎧、あの武具、まさに肖像画で見たお姿だ。:
…Bone Emperor.
That armor, that weaponry—exactly as I saw in the portrait.
m200384.……黙レ、黒き竜人の裏切り者。\nモハヤ、誰もお前を族長トハ認めナイ。:
…Silence, traitor of the black dragons.
Mohaya, no one acknowledges you as chieftain.
m200384.「ボクには路地裏が似合うのさ」なんて言って、\nアタシの誘いを断ったのはレーネの:
“I belong in the back alleys,” you said, turning down my invitation—that was you, Lehne—
…Huh? What's that sound?
m200384.あ、れは……。\nまさか……うそ、そんなことって……。:
Ah, that…
No way… this can't be true…
m200384.あぁ……もうっ！\n覚えてろよマルレーン！\nあんたを！ 助けに行くんだから！: Ah… damn it! Remember this, Marleen! I'm coming to save you! Consider that a favor!
m200384.あぁもう！ うるさいリンクス！\n誇り高き咆哮は！ 何者をも斬り裂く爪は！\n獣: Ah, enough! Shut up, Lynx! Your lofty roar! Your claws that could tear anything apart! What good are the beast-folk's fangs for!!
m200384.あぁ？ てめぇら、逃げるつもりか！？: Huh? You guys planning to run away!?
m200384.ああ、ここだ。\n敵の目標は最初から、俺をここに引きずりだすことにある。: Ah, here it is. The enemy's goal was to lure me here from the beginning.
m200384.ああ、こんな状況で、例えば――\n――そう、例えばどこかの王子様が、\n颯爽と私: Ah, in a situation like this… imagine—yes, imagine some prince galloping in to rescue me…
m200384.ああ、さっき皇帝の私室に行ったわよ。\n酒瓶を山ほど持って。: I just went to the Emperor's private chambers. He's got a mountain of wine bottles.
m200384.ああ、せめて恋くらいしてから死にたかった。\n軍人になった以上望めないことだけど: Ah, I wish I could at least die after falling in love… But as a soldier, that's not something I can hope for!
m200384.ああ、つまり黒炎も斬ってしまえばいいと。\n単純で助かりますね。: Ah, so we just cut the black flame itself. Simple and helpful.
m200384.ああ、どうだ、冥界への土産話ができただろう。\nだから、今度こそ、安心して逝って: Yeah, now you've got a tale to bring back to the Underworld. So this time, go peacefully…
m200384.ああ、もう……。\nあったま来た……鬼を……怒らせたな……。: Ugh… I'm getting heated… I shouldn't have angered that demon…
m200384.ああ、オークは戦いに生き、戦いに死ぬ誇り高き種族。\n連中の死に花、見届けてやら: Yes. Orcs live for battle and die with pride. We must witness their death-blossoms.
m200384.ああ、屈辱を忘れぬ獣人の新たな姫よ。\nさて、そろそろ包囲も完了する頃だ。\n―: Ah, the new beast-folk princess who won't forget her humiliation. The encirclement is nearly complete. —Let the battle begin.
m200384.ああ、帝国式魔導砲の情報、大儀である。\n我が配下であれば褒美を与えるところだが: Ah, the info on the Imperial magical cannon is most useful. I'd reward you if you were my subordinate—but—
m200384.ああ、無論最終目標はハイドースの首だが、\nそのために帝国軍人や、\n協働する王: Of course the ultimate goal is Hydros' head, but I have no intention of sacrificing Imperial soldiers or our allied Kingdom troops for it.
m200384.ああ、白の皇帝の生き血で真っ赤に磨いておいてやろう。\n――さて、そろそろ、か。: Yeah, I'll polish it bright red with the White Emperor's own blood. — Well then, it's about time.
m200384.ああ、頼まれたとも。\n無論全力で断ってやったけれどね！: Yeah, they asked me. Of course I turned them down flat-out!
m200384.ああ。\n――死した後、魂となって冥界でまた会おう。: Yes. ――After death, we'll meet again as souls in the Netherworld.
m200384.ああ。こちらの手の内も明かしてしまった以上、\n次からの攻勢はより過酷なものとな: Right. Since we've revealed our hand, the next offensive will be even harsher.
m200384.ああ。幕引きをすべきは、俺じゃない。\n……帰ってこい、戦友。:
Yeah. It isn't my job to pull the curtain.
…Come back, comrades.
m200384.ああ。現状で最も危険な状態にあるのは、\n黒の軍団を任せていた私の部下、マレブラ: The most perilous case right now is my subordinate, Mare Blanc, who was in charge of the Black Legion.
m200384.あいつが物質界のオーク、\nそのすべてを束ねる長、オークロードってわけか……。:
So that guy is the Orc of the material world,
the one who unites them all, the Orc Lord...
m200384.あいつは根っからの戦闘狂だ。\n強者と戦うのが、楽しくて楽しくて仕方ない類のな。: He's a born battle maniac. He just loves fighting strong opponents—can't get enough of it.
m200384.あいつらは、千年の間先祖が守ってきた土地を、\n白の帝国に奪われ、隷従させられた: Those folk had their ancestral lands guarded for a thousand years, only to have the White Empire seize them and force them into servitude.
m200384.あたしには、あいつらの考えてることが分かるよ。\n連中もあたしも、どこまで行って: I can read their thoughts. They're warriors, just like me, no matter how far we go.
m200384.あたしはね、じめじめしたのは嫌いなんだ。\n過去の遺恨、大義、友のための戦い、大: I hate anything damp and soggy. Past grudges, noble causes, battles for friends—bring it on.
m200384.あちらも、きっとそれと同じ問いを、\nベラート伯爵にしたことだろう。: They probably asked the same question of you, Count Belart, over there.
m200384.あっ……あぁ、もうっ！\n考えなしに最前線に……！: Ah… ugh, geez! Jumping into the front line without thinking…!
m200384.あっ……言われてみれば、確かに……？\nでも、どうしてか反逆しようとか思わなかっ: Ah… now that you mention it, yeah… But I never felt like rebelling.
m200384.あっ、あの、なぜ抱っこを……？\nでも……はい、ありがとうございます。\nちょっ:
Ah, um, why are you holding me…? But… thank you.
I feel a bit calmer now.
m200384.あっ、そっか、そうだよね！\nあはは、やっぱ故郷は守らないとだしね！: Oh, right, that makes sense! Haha, we've got to protect our hometown after all!
m200384.あっ、な、ないですー。\nど、どうしよう、本当に王子様が現れてしまった……！: Ah, n-no, I'm fine… Wh-what do I do? The prince actually showed up…!
m200384.あとは今の世を生きる……お前たちの役目だ……。\n存分に戦え、戦って、戦って、名: The rest is up to you… your part in this age… Fight to your heart's content, fight, fight, and meet a glorious death. …I'll be waiting in the Underworld for the stories you bring back.
m200384.あなた、さっきの……。\n撤退したと思っていたけど、\n今度は妨害してくるなんて: You, earlier... I thought you were retreating, but now you're interfering—what's your intention?
m200384.あなたが、獣人の誇りと尊厳ではなく、\n人間と手を取り合うことなんて、選んだから: You chose to set aside beast-folk pride and dignity, and side with humans…!
m200384.あなたという人は……。\n――全軍、心して聞け！\n伝令はすべての前線へ伝えよ！:
You, Angeline…
—All forces, listen up!
Relay this to every front line!
m200384.あなたの怒りは理解できます。\n私がそれだけのことをした、その事実も分かっていま: I understand your anger. I know the facts of what I did.
m200384.あなたも、相変わらずご自身の創造物に冷たいようだ。\n見捨てていった騎士にかける:
You too, still cold toward your own creations.
The words you offer the abandoned knight are proof of that.
m200384.あの場は、戦士としてのあの男に譲っただけだ。\nかの王が帝国に道を開けたなら、\:
I left that spot to the warrior that man was.
If that king opened a path for the Empire, then as a knight it's against my code to overturn it.
m200384.あの女には、我が主は殺させない。\nあなたの真意を問うのも、あなたに何故と問うの: That woman will never be allowed to kill my master. Questioning your true intent, questioning why you… taking your life… are all rights I alone possess.
m200384.あの拠点を潰さないと、こちらの展開も難しい。\n敵の支配力を削るためにも、\n敵:
If we don't destroy that stronghold, our own deployment will be difficult.
To weaken their control, let's prioritize taking out their bases.
m200384.あの軍艦……まずいな、大砲が陸を向いてやがる。\n王子、あいつら上陸前にぶっ放し: That warship… this is bad, its cannons are pointing toward the shore. Prince, they'll fire before they even land!
m200384.あはは、そんなこと言って、\nレオラっち辺りに言い含められたんでしょ？: Ahaha, you're saying that because Leola told you to?
m200384.あら、それくらい鎮められなくて何が皇帝なのかしら。\n早く目を覚まして、\n帝国: Oh, if you can't even calm that much, what makes you an emperor? Wake up quickly, and show them that the empire's greatest power lies here.
m200384.あら、それは分かっていたことよ？\nかつての白の王国を取り戻そうだなんて、\n貴: Oh, you knew that, didn't you? Wanting to restore the old White Kingdom is like sweet honey to the nobles.
m200384.あら、大牛と子猫の間違いじゃない？: Oh, perhaps you mean a bull and a kitten?
m200384.あれが帝国の援軍なのだとしたら、\nなぜ海から……それにあの軍艦、\n軍旗を掲げ: If that's the Empire's reinforcements, why are they coming from the sea… and that ship doesn't even have a battle flag.
m200384.あれが物質界のオークの長、オークロードか。\n魔界のオークとは、やっぱり考え方が:
So that's the material-world Orc leader, the Orc Lord.
The demonic Orcs are really a different breed.
m200384.あれが話に聞いた帝国の新兵器、か……。\n敵兵力の把握は十分だ、戦線を下げろ！！: So that's the Imperial new weapon they've been talking about… Our intel on enemy forces is solid, fall back!!

After taking that kind of attack, how can they keep moving…?
They should've fallen countless times by now.

Most likely they're using the Netherworld Gate to travel far away.

m200384.あんなので焼き払われたら、\n簡単に陣地を占拠されちゃうわ。\nセグナンドを放置: If that burns everything, we'll lose the field in an instant. Leaving Segnand unattended is too dangerous!

m200384.いいえ、届きます。\nこうして、言葉を交わしてくれています。: No, they do. You're speaking to me now.

m200384.いいでしょう。\n見捨てたつもりはないけれど、\nその感情くらいは受け止めてあげ: Fine. I'm not abandoning you, but I'll at least acknowledge those feelings.
m200384.いいのかベラート伯爵。\nそのすり潰される軍は\nお前のかつての同胞たちだろう？: Orc Lord —Is that alright, Count Belart? The army you'll crush were once your own comrades, weren't they?
m200384.いいや、あいつは死に場所を決めたんだ。\n傷なんて、もはや勲章が\n増えたくらい: No, he's chosen his place to die. He probably sees those wounds as nothing more than extra medals.
m200384.いいや、アタシも頑張らないとなって思っただけ！\nさぁ怪我人を運ぶよ！ 手を貸し: Never mind, I just thought I should do my part too! Come on, let's move the wounded. Give me a hand!
m200384.いえ、まるで微笑んでいるように見えましたので。: No, you just seemed to be smiling.
m200384.いえ、もうひとつ。\nつい先ほど、王国のシノビより、\nこれより王国軍が駆けつけ:

Just now, a messenger from the Kingdom's shinobi reported that the kingdom's troops are on their way.
m200384.いえ、遠慮しておきましょう。\n我が使命はただひとつ、\n彼に「世界を頼む」と託: ???: No, I'll decline. My sole mission is that I've been entrusted to ask him to “take care of the world.”
m200384.いえね、ベラート伯爵についたのは、\n果たして、伯爵領の兵だけだったのだろうか、: No, I'm wondering whether only the Count's own troops were attached to him.
m200384.いつだってちびっこのため、\n放っておいたら、誰も助けてくれない場所に\n行って: He's always fought for the little ones, to shine a light on those who'd end up in places no one would help them if left alone!
m200384.いま一度、子孫らのために、\n国を取り戻す戦いに駆けつけたいと。: They want, once more, to rush to the fight to reclaim the country for their descendants.
m200384.いま一度、次は人の子らを救うため、\n神に抗う力を残すために捧げるのも、\n女神: Once more, to save those children and leave a power that defies the gods—that's the proper path for a goddess.
m200384.いや、そこまで酷い言い方はしてないぞ団長！\nただ、神の力の扱いに関しては\n王: No, that's a bit harsh, Captain! It's just that the kingdom is already ahead when it comes to handling divine power, so it'd be convenient—!
m200384.いや、その被害は、祖国を思う者たちの血そのものだ。\n被害を忘れてはならないが、: No, that loss is the very blood of those who love their homeland. We must not forget the damage, but we also must not be ashamed of the blood that's been spilled.
m200384.いや、勇者とはあくまで旗印に過ぎない。\n戦働きを見届け、その死に様を看取り、\: No, a hero is merely a banner. The true strongest are those who witness the battle, see its end, and guide that soul toward a shared, shining triumph.
m200384.いや、進軍を止めるな。: No, do not halt the advance.
m200384.いやいや、ここは千年戦争の後、\n人類同士が殺し合った、戦乱の時代の古戦場ですぞ: No, no. This is a battlefield from the age of strife after the Millennium War, when humanity turned on each other.
m200384.いやいや、戦えるんだから戦闘員さ、トゥーダ。\n神官戦士殿直々に、ちゃんと訓練も: No, no, Tuda, you're a combatant because you can fight. You've been properly trained by the priest-knight himself, after all.
m200384.いやいや、私はあくまで同盟者ですからな。\n褒美は最前線で戦った、\n獣人、オー: No, no, I'm merely an ally. The reward should go to the beastmen, orcs, and underworld soldiers who fought on the front lines.
m200384.うっさい黙れッ！\n鬼は最強なんだ！ 思い知れクロコー！！: Shut up! Demons are the strongest! Take that, Croco!!
m200384.うむ……感謝しておるぞ、冥界の亜神よ。\n――しかし、まさかわしを選ぶとは、\n: Hmm… I thank you, demigod of the underworld. —But choosing this path… I don't quite understand the reason.
m200384.うむっ、実に竜人らしい！\nこれで、わしも大往生できるというものよ！:
Indeed, truly dragon-like!
Now I can finally meet my end peacefully!
m200384.うむッ、見事な戦いぶりであるッ！\n白の帝国を相手どり、よくぞ戦い抜いたッ！！: Indeed, a splendid battle! Facing the White Empire, you fought through to the very end!!
m200384.うわぁ、すごい満足そう。\n――それより、そろそろ敵が追いついてくる頃だよ。\n: Wow, you look so satisfied. —Anyway, the enemies should be catching up soon. Keep your guard up!
m200384.うん、そうだね。\n……あの人が守りたいと思うものを、\n今この場所で守れるのは:
Yeah, that's true.
...We're the only ones who can protect what she wants to protect right here, right now.
m200384.うん、国のためでも、種族のためでもない。\nあたしの金棒は、目の前で命を奪わせな: Yeah, it's not for the country or any race. My club exists to stop lives from being taken right in front of me!
m200384.うん、私の予想が正しければ――: Yeah, if my guess is right—
m200384.うんうん、これでよし。\n人の子の友情は、なんと尊きものなのだろう。: Yep, that's settled. The friendship of children is truly a precious thing.
m200384.うんうん、だよねー。\nでも、雲ひとつないこの空に、\n何かが飛んでいる気配はな:
Yeah, yeah, exactly.
But in this perfectly clear sky, I don't feel anything flying around…
m200384.うんうん、パーフェクトだ。\nでは、それを踏まえて帝国軍が次に打つべき一手は何か:
Yeah, yeah, perfect.
So, based on that, what should the Imperial army's next move be?
m200384.えぇ、そのとおりです。\nシャディアは申し訳無さそうな顔をしますが、\nその表情:
Yes, exactly.
Shadia may wear an apologetic face, but whenever I see that expression, I tug at her cheek.
m200384.えぇ、それでは楽しい山越えの時間、ですね。\n各員、吹雪ではぐれないよう、連絡を: Ah, so it'll be a fun little mountain-crossing, huh? Everyone, keep in close contact so we don't get lost in the blizzard!
m200384.えぇ、でも、間違えたままであっても、\n勝利は勝利、解放は解放に違いない。: Yes, but even if we're wrong, victory is still victory, liberation still liberation.
m200384.えぇ、エスネアも元気で……。\nそ、それよりクロコさまがご無事で、本当に良かった: Yes, Esnea's fine too… But more importantly, I'm relieved you're safe, Croco! Could this place perhaps be… a reinforcement for us?
m200384.えぇ、人間にしておくには惜しい戦士ばかり――と、\nセグナンド様、何か良いことで: Ah, they're warriors too fine for mere humans—so, Lord Segnand, any good news?
m200384.えぇ、今は国内に戦力を割く余裕が惜しい……。\n冥界への遠征を本格化することを考: Yes, we can't spare any forces at home right now… If we fully launch an expedition to the Underworld, this could become a clear weakness of the empire.
m200384.えぇ、今も存在しているだけで精一杯。\n魔王との決戦で、本当にすべての力を注ぎま: Well, just existing is a struggle enough. I poured everything into the final battle against the Demon King.
m200384.えぇ、以前冥界の門が開いた時より、\nむしろ安定しているくらいですな。: Yes, they're even more stable than when the Gate of the Underworld opened before.
m200384.えぇ、力のほとんどを失い、\n肉体まで失ったがために、\nしばらく目を覚ますこと: Right. She's lost most of her power and even her body, so she probably won't awaken for a while.
m200384.えぇ、子爵、あなたも。\nしかし驚きましたわ。\n誰よりも忠義を重んじるあなたが:
Indeed, Count, you as well.
But I'm surprised.
To think someone who values loyalty above all would stand on that side.
m200384.えぇ、完璧かと。\nただ、時が時ならば、\n革命の戦火が巻き起こりそうな演説でし: Yes, it's perfect. Though, if the timing's right, it sounds like a speech that could spark the flames of revolution.
m200384.えぇ、必ず。\nそれでは先代、おさらばです。:
Yes, I will.
Then, predecessor, farewell.
m200384.えぇ、感情にまかせて焦るなんて、\nレオナちゃんらしくないわ♪: Yeah, panicking on emotion isn't like you at all ♪
m200384.えぇ、私も同意見よ。\nけれどそれは、今ではないの。:
Yes, I agree.
But not now.
m200384.えぇっ！？ まだ起動試験も終わってないんですよ！？: What!? We haven't even finished the activation test yet!?
m200384.えぇっ！？ わ、私！？\n次に帝国が打つべき一手、か……。:
Wh-what!? Me?!
The next move the Empire should make, huh…?
m200384.えぇと、格納庫みたいな箱を積んだ、\n大型の飛空戦艦だったかと……。\nそれから: Um, they were large air-battle ships carrying something like a hangar… and they had a bunch of cannons!
m200384.えぇー、マルレーン寝相悪いしなぁ。: Ehh—Marleen, your sleeping habits are terrible.
m200384.えっ……あ、アタシなにかやっちゃったのか……？: Huh… Did I do something wrong…?
m200384.えっ……えぇと、分かった。\nでも砕けた剣なんて、いったい何に使うんだ。:
Eh… um, okay.
But what on earth will we do with a shattered sword?
m200384.お、親父！？ いったいどこから！？: Oh, father!? Where on earth did you come from!?
m200384.おい、それより連中の数の方が問題だ。\nあれはどう見ても正規兵の軍だ。\n部隊単:
Hey, the numbers are the real problem.
Those look like regular troops no matter how you slice it.
Units moving in formation are scary, huh?

m200384.おいおい、ヘカティエ、勘違いしてねぇか？\nオレが守るべき法とは、冥界のそれだ。: Hey, Hecatie, are you misunderstanding? The law I protect is the law of the Underworld.
m200384.おいおい、突っ込んでくるぞ！\n本当にあれが亜神の戦い方かよ！: Hey, hey, it's charging at us! Is that really how a demigod fights!?
m200384.おいヘカティエ、てめぇに止める権利はねぇだろ。\nこいつはオレの領地で勝手に戦っ: Hey Hecatie, you've got no right to stop this. This is my territory, I fought here on my own. I attacked my own prey.
m200384.おい女ァ！\nオレの言葉を遮った罪は重いぜ。\nこのラビリス様の言葉をなァ！！: Hey, woman! Cutting me off is a serious offense. Hear the words of Labrys, the great Labrys!!
m200384.おぉ……アンジェリーネ様。\nご機嫌麗しゅう。: Ah… Lady Angeline. You're in fine spirits.
m200384.おぉ、ありがたい……！\n白の王国を想う者たちよ！ 今は撤退の時だ！:
Oh, thank you…!
Those who cherish the White Kingdom! Now is the time to retreat!
m200384.おぉ、おぉ……！\n我らが先達が、白の王国の戦士たちが……！！: Oh, oh…! Our predecessors, the warriors of the White Kingdom…!!
m200384.おぉ、おぉ、メリュジアナよ。\n実に懐かしいのう。\nさぁ、もっとよく顔を見せて:
Oh, oh, Meliusiana.
It's truly nostalgic.
Now, show us your face a little more.
m200384.おぉ、おぉ、殺人機械の――こほん、\nこれは失礼な呼び名ですな。\nルイン嬢、ご: Oh, oh, “murder machine”—ahem—what a rude nickname. Miss Ruin, glad to see you in fine health.
m200384.おぉ、おぉ！\n先代、再びお会いできる日が来るとは……！！: Oh! Oh! To think the previous generation would return…!!
m200384.おぉ、おぉ！ 兵たちよ、見よ！\n伯爵殿が最前線に、我らと共に立つぞ！: Oh, oh! Soldiers, look! The Count leads the front, standing with us!
m200384.おぉ、セグナンド殿。\nはて……どうでしょうな……。: Ah, Lord Segnand. Hmm… I wonder…
m200384.おぉ、ハイドース殿。\nお見苦しいところを見せてしまいましたな。: Ah, Lord Hydros. I've shown you a sorry sight, haven't I?
m200384.おぉおぉ、ここから見えるだけでも\nなかなかの大軍勢だ。: Whoa, just seeing it from here—what a massive army.
m200384.おお、ハイドース様の小間使いか。\nワシらの戦いぶり、どうかあの御方に伝えてくれ:
Ah, a servant of Lord Haidos, huh?
Tell that one how we fought.
m200384.おっけーまかせて。\nはぁ、穴埋め大変だなぁ！\nさっそくいってきまーす！: Got it, leave it to me. Phew, filling the gaps is tough! I'm off right away!
m200384.おっと、それは違うぞ陛下。\nサザンカは決して、帝国のためには戦っていない。: Hold on, that's not right, Your Highness. Sasanqua never fought for the Empire's sake.
m200384.おっ待たせしましたー！\n帝国軍掘削部隊、冥界にトンネルぶち抜いてきました！:
Sorry to keep you waiting!
The Imperial drilling unit has punched a tunnel straight into the Underworld!
m200384.おふたりは、強すぎます。\nですが私とて、黒き竜人族の長。\n――この血に恥じぬ: You two are far too strong. Still, I am also the chief of the black draconians—let us fight in a way that does no shame to this blood.
m200384.おまかせあれ。\n私の王子様を呼んでこよう♪:
Consider it done.
I'll go summon my Prince♪
m200384.おや、お褒めに預かり恐悦至極。\n今の喜びをパーセントで表そうか？:
Oh, I'm deeply honored by your praise.
Shall I express my current joy in percentages?
m200384.おやアブグルント。……前線による、かな。\n総じて言えばこちらの方が押されている:
Oh, Abgrund… It's about the frontline, I suppose.
Overall we're being pressed, but that's part of the plan.
m200384.お久しぶりです、墓守のリッチさん。\nお騒がせしてすみません。: Long time no see, Lich, the tomb keeper. Sorry for the disturbance.
m200384.お前が望むのなら、我はお前にも、\n帝国に棲まう獣人にも手を差し伸べよう。: If that's what you desire, I'll offer my hand to you, and to the beast-folk living within the Empire.
m200384.かつてこの地を守った戦士たちよ。\n王子、絶対に気を抜かないようにね。:
Warriors who once defended these lands.
Prince, never let your guard down.
m200384.き、騎兵その２……ひひーん……っ！\n皆さん大丈夫ですか！？\n増援部隊、ただい:
C-Cavalry #2… hiiiin…!
Is everyone alright?!
Reinforcement units have just arrived…!
m200384.くそっ、砲弾が痛ェ！\nオレの領地に何しやがる！？: Damn, those shells hurt! What the hell are you doing in my territory!?
m200384.くっ……なんという力だ……。\nまさかオークでない者に、これ程の使い手がいたとは:
Damn… what power….
I never imagined someone not an Orc could wield such skill.

m200384.くっ……敵の数が多すぎるか。\n仕方ない、これは切り札だったが……。: Damn… there are too many enemies. Guess I'll have to use my trump card after all…
m200384.けっ……戦士が息子に死を看取られるなんざ、\n全然嬉しくないだろうが……。: Hmph… A warrior having his son watch his death isn't exactly something to rejoice about…
m200384.けれど、ここで力を与えなければ、\nあなた方の信仰に対して不誠実ではありませんか: But if I don't lend my power here, wouldn't that be a betrayal of your faith?
m200384.けれど、この地は創造神が物質界の民に与えたもの。\n神々の争いで、奪い合うような: But this land was given to the material world by the Creator God. It's not something to be seized in the gods' wars.
m200384.こ、この黒炎は……まさか亜神ハイドース様の……？: Th-this black flame… could it be… the divine Haidōs himself…?

This is the underworld, huh.
...It's not as bad as I thought.
m200384.ここで、あなたに立ちはだかる全ての力は、\n人が亜神に抗わんとする、\nその意志:
All the power that stands before you now
was seized by humanity's will to defy a demigod,
the very result of that resolve.
m200384.ここで、己が信徒と共に冥界の黒炎に焼かれるがいい！\n精神体の一欠片まで消え去れ:
Here, be consumed by the black flames of the underworld alongside your followers!
Let even a fragment of your spirit be erased, goddess Adamas—!!
m200384.ここで追撃をすれば、その部隊は残らず返り討ちにあうぞ。\n……今回は、痛み分けだ:
If we chase them now, that unit will be completely wiped out.
…So this time, we share the pain.
m200384.ここは複数の街道の交差点だからね。\n地形的にも、西から帝都へ入るためには、\n: It sits at the crossroads of several roads. Geographically, anyone heading west toward the Imperial Capital has to pass through here.
m200384.ここまでは上手く潜入できましたけど……。\nうぅ、さっきより敵が増えてますし、\: We managed to infiltrate this far… but the enemy numbers have swelled since earlier, and it looks like we can't avoid a fight…
m200384.こちらの兵を展開できる隙間ができたのだから、\nここからは反撃、というわけだよお: Now that we have a gap to deploy our troops, it's time for a counter-attack, my lady.
m200384.こちらの戦力も、随分と失われてしまった。\n此度の戦、勝利したとしても、\n我が: Our forces have been greatly diminished. Even if we win this battle, our lands will suffer a severe blow.
m200384.このためって、いったいどういうことなの！？\nこんな所に大穴開けたって何も……。:
What do you mean “for this”!?
Why dig a massive hole here…
m200384.この地が冥界に最も近い場所である理由、\n数多の戦士が眠る場所である理由、\nそ: The reason this place is closest to the Underworld, the reason countless warriors lie here, and why resentment still swirls…
m200384.この地で、いったい何が……？\n冥界の門が開いた正式な記録は、\n白の帝国にはな: What on earth is happening here…? There should've been no official record of the Underworld Gate opening in the White Empire…
m200384.この戦いは帝国が背負うべきもの。\nされど、民に血を流させるわけにはいかない。: This battle is the empire's burden. But we can't have the people shedding blood.
m200384.この戦は白の帝国の内乱であり、\n同時に亜神との戦いでもある、ということか。\n:
So this battle is a civil war within the White Empire, and at the same time a fight against a demigod, huh.
There's some truth to that, but…
m200384.この砦は帝都に至る街道の、守りの要だ。\n「城門」も強固な防御力を誇っているが、: This fortress is the key defense on the road to the Imperial Capital. The “gate” boasts solid defenses, but even so, nothing's foolproof in battle.
m200384.この都市には、古くから住まう者もいれば、\n航海の果てに住み着いた者たちもいる。: In this city, there are those who have lived here since ancient times, those who settled here after voyages across the seas, and those we have annexed through war.
m200384.こら、無駄口を叩かない。\n周辺警戒を厳となせと言われたばかりだろう？: Hey, stop spouting nonsense. Didn't you just get told to keep a tight watch on the surroundings?
m200384.こらこら、喧嘩は戦闘が終わってからだよレディたち。\nさぁ、襲撃が止まった今の内:
Hey now, the fighting's over before you start bickering, ladies.
Now, while the raid's halted!
Let's hurry and finish resupplying!
m200384.こらっ、また起きてきたな！？\n前線は王子たちに任せたまえ。\nサザンカはよく戦: Hey, you're up again!? Leave the front lines to the princes. Sasanqua, you fought well.
m200384.これが我が覇道の行き着く先、\n我が血を継ぐ帝国軍の、当代の姿だというのか。:

m200384.そんな存在のために、命を賭してでも\n勝利への礎となることを決めた者。\nそれこ: Those who, even at the cost of their lives, become the foundation of victory for such souls—that is who the battlefield's strongest truly are.
m200384.そんな泣き顔で何が誇りか。\n何が獣人の尊厳か。: What pride can you claim with that crying face? What dignity of a beast-folk is that?

m200384.だからこその、強固な城門と、\n強固……だった城壁なんだよね。: That's why it has such a solid gate… and, well, solid… walls.

But even so…

m200384.だが、それでも立ち上がらんとするならば、\nリンクスよ、そしてその兵たちよ、\n: Still, if you rise up, Lynx, and your troops, you'll become my finest comrades.

m200384.だが、一度の砲撃ごとに魔導機関の冷却が必要となる。\n連射はできないから、使い所: But each shot requires the magical engine to cool down, so we can't fire repeatedly. Use it wisely.

m200384.だが、指揮官が前線に並び立つことの心強さは、\n俺たちも十分に理解していることだ: Still, we all understand how reassuring it is when a commander stands on the front lines.
m200384.だが、死ぬために戦うな。\n……親父殿に誇れるような死に方をしろ。: ???: But don't fight just to die. …Die in a way that would make your father proud.
m200384.だが、限りがあると分かれば戦いようもある。\n手の内の分からない敵ではないのだか: But once we know there's a limit, we have a way to fight. It's not an unknown enemy, so we can just kick them aside as we always have.
m200384.だが、願いのために犠牲は必要なのだ。\nその願いを阻まんとする者がいる限り。\n:

As long as there are those who would block that wish, we must fight.
m200384.だが獣人と冥界人の部隊だけで、\n帝国を攻め滅ぼすつもりでもあるまい。\n後に控: But with just beastfolk and Netherworld units, we can't expect to crush the Empire. I wonder what's next.

Hey! What can I possibly—

But I'm here.

m200384.でも、あの飛空戦艦はまだまだ試作段階。\n飛行時間はごく限られているはずよ。: But that airship is still in the prototype stage. Its flight time should be very limited.
m200384.でも、そのおかげで砦に侵入した敵はいないわ。\nさすがはガオレオンの血を引く戦士: But thanks to that, no enemy has managed to breach the fortress. I guess you could say you're a warrior with Gaoreon's blood.

m200384.でも、負傷者も増え始めている。\nこのまま戦いが進めば、\nいずれこちらの戦力で: But the wounded are starting to pile up. If the battle keeps going like this, we'll eventually crush them with our own forces.

m200384.というわけだから、王子っ！\nこれからよろしくねっ！: So, Prince! From now on, count on me!

m200384.どうした、貴様にも覚えがあるような口ぶりだが。: How dare you speak as if you remember me, huh?

m200384.どうやら、新型兵器の\n出撃を防ぐことができたようですね。: It seems we've managed to prevent the launch of the new weapon.

Looks like we made it in time.

Our airship warship! …Eject… Eject now!!

m200384.なっ……しかし！\n仇は目前に……！！: Huh… but! The enemy is right in front of us…!!

What's this, a huge hole in the ground—
Aaaah!??
m200384.ならば、それまで付き合うとしようか。\n我が友サザンカよ。: Then let's stick together until then, my friend Sasanqua.

m200384.ならば、白の帝国が危機にある今、\n私がなすべきことはひとつだけ……。: So, with the White Empire now in crisis, there is only one thing I must do…

Then don't disgrace the nobles of the White Kingdom.
Tell us which side should break through head-on and protect the people.

Then I'll take you up on the invitation.
It's been a while since we've faced each other on the front lines.

I see… a friend on the enemy side…
That must be hard for you, miss.

m200384.なれば、我ガ望みヲ叶える時マデ、\nその威、存分ニ利用させテもらうとしヨウ！: Then, until the moment my wish is fulfilled, I'll make full use of that power!

My body feels heavy...

Hah… You heard that conversation just now, didn't you?
That little girl making that face—here, take this!  Take this!

m200384.はぁ……勝ちは勝ちだよ。\nなに痛み分けみたいな顔してるのさ。: Hah… a win's a win. Why the sour face?

m200384.はぁ……国がどうとか、種族がどうとか、\nほんとよくやるよね、みんな。: Sigh… the nation, the race… they really get away with it, don't they?

m200384.はぁっ、はぁ……っ！\nラウラ！ 陛下はどこに！？: Haa… haa…! Laura! Where is His Majesty?!

Far from resenting, the way the predecessor died is a laughing matter.

Georg, what do you think?

m200384.ふふ、そうね。\nこれはまだ、こちらの作戦の範疇。: Heh, indeed. It's still within the scope of our plan.
m200384.ふふ、大いに悩み給え、若人よ。\nどれだけ悩もうと、私たちが今できるのは、\nこ:
