m200384.ほう、クロコ殿の口からそんな言葉が出るとはな。: Segnand —Huh, coming from Lord Croco, such words.
m200384.まぁ、そういう態度は嫌いではないけれど……。\nディアナ、兵たちに伝えておくとい: Well, I don't dislike that attitude… Diana, you should let the troops know: the Netherworld army has unleashed its monsters.
m200384.まぁ、不安がっていても仕方がない。\n今は背後の街を守ることに集中しよう。\n美:
Well, worrying won't help.
Now let's focus on defending the town behind us.
For the sake of the beautiful maidens' friendship!
m200384.まぁいいじゃないの♪\n初めての、小さな勝利の第一歩を刻んだんだから♪: Well, it's fine♪ It's the first little victory, after all♪
m200384.まぁいいわ。私が直接戦場に出て、\n王子とやらを叩き潰せばいいだけよ。: Fine. I'll just go onto the battlefield myself and crush that so-called Prince.
m200384.まぁね、これは帝国が受け止めなければならない、\n帝国がなしてきた事の終着点なん:
Indeed, this is the culmination of what the Empire must face, what the Empire has done.
The price is… quite heavy.
m200384.ましてや、神のために数多の生贄を――: Moreover, for the sake of the gods, countless sacrifices—
m200384.まずいわね……。\nこちらの航空戦力は分散しているわ。\n一点突破で戦力を投入さ: This is bad… Our aerial forces are scattered. If they concentrate a strike on a single point—
m200384.まだ喚び出すの……！？\nはぁ、やるしかないわね……！:
We're still calling them out…!?
Sigh, I guess we have no choice…!
m200384.まだ遠方だからこそ少数に見えますが、\n実際にはあの集団ひとつひとつが、\n冥界: Because they're far away, they seem few, but each of those groups is actually an elite Netherworld unit…
m200384.まったく、あの男は……。\n為政者というものは、\nこういう時、責任を取るために: Honestly, that man… A ruler is supposed to take responsibility in times like these.
m200384.まったく、そのとおりです。\n亜神如きに後れを取っているようでは、\n革命のし甲: Indeed, exactly. If we fall behind beings like demigods, there'll be no point in a revolution.
m200384.まったく、そんなことだろうと思ったよ。\nマルレーンったら、軍に入ってから\n一: I knew it, I just knew it. Marleen never even went home once after joining the army—
m200384.まったく、戦う理由が分からないと言いながら、\n真っ先に敵陣に突っ込んでいくんだ: Honestly, you claim you don't know why you fight, yet you're the first to charge straight into the enemy lines. I'm impressed.
m200384.まったくです。\nとはいえ、あの背中を見ているからこそ、\n兵たちが奮い立つとい: Exactly. Still, seeing his back does fire up the troops.
m200384.む……おぉ、騎士殿か。\nなに、帝国軍に一泡吹かせてやろうかと思ってな。: Hm… Ah, Sir Knight. So, you thinking of giving the Imperial army a taste of their own medicine?
m200384.むしろ、実力主義などというその詭弁が、\n我ら白の王国貴族の誇りをどれほど貶めた: On the contrary, that sophistry of meritocracy has utterly tarnished the pride of our White Kingdom nobles!
m200384.むしろあいつこそ、\n白の帝国のやり方にふさわしい人材だろう。: In fact, he's exactly the kind of person the White Empire needs.
m200384.むっ……あれは闇水晶かな……？\nリンクス嬢から感じる力が、\n急速に増大してい: Huh… is that a dark crystal? The power I feel from Miss Lynx is rapidly intensifying.
m200384.むっ……童顔って言いたいのかー！？: Huh… are you calling me baby-faced!?
m200384.むむ……ごまかされませんよ？\n――ともあれ、これでこの砦は大丈夫そうですね。:
Hmph… You can't fool me.
—Anyway, it looks like this fortress will hold.
m200384.もう一発行くか？\nそれともすり潰されるのが好みか？\n可愛い顔にお化粧してやる: Want another go? Or do you prefer being ground to dust? I'll paint a cute little face on you, come on!!
m200384.もう一箇所の襲撃地点……。\nあちらも無事だと良いんだけど……。:
Another attack point…
I hope they're safe over there as well…
m200384.もっちろん、分かってるって。\nそれよりあの艦隊、沈められないかな？\n上陸前に: Of course I get it. More importantly, can we sink that fleet? If we take them down before they land, it'll be a clean sweep.
m200384.もっと素直に言いな。\n「城門」を破壊されたら、戦士がなだれ込んでくるから、\n: Just say it straight. If the “gate” gets destroyed, warriors will pour in, so we need you to protect it.
m200384.もとより戦闘の発生を踏まえた部隊編成だ。\n王子の指揮があれば、突破も難しくはあ: Our units were already organized with combat in mind. With the Prince's command, breaking through shouldn't be too hard.
m200384.もはや、反乱軍に勝機はない。\n投降すれば極刑は免れるかもしれないぞ。: There's no chance for the rebels now. Surrender, and you might escape the death penalty.
m200384.やっ、やめっ、いだだだだっ！？\n頬をひっぱるにゃっ！:
No, stop, i-i-i-it's—!
You're pulling my cheek!
m200384.やはり来たか……。\nだが、展開が予想より早すぎる。\n敵の指揮官は分かるか？:
So they've finally arrived…
But the development is faster than we expected.
Do we know who the enemy commander is?
m200384.やめなさいッ！！\n女の子の顔を、何だと思ってるの！！: Stop it!! What do you think her face is, a…?
m200384.やらしくありません！\n……あっ、さらに万全を期すなら、\n空からの戦力も考慮に: Not at all! …Ah, if we really want to be thorough, we'll bring in forces from the sky, too.
m200384.やれやれ、しつこいな。\nさすがはベラート伯爵の兵か。: Good grief, they're persistent. As expected of Count Berato's troops.
m200384.やれやれ、そういう気質は獣人ならではか。\nだが、決して引き際を見誤るな。\nま: Good grief, that kind of temperament is typical of beastfolk. But never misjudge the right moment to withdraw. First thing's first: know your enemy.
m200384.ようやく姿を見せたか……。\nいや、待て……なんだ、その姿は。: So you finally show yourself… Wait, what is that form?
m200384.ようやく白の帝国と戦えるってのに、\nそこに水を差すなんざ、\n騎士とは名ばかり: Finally getting to fight the White Empire, and you're pouring water on it—just a thief wearing a knight's title.
m200384.よかろう……。\n失う悲しみならば、我もよく理解できる。:
Very well…
I can understand the sorrow of loss.
m200384.よかろう。\nダークエルフ、竜人の連合をもってなお、\n帝国の防備は万全であった: Very well. Even with the Dark Elf and Dragonfolk alliance, the Empire's defenses remain flawless.
m200384.よく吠えるッ！！\n貴様こそ、力に頼り、力に溺れた俗物だ！:
You bark loudly!!
You're the one who leans on strength, drowning in it, you commoner!
m200384.よく言うわ。\n陛下を殺すなら、今こそ好機だというのに。: Well said. If we're to kill His Majesty, now's the perfect chance.
m200384.よし、陛下に知らせるぞ。\n悩むのは、全部終わらせてからにしよう！:
Alright, I'll inform His Majesty.
Let's finish everything first, then we can worry.
m200384.よろしい。――でも、視野を狭くしないようにね。\nクロコはサンダードレイクを率い: Very well. —But don't let your vision narrow. Croco commands the Thunder Drake. Don't underestimate aerial lightning strikes.
m200384.ん……だって身体が勝手に……。\nなんだか、戦わないといけない気がしたんだよね。: Hmm... my body just does it on its own... I felt like I had to fight.
m200384.ん……判断が早いのは大事なこと。\n戦略を練った上で、状況次第で\nそれをすぐに: Hm… being quick to decide is important. A commander's talent is being able to devise a strategy, then discard it on the fly when the situation calls for it.
m200384.ん……聞いたことが、ある？: Huh... you've actually heard about it?
m200384.アイギス様と同じこと……つまり、\nその肉体を犠牲にして、魔力を得るつもりじゃ―: Doing the same as Aegis… meaning you intend to sacrifice your body to gain magic—
m200384.アタシは、千年戦争で名を馳せた鍛冶神じゃない。\n魔剣を打つような魔力だってない: I'm not the famed forge god of the Millennium War. I don't have the magic needed to forge a demon blade.
m200384.アダマス様より下賜された神器どころではない、\n女神の肉体を魔力として使った、\: This isn't just a divine relic bestowed by Lord Adamas—it's gear forged from the goddess's very flesh as magic, essentially a god-sword…
m200384.アダマス！ 貴様、肉体はどうした！\n何なのだ、その今にもかき消えそうな魔力は！: Adamas! What happened to your body? What is that flickering magic about to vanish?!
m200384.アンジェリーネ様があちらについた以上、\n白の王国を取り戻すのは、\nあなたの背:
Now that Lady Angeline has taken her place over there,
restoring the White Kingdom is
your very own duty…!
m200384.エレオノーラ様。\nということは、ハイドースは\n未だ全力を出すことができない、: Lady Eleonora. So you're saying Haidous hasn't been able to unleash his full power yet?
m200384.オリュンポスに座すあやつのように、\n兵を使い捨てる戦いは、長のするべきことでは: Like those who sit on Olympus, using troops as disposable pawns isn't the way a true leader should fight.
m200384.オレたちに、迷いはない。\n誓いも、後悔もない。\nさぁ、誉れ高き戦いに向かうぞ: We have no doubt. No oath, no regret. Come, let's charge into this glorious battle!!
m200384.オークが戦士としてあるために。: Orc Lord —For the Orcs to be warriors worthy.
m200384.カッカッカ！\n良かろう、この老体の生命の輝き、\n腑抜けた地上の竜人に見せてや:
Ha ha ha!
Very well, let this old man's life shine,
and show those spineless surface dragons!
m200384.カテリナさん、これだけの広域に渡る戦闘です。\n普段とは射程の感覚が違うと思いま: Katerina, this battle spans a huge area. The sense of range is different from usual, so be sure to judge carefully before acting.
m200384.カトリーナ！\n「帝国式魔導砲台」を起動しろ！: Katrina! Activate the Imperial Magic Cannon!
m200384.ガオォォォォッ！\n時代のチャンピオン、王子に言付けを受けてなッ！: GAAAH! The champion of the age, summoned by the Prince himself!
m200384.クク……感情に振り回されぬその意志、気に入ったわ。\n此度の蘇りへの感謝として、: Heh… I like that resolve, unshaken by emotion. As thanks for your resurrection, I'll refrain from probing your true purpose.
m200384.グラティア！？ どうしてこんなところに！\nここは最前線ですよ！！\n非戦闘員は: Gratia!? Why are you here! This is the front line!! Non-combatants, get inside the city walls quickly—
m200384.コノ身も武を志し、大願を成就サセンとスル者。\n今は助力スルのみの立場ダガ、\n: Croco —I, too, aspire to martial greatness and fulfill my grand ambition. Though now I can only aid, I think I understand your feelings.
m200384.サザンカ、君は帝国に恭順した鬼の一族だろう？\nしかも今や、その族長という立場だ: Sasanqua, you're a demon clan that pledged fealty to the Empire, aren't you? And now you're the clan chief.
m200384.サザンカ！ 下がれ！\nあぁもう、怪我してるんだから突っ込むな！: Sasanqua! Step back! Ah, you're injured—don't charge in!
m200384.セグナンド、オークロードを倒さねば、\n各地の解放は難しいかと……。: Unless we defeat the Orc Lord at Segnand, freeing the regions will be difficult…
m200384.セグナンドの戦法に振り回されるな。\n奴は神出鬼没に戦場を駆け、\nこちらの陣地:
Don't be fooled by Segnand's tactics.
He'll appear and disappear, seizing our positions at will.
m200384.セグナンド様、それはいったいどういう……。: Dark Elf —Segnand-sama, what on earth does that…?
m200384.ダークエルフの誇りを、取り戻すために。: Segnand —To reclaim the Dark Elf's pride.
m200384.ディアナ様、敵の采配が分かるのですか？: Lady Diana, can you read the enemy's tactics?
m200384.ハイデマリー、お前は直接、\n最前線で骸帝と対峙したな。: Heidemarie, you faced the Bone Emperor head-on on the front lines.
m200384.ハイドースめ、さすがは冥界の亜神か。\n戦士の心を滾らせる方法を熟知しているよう:
Hydros, as expected of a demigod of the Underworld.
Seems you know exactly how to set a warrior's heart ablaze.
m200384.ハイドース様、冥界の力をお借りします。: Hydos, lend me the power of the Netherworld.
m200384.ハイドース様に、\nオレを連れ戻すよう、言われたのだろう……？: You were told by High Duse to bring me back, weren't you?
m200384.ハイドース様の力のひとかけらくらい、\n授かっていると考えた方がいいわね。\n例: We should assume they've been granted even a fragment of Lord Haidōs's power. For example… yes, a black flame, perhaps?
m200384.ハイドース様の反魂の術……？\nいえ、そんな魔力は感じなかった。\nそれなのに、: Hydros' soul-restoring technique…? No, I didn't feel that kind of magic. Yet this pressure… this soul's force—
m200384.ハイドース様の宿願、虐げられし友の悲願、\nそして我らが父祖の怒り！\nそれらを: Lord Hydo's lifelong wish, the oppressed friends' yearning, and our ancestors' wrath! To fulfill them, we must retreat now!
m200384.ハイドース様の無念、宿怨も、\n此度の戦にて晴らすことができるでしょう。: Your grief and lingering hatred, Hydos, can finally be settled on this battlefield.
m200384.ハイドース様は、全軍に冥界への撤退を命じた。\n……命を捨てる必要はない。\nこ: ???: Lord Haidos has ordered a full retreat to the Netherworld. …You don't need to sacrifice your life. This is a fight to reclaim your honor, isn't it?
m200384.ハイドース殿、貴殿は貴殿なりの、\n正義の為に剣を取ったのじゃろう？: Lord Hydros, you have taken up the sword for your own sense of justice, have you not?
m200384.ハッ……ハハッ、笑えッ！\n貴様ら、王の命令だ！ 笑えッ！！:
Ha… Hah! Laugh!
By the king's command! Laugh!
m200384.ハッ、別れが台無しだぞ、親父。\nそういう冗談は、オレが死んだ時、冥界で聞かせて:
Ha, you ruined the farewell, old man.
Tell me that kind of joke when I'm dead in the Underworld.
m200384.ハハッ、亜神の戯言だ。\nあの男といい、リンクスといい、どうにも、\n我の言葉を: Ha ha, the demi-gods' nonsense. Whether it's that man or Lynx, few seem willing to take my words at face value.
m200384.ハハハッ！ 白の王国兵は大したものだな。\n次から次へと、この戦いに馳せ参じたい:
Hahaha! The soldiers of the White Kingdom are something else.
They keep gathering, eager to throw themselves into this battle one after another.
m200384.ハルモニア、しっかりして。\n――あぁ、もう！\nほら、全然会話する気ないの分か: Harmonia, pull yourself together. —Ugh, seriously! You can see he has no intention of talking, right!
m200384.ハーピーとの戦いには、遠隔攻撃が必要でしょう。\n山頂を確保できれば、\n広い射: We'll need ranged attacks against the harpies. If we secure the summit, we could get a longer reach.
m200384.バチバチ光ってる、竜人……？ も、\n飛空船と同時に接近中です！: They're flashing with electricity—dragon people…? They're approaching at the same time as the airship!
m200384.フッ……たわ言を。\nまだ勝負はついてはおりませんからな。: Hmph… empty words. The outcome isn't decided yet.
m200384.フッ……名誉より、友か。\nしかしまさか、王国軍本隊を出すとはな。\n……恩に着: Heh… friendship over honor, huh? Yet you actually send the Kingdom's main force. …I'm in your debt, comrade.
m200384.フフッ、戦争とは数と配置でするものさ。\n数だけ多くても、\nそれを配する場所が:
Heh, war is all about numbers and placement.
Even a huge army is useless if you have nowhere to deploy them.
m200384.フフッ、陛下を斬り殺そうとした女傑は言うことが違う。\nさて、それじゃあ戦闘準備:
Heh, the heroine who tried to slay Your Majesty certainly has different ideas.
Now then, shall we begin the battle preparations?
m200384.ヘカティエ様に捨てられたと思っているのだろう？\nその腹いせに戦争に出るとは、\: You think Lady Hecatie abandoned you? Going to war out of spite—that's pure self-destruction.
m200384.ヘカティエ！ あんたも怒りなさい！\nあなたの騎士なんでしょ！？: Hecatie! Get angry too! She's your knight, isn't she?!
m200384.ベラート伯爵、見れば分かるぞ。\nこの攻勢のために、領地の戦力の殆どを割いたな。: Count Belart, you can see it plainly. You've devoted almost all your domain's forces to this offensive.
m200384.ベラート伯爵は、\nもとより手段を選ばない方でしたからね。\nこれより先は……。:
Count Belart has never been one to pick and choose his methods.
From here on out…
m200384.ベラート伯爵は、この地で皇帝陛下と王子殿下を、\n一度に仕留めるつもりでいるので: Count Berault intends to take down both His Majesty the Emperor and Your Highness the Prince here… That explains the massive force he's brought.
m200384.ベラート伯爵をはじめとする、\n白の王国貴族たちも黙ってはいないだろう。: Even the White Kingdom's nobles, like Count Berart, won't stay silent about this.
m200384.マルゴット、兵たちに交代で休息を。\nそれからあなたも、しばらく休んでおきなさい: Margot, rotate the troops so they can rest. And you, take a break yourself for a while.
m200384.マルゴット、彼らの戦い方を見ておきなさい。\nきっといつか、あなたの剣に役立つは: Margot, watch how they fight. One day it'll come in handy for your sword.
m200384.マルゴットはこういう状況慣れてるだろうけど、\n私は最前線向きじゃな――んっ？\:
Margot's used to situations like this, but I'm not cut out for the front lines—huh?
Ah! Ah!! Speaking of rumors!!
m200384.マルゴットー！\nやった！ やっと睡眠時間だー！\nカテリナさんの頭脳は睡眠を求:
Margot—!
We did it! Finally, nap time!
Katerina's mind is craving sleep… snooo…
m200384.マルレーン、工兵隊への伝令を任せる。\n戦場は広域だ。\n攻撃の届く範囲は限られ: Marleen, you're in charge of relaying orders to the engineers. The battlefield is huge, and our attack range is limited. Don't misjudge the range.
m200384.マルレーンはどっちかっていうと、\n美しいっていうより、かわいいの方じゃない？: Marleen, you're more cute than beautiful, aren't you?
m200384.マルレーンは落ち着き過ぎだよ！\n街の外には伯爵の軍勢がいるのに！:
Marleen, you're too calm!
The Count's army is outside the town!
m200384.マレブランケ副団長ですね？\nお怪我はありませんかー？: Deputy Commander Malebranche, right? Are you hurt?
m200384.メリュジアナよ……忘れたというのか……？\n虐げられ、地下に追いやられた竜人の嘆: Meliusiana… you say you've forgotten? Hear the lament and fury of the draconians once oppressed and driven underground!
m200384.ラビリス……？\n人の王でありながら、\n亜神となったというあのラビリスですか！: Labrys…? The Labrys who's a king among men yet became a demigod!?
m200384.リンクス、また無茶を……。\n王子様、どうかあの子を止めるために、\n力を貸して: Lynx, you're being reckless again… Prince, please lend your power to stop her!
m200384.リンクスよ、お前もまた、\n我が手を差し伸べるべきちびっこであったか……。: Lynx, you too were a little one I should have extended my hand to…
m200384.リンクスよ、これは我が高慢である。\n我が民すべてに強くあれという、我儘ですらあ: Lynx, this is my arrogance—my selfish desire that all my people be strong.
m200384.リンクス！\n……どうして、あなたも、分かっているはずなのに。: Lynx! …How can you understand and still…?
m200384.ルインは自動人形ですから、いつでも健康です。\n――儀式の方は順調ですか？: Since I'm an automaton, I'm always in good shape. —How are the rites progressing?
m200384.ルーテ、あなたの家もそのひとつでしたね。\n……あちらに付きますか？: Rute, your house was one of those, wasn't it? …Shall we follow them?
m200384.レオナ、前線に出るぞ。\n敵の策に乗るのは気に入らないが。: Leona, I'm heading to the front. I don't like playing into their scheme, but—
m200384.レオナ、部隊長を集めろ。\n王国軍との連携を踏まえた軍議を開く。: Leona, gather the unit commanders. We'll hold a council on coordinating with the Kingdom forces.
m200384.レーネったら、自分の故郷を僻地とか言わない！\nそれに視察じゃなくて、\n対冥界: ???: Lehne would never call her own hometown a backwater! And it's not a scouting mission—it's a joint exercise assuming a clash with the Underworld forces.
m200384.レーネ！？ 逃げてって言ったのに……！: Lehne!? I told you to run…!
m200384.ワシだけではないぞ。\nもう一度戦えると聞いてな、\n居ても立っても居られぬ馬鹿: I'm not alone. I heard we could fight again, so I brought along those restless idiots.
m200384.一度は帝国に服従し、\nされど怒りを忘れぬ暗がりの民よ、\n種族の誇り、父祖の名:
Once they submitted to the Empire, yet they have not forgotten their anger.
Now is the time to draw swords for the pride of their race and the honor of their ancestors.
m200384.三代目、骸帝と言えば血なまぐさい逸話と共に、\n版図を拡大した帝国の英雄でもあり:
The third, the Bone Emperor, is famed for blood-soaked legends and is also hailed as a hero who expanded the empire's territories…
Especially in the eyes of the noble families.
m200384.上層部は確信があって進軍しているみたいだけど、\n冥界にそんな簡単に行ける方法が: The higher-ups seem confident enough to keep moving forward, but if there's an easy way into the Netherworld, I'm sure we've heard at least a rumor about it.
m200384.上等です。\n竜との絆ならば王国の騎兵とて負けません。\n王子、進行経路に警戒を: Fine. A bond with a dragon can rival even the kingdom's cavalry. Prince, keep the route guarded—let's meet them head-on.

m200384.安寧ってのはな、法に従わせることで生まれるんだよ。\n魂の管理を投げ出した亜神ヘ: Peace comes from making everyone obey the law. You, Demigod Hecatie, who abandoned the management of souls, and the insolent knight Tilt who committed blasphemy in my realm!

m200384.実に良い戦士だ。\n我が配下に出来ぬことを悔しく思う。:
A truly fine warrior.
I regret that my subordinates couldn't handle you.
m200384.山岳地帯から伏兵が出てきたか……。\n連中は街道を行く部隊より足が遅い。\n接近:
Ambushes emerging from the mountains…
They move slower than the units on the road.
Prepare to intercept before they get close.
m200384.帝国――いや、王国か？\nそっちにも良い戦士がいるじゃないか……。: Empire—no, kingdom? You have fine warriors over there, too…
m200384.帝国とは決して止まれぬものだ。\n侵略を始めたなら、全てを喰らい尽くすか、\n内: The Empire never stops. Once it begins its conquest, it either devours everything or is torn apart from within.
m200384.帝国に、内通者がいると……？\n馬鹿な、軍内に裏切り者がいるはずが――: A spy inside the Empire…? No way, there can't be a traitor in the army—
m200384.帝国に住まう、鬼の部族が長よ。\n――貴様に、頼みたいことがある。\n街への侵入: The chief of the demon tribe that dwells within the Empire… I have a request of you. When we allow the city to be breached, I'll need the power of that club of yours.
m200384.帝国に棲家を奪われた獣人が、\n帝国を恨んでることだって分かってる。: I understand why beast-folk whose homes were taken by the Empire would hold a grudge against it.
m200384.帝国の士気が下がっている今こそ好機。\n冥界の勇士たちよ、\nこの砦を押さえ、北:
Now that Imperial morale is low, it's our chance.
Warriors of the Underworld,
seize this fortress and make a foothold to the north!!
m200384.帝国の戦いに、口出しはしない。\nでも、帝国の民は必ず守る……。\n本当に、どこ: I won't interfere in the Empire's war, but I'll protect its people no matter what… The Prince really is the Prince, through and through.
m200384.帝国の飛空艦隊はここにはいないはずだけど。\n……あっ、見えた。あの艦影は帝国艦: The Imperial fleet shouldn't be out here… Ah, there it is. That ship silhouette is definitely Imperial. And the flag it's flying—
m200384.帝国艦隊の砲撃だけでも厄介だというのに……。\n王子殿、クロコを全力で叩くぞ！: Even the Imperial fleet's bombardment is a hassle… Prince, let's give Croco everything we've got!
m200384.帝国軍の練度は極めて高いわ。\nだからこそ、こちらが兵を割けば、\nそこへ迅速に:
The Imperial troops are extremely skilled.
That's why, if we thin our forces here, they'll swiftly send reinforcements there.
m200384.帝国軍も王国軍も、雪山の方に向かったのかな。\n……ふふん、これでボクは安全に逃: Both the Imperial and Kingdom forces must've headed toward the snow mountains. …Heh, now I can make a clean getaway—
m200384.帝国軍兵士たちよ、剣をとれ。\n死者どもには、冥界へお帰り願おう。: Imperial soldiers, draw your swords. Let the dead return to the Underworld.
m200384.帝都周辺を確保できたとしても、\nこの戦は長引きそうだな……。: Even if we secure the area around the Imperial City, this war looks like it'll drag on…
m200384.平たく言えば、今後は政治の世界に\n思いっきり巻き込まれることになる、ということ: In short, you'll be dragged head-first into the world of politics from now on, huh♪
m200384.平和のために、争う者をすべて排除する……。\nそれ以外の手段を、ルインは手にする: For peace, we must eliminate all who fight… I have no other means.
m200384.幼馴染のボクを置いて、\n都会に出て行っちゃうんだから薄情者だと思うなぁ？: Leaving my childhood friend behind to go to the city—that's what I'd call heartless, don't you think?
m200384.強がらず休め馬鹿者。\nお前が立っていたら兵が休息をとれぬだろう。: Don't be a fool—take a break. If you stay up, the troops won't get any rest.
m200384.当たり前だ、伝説の存在に焚き付けられたんだぞ。\nだからこそタチが悪いんだがな…: Of course—being spurred by a legendary being makes them even more dangerous.
m200384.当然！\n砲兵、全弾ぶち込めェ！！\n地下まで追手を出されたら終わりだからね！！: Of course! Artillery, fire everything!! If the pursuers get down to the underground, it's over!!
m200384.彼……？ あぁ、なるほど。\n開戦前に、彼が陛下と密談を\nしていたのはそういう: Him...? Ah, I see. So his private meeting with the Emperor before the war was about this.
m200384.彼は言葉巧みに、穏やかに眠るべき死者の魂を惑わした。\n未だ死すべき運命にない定: He twisted his words, leading the souls of the peacefully sleeping dead astray. He drove mortals—who weren't even fated to die yet—onto the battlefield for the sake of deceit and a hollow honor.
m200384.待って、あの旗ってベラート伯爵の……。: Wait, that flag belongs to Count Berato…
m200384.後悔したくなければ、この砦へ来いと。\n――そして、なるほど、確かにこれは我が後: If you don't want to regret it, come to this fortress. —Indeed, this is the lingering regret of my own making.
m200384.微弱だけど、物質界のものではない魔力を感じる。\n冥界軍の解析に使えるかもしれな: They're faint, but they emit a magical energy that isn't from this world. They might help us analyze the Netherworld forces, so please pick them up if you see any.
m200384.心得た。\n騎士殿も、悔いなき選択をするがいい。: Understood. Sir Knight, make a choice without regrets.
m200384.心得ておくよ。\nはぁ……花の似合う麗しの神官さまが、\n今や最前線に咲く屈強な: Got it. Hah… the beautiful priestess who looks like a flower, now blooming on the front lines as a mighty priest-knight.
m200384.心配しなくても大丈夫だって。\n王子がさ、いくつの戦場を\n勝ち抜いてきたと思っ: Don't worry, it's fine. The Prince has survived countless battlefields, you know.
m200384.必要な、しかし忘れてはならぬ尊い犠牲、\nそう心に刻んでおけばそれでよいだろうと: Belart —A necessary, yet unforgettable noble sacrifice—just keep that etched in your hearts, and that should suffice.
m200384.応ッ！\nそして白の皇帝よ、貴様もここで死ぬのだ。\n戦士として最後の戦いを、始: Yes! And you, White Emperor, you'll die here too. Shall we begin the final battle as warriors?
m200384.思い返せば、この身体も\n人の子らの力によって取り戻してもらったもの。: Come to think of it, this body was restored thanks to the children of men.
m200384.思っています。\nあなたは、私の一番の親友ですから。: I do. You're my dearest friend.
m200384.怪我人は安静にしてください。\n無理やり安静にしますよ？: Injured people should rest. I'll make sure they do, alright?
m200384.悪くない……戦士たちの怨嗟の声が、\n殺せと、砕けと、オレに求めてくる。: Not bad… the warriors' lingering cries demand me to kill, to shatter… they call to me.
m200384.憧れの存在ってのは、毒にも薬にもなるってことだ。\nユージェン、お前も気をつけて: A legendary figure can be both poison and medicine. Yuugen, you'd better watch yourself.
m200384.我々は別の戦線で、冥界軍の作戦行動開始を遅滞させる。\nどうか、私の部下を救って: We'll delay the Netherworld army's operations on another front. Please, save my subordinate.
m200384.我が剣はあなたの神罰を代行するものであり、\n我が手は死者の魂を冥界へ導き、\n: My sword was to enact your divine punishment, my hand to guide the dead's souls to the Underworld, to lure them into your cradle.
m200384.我が復讐を……悲願を愚弄するつもりか……ッ！！: You dare mock my revenge… my lifelong ambition…?!
m200384.我が王、こちらの戦力は各個撃破されています。\nしかし同時に、確実に\n帝国軍の: My king, our forces have been taken down one by one. Yet at the same time, the Imperial troops are clearly slowing their advance.
m200384.我が願いニハ、数多の生贄が必要ナノダ。\n真なる雷を、コノ身に宿すにはナ……。: My wish requires countless sacrifices. To house the true lightning within me…
m200384.我らは誉れある戦いを重んずる。だがこの戦いは、\n志を同じくする友のための戦いで: We cherish honorable battle. Yet this fight is also for our comrades who share our resolve.
m200384.我ら王政の時代より国を支えてきた貴族……。\n何処の馬の骨とも知れぬあの男が長と: Since the days of the monarchy, the nobles have upheld the nation… Since that unknown man rose to power, our homeland has been consumed by war, only twisting further…
m200384.我ら白の王国貴族、先王への忠義は誓えども、\n生まれも知れぬ傭兵などに\n仕えた: We, nobles of the White Kingdom, have sworn loyalty to the late king, yet we have never—not in the slightest—served unknown mercenaries.
m200384.戦争など、強がりで参戦するものではない。\n誇りと虚勢を取り違えたままでは、\n:
War isn't something you join out of bravado.
If you keep confusing pride with pretense, a day will come when you can't turn back.
m200384.戦争に正義なんざないさ。\nこっちの利益とあっちの利益、それが激突して、\n話し: There's no such thing as justice in war. It's a clash of our interests versus theirs, and when talks fail, war erupts.
m200384.戦力の分散にも気をつけて。\nはぐれたら帰れない可能性もあるから。\n――それじ:
Be careful not to spread our forces too thin.
If we get scattered we might not be able to return.
—Well then, shall we go?
m200384.手厳しいものだ。\nだが、期待には応えよう。\n――そこでサザンカ、貴様に頼みが: Harsh, but I'll meet your expectations. —So, Sasanqua, I have a request of you.
m200384.手強い相手だよ、兵の心を掴んでる。\n――そう、それこそ連中にとっての王子みたい:
They're a tough opponent, they've got the troops' hearts.
—Exactly, they're like a prince to those guys.
m200384.承知の上、よ。\nハイドース様が本心を語らず、\n何かを企んでいることは、私も知: I'm fully aware. I know Haidos keeps his true intentions hidden and is scheming.
m200384.承知の上だ、鬼の族長。\nこちらから攻撃を仕掛け、領土を拡大したのだ。\nその責: I understand, chieftain of the demons. We launched the attack and expanded our territory. We must bear that responsibility.
m200384.指揮官は後方に控える、\nということを覚えたのかもしれません。: Perhaps the commander decided to stay back.
m200384.捌くんじゃないの。\n思いやって、慈しむのよ。: It's not about disposing of them. It's about caring for them.
m200384.掴まれサザンカ！！\n……まったく、連中の時間稼ぎはこのためか！！:
Hold on, Sasanqua!!
…Good grief, they're buying time with this!
m200384.援軍到着まで保たせただけで勲章ものだ。\n後は我々にまかせておけ。: Just keeping things afloat until the reinforcements arrived is medal-worthy. Leave the rest to us.
m200384.支援が欲しいのは全部の前線かなぁ。\nロミルダ、ちょっと休んでいってください！\: All fronts could use some support, I guess. Romilda, take a little rest! You can't fight when your mana's drained.
m200384.故郷に残してきた友に、\n言いたいことはしっかり伝えておくべきだったなぁ。\nあ: I should've made sure to tell my hometown friend exactly what I wanted to say. Ah, such a regret. I'm so full of regret.
m200384.故郷を奪われた貴殿には、我らと同じく、\nその怒りをもって皇帝を断罪する権利があ: Having lost your homeland, you have, just like us, the right to condemn the Emperor with that very anger. Yet you waste it on… what are you brooding over?
m200384.敵が強くて助かった、と言ったところか。\n何とも滑稽な話だが、人の身からすれば天:
So you say we were saved by the enemy's strength.
How absurd, but to mortals it's like a natural disaster.
m200384.敵が飛空艦隊を持ち出した以上、\nこちらは常に後手に回ることになります。\nこち:
Since the enemy has deployed an air fleet, we'll always be on the back foot.
If only we had air power ourselves…
m200384.敵の増援、かもしれません。\nあれだけの艦隊ならば、\n上陸部隊もかなりの数でし: It could be enemy reinforcements. With a fleet that size, the landing force must be huge.
m200384.敵の将は戦争を知っているらしい。\nだが、こちらも全ての手の内を明かしたわけでは: The enemy commander seems to understand war. But we haven't revealed all our cards either.
m200384.敵の戦術、布陣も分かってきた。\n次は毒茨のドルイドたちを出せ。: We're getting a handle on the enemy's tactics and formations. Next, send out the poison-thorn druids.
m200384.敵の総指揮官はハイドース様なのよ？\n冥界の門を開く権限を持っている亜神なのよ？: The enemy's supreme commander is Lord Hydo himself, the demigod who can open the gates of the Netherworld!
m200384.敵は街道も押さえているようです。\n舗装された道を使ってくるとなれば、\n敵の行:
The enemy seems to have secured the roads as well.
If they're using paved routes, their march speed will be swift.
m200384.敵は飛空戦艦と車両部隊を主力としています。\nならば、背後の雪山に逃れ、\n高所: The enemy's main forces are airship battleships and vehicle units. In that case, we should fall back to the snow-capped mountains behind us and secure the high ground.
m200384.敵を褒めている場合じゃないよ、団長。\n――王子、もうあまり時間がない、\nオー:
This isn't the time to praise the enemy, Captain.
—Prince, we don't have much time left,
prepare to withstand the Orcs' massive offensive!!
m200384.敵軍の監視のため、東の川に忍ばせていたが、\n先の戦闘結果、\n退路を絶たれる形: He was hidden near the eastern river to monitor the enemy, but after the latest battle he's been cut off with no retreat.
m200384.敵軍は冥界人と思しき連中だけではない。\n遠方より、獣人の部隊が接近しているのだ:
The enemy isn't just the Underworld folk.
Troops of beastmen are approaching from afar.
m200384.敵部隊に近付かれる前に、\n遠距離からできるだけ戦力を削っておきたいですね……。: Before the enemy gets close, I'd like to whittle down their forces from afar as much as possible…
m200384.時が経てば、黒炎も\n物質界の法則に飲まれて消えていくけれど……。\n手早く炎を: Given time, the black flame will be consumed by the laws of the material world and fade, but it might be safer to disperse the fire quickly.
m200384.時にハイデマリー、四季の豊かな国は好きか？\nお前の戦功を讃え、王国旅行を贈りた: Tell me, Heidemarie, do you like a country blessed with the four seasons? I'd like to honor your deeds with a royal tour.
m200384.暗殺ではなく、戦争を選ぶ以上、\n白の帝国自体に恨みを持つ者なのでしょうか……。:
If we're choosing war over assassination,
then they must bear a grudge against the White Empire itself…
m200384.書物にはほとんど、その記録が残されていません。\nですがある地方の口伝によれば、: Most texts barely mention it, but local legend says Queen Labrys became the Judge of the Underworld after death.
m200384.最初から想定済みだ。\n……悪い想定の方ばかりが当たっているが。: We anticipated that from the start. …Only the worst-case scenarios seem to be playing out.
m200384.最初のダークエルフの襲撃で、\n警備部隊長が負傷してしまいましたので……。: During the initial Dark Elf raid, the head of the guard was wounded, so…
m200384.最前線に出たがりの困った男だが、\n優れた政治手腕なくして、\nあの寄り合い所帯: He's a troublesome man who loves the front lines, but without sharp political skill he couldn't keep that rag-tag group together.
m200384.最強の鬼が、これからも手を貸してあげるよ。\nだから皇帝も王子も、\n絶対に、だ: The strongest demon will keep lending you a hand, so neither the Emperor nor the Prince should ever—ever—lose to anyone!
m200384.最新鋭の兵器なんだろ、帝国式魔導何とかってのは。\n――それがこの砦にあるって、: It's the latest cutting-edge Imperial-style magical weapon, isn't it? —And it's at this fortress, so I figured someone must've leaked that info.
m200384.望みを叶えよう、かつての強者たちよ。\n冥界と物質界の壁を超えるがよい。:
Let your wishes be fulfilled, mighty ones of old.
Cross the barrier between the Underworld and the material world.
m200384.期待はしておくよ？\n鬼を呆れさせないように注意するといいさ。: I'll be watching. Make sure you don't disappoint the demons.
m200384.本来ならば付き合ってやる必要はないが、\nこちらもこの砦を失うわけにはいかない。: Normally we wouldn't have to engage, but we can't afford to lose this fortress. Fight with everything you've got!
m200384.来いッ！\n獣人の誇りがあるのなら！\n言葉で語るな、牙と咆哮で語るが良いッ！！: Come at me! If you have the pride of a beast-folk, don't speak with words—prove it with your fangs and your roar!!
m200384.来るが良い、今代の帝国軍よ。\n戦乱の世にて磨かれし我が剣、\nその錆となりたい:
Come forth, this generation's Imperial army.
Step forward if you wish to become the rust on my blade.
m200384.案ずるな、別働隊も制したと報告があった。\nまだ帝国は、戦い続けられる。:
Don't worry, reports say the auxiliary unit has been subdued.
The Empire can still keep fighting.
m200384.欠片は拾い集めたけど、\n女神の魔力が宿っていた武器に、\nその力を取り戻すこと: I've gathered the fragments, but a weapon that once held the goddess's magic can't have its power restored.
m200384.正直に言って、かなりの無理難題だと思いますよ。\nあちらにも正義があることだけが: Honestly, I think it's an almost impossible task. The only small consolation is that they, too, have a sense of justice.
m200384.正統性という意味なら、\n先帝による譲位と、私の信認がそれを保証するでしょう。: In terms of legitimacy, the abdication by the former emperor and my endorsement guarantee it.
m200384.正面から蹴散らせ。\n彼らもそれを望んでいるはずだ。: Drive them back head-on. They'll want that too.
m200384.此度の戦は、王国に助けられた。\nその事実はどうあがいても変わらない。:
This battle was aided by the Kingdom.
That fact won't change no matter how hard we try.
m200384.此度の戦場、貴様の勝ちだ。\n死の淵より帰還するとは、\nそれほどまでに、この世:
This battlefield is yours.
To return from the brink of death,
you must cherish this world that much.
m200384.武技も、器も優れた男、か。\nそれだけに惜しいな……。:
A man with both skill and bearing, huh.
It's a shame, then…
m200384.歩む速度が落ちるのなら、\n堂々と胸を張って進めばいい。\nそれが我ら、勇者に連: If our pace slows, we'll just stride forward with our heads held high. That's what we, the Orc warriors who follow the heroes, do!
m200384.歪んで、傾いて、反旗を翻されてもなお、\nその異形のままに走り続けることしか、\: Even if it twists, tilts, and rebels, the Empire can only keep charging forward in its monstrous form.
m200384.歴代の勇者たちが……この地に……！\n勝てる、おぉぉ、勝てるぞ、この戦……！！: The heroes of old… here…! We can win, oh yes, we can win this battle…!!
m200384.死んでしまっては誇りもなにもない、と？\nはははっ、騎士殿、それは順序が逆だ。: You say if you die there's no pride or anything? Hahaha, Sir Knight, that's the wrong order.
m200384.死んで楽になんて、させませんから。\n自分の始めたことなら、\n最後まで責任を取:
I won't let you die and find peace.
If it's something you started,
you must take responsibility to the end.
m200384.死兵……捨て駒となることを決めた者こそ、\n最も強い戦士である、と……？: So a dead soldier… someone who decides to become a sacrificial pawn is the strongest warrior, huh?
m200384.死後の世界、ですからね。\nその兵力とは、物質界の死の総量に等しいものかと。: It's the afterlife, after all. That manpower likely equals the total amount of death in the material world.
m200384.死者が、この世に現れる。\n悪霊怨霊、地縛霊に、夢枕に立つご先祖さま。\nまさか: The dead appear in this world—malevolent spirits, bound souls, even ancestors who visit us in our dreams. You really haven't heard any of that?
m200384.死者を兵として扱えることでしょ？\nどれだけ使い潰しても、再利用できちゃうんだか: It's that they can use the dead as soldiers, right? No matter how many times you wear them out, you can reuse them.
m200384.殊勝な心がけだな。\nでは、この礼は別の形でするとしよう。\n帝国――いや、白の: Admirable sentiment. Then let's express our thanks in another way. Empire—no, White Kingdom noble Belart.
m200384.殺された当人が許すと言っているのだ。\n胸を張って、私が殺したと自慢しておけ！:
The one who was killed says it's okay.
Stand tall and brag that I was the one who killed her!
m200384.殺すなって言われてないから、殺すってこと……？\nふっざけるなッ！\n殺せるから: Just because nobody told you not to kill, you can just kill? Don't mess with me! “I can kill, so I will”—enough!
m200384.民を守る、強き力を持つ者が皇帝となる。\nこちらの流儀に、あちらもあわせてくれて:
Those who protect the people with great strength become emperor.
They've blended their ways with ours.
m200384.民を守るのが、俺の役目だ。\nあいつなら、同じ選択をするだろう。: Protecting the people is my duty. He would make the same choice.
m200384.気にするでない。\n竜とは、気まぐれに世界を愛し、世界を壊す存在じゃ。: Don't worry about it. Dragons are beings that love the world on a whim—and destroy it.
m200384.気にする必要はありません。\nルインは、自分からこの作戦を提案しました。: No need to worry. I proposed this plan myself.
m200384.永遠を生きる神仙なんて、\n時の停滞した死者と同じようなものじゃない？\n居心地:
Immortals who live forever are basically the same as the dead whose time has stopped, aren't they?
The reason it's comfortable is because you're the one summoned here.

we'll keep Your Majesty's life.

—Well, that's odd for a ship like that…

m200384.物質界で生きていても、いずれは死ぬでしょう？\n生命とは、いつか必ず\n死ぬよう:
Even in the material world, everyone eventually dies, right?

m200384.王よ、そんな……！\n俺たちもここでお供します！！: My king, no…! We'll go with you too!!

m200384.王国軍には、このマレブランケ隊の救出を頼みたい。\n……できるか？: Kingdom forces, we'd like you to rescue Mare Blanc's unit. …Can you do it?

Prince, the fight with Hydos isn't over yet.
Let's stay vigilant and keep our guard up.

m200384.王子、敵が動き始めたようだ。\nどうやらこちらの先手を取りたいようだね。: Prince, the enemy seems to be making a move. Looks like they want to take the initiative.
m200384.王子、敵の増援部隊だ。\nさすがに後詰を用意していたか、冥界軍。: Prince, enemy reinforcements. The Netherworld forces have even prepared a rear guard.
m200384.王子、敵の攻勢が続いています。\n引き続き指揮をお願いします！:
Prince, the enemy's assault continues.
Please keep commanding!

Prince, the enemy has entrenched themselves around the Imperial City.
You should be able to see the flag-bearing Minotaur from here, right?
m200384.王子、気をつけろ。\n敵軍の士気はより高くなるぞ。: Prince, be careful. The enemy's morale will only rise from here.
m200384.王子、港町の防衛部隊も出ているようです。\n協力して戦闘を進めましょう。: Prince, the port town's defense forces have shown up. Let's work together to push the fight forward.
m200384.王子、王国軍も傷の手当が必要だろう。\n得られた時間は長くはないが、\n可能な限: Prince, the kingdom's troops will need medical attention. We don't have much time, so get whatever preparations you can done.
m200384.王子さま！ 気をつけて！！\nクロコのハルバードがまとっているのは、\n古代の雷: Prince! Watch out!! Croco's halberd is channeling something equal to a dragon-breath from an ancient thunder dragon!
m200384.現状では静かなものだ。\n拠点が物質界にない上、\n異種族の居留地を無意味に探る: At present it's quiet. Since their base isn't in the material world, they can't senselessly scout the other-race settlements.
m200384.生きて帰るつもりがないのなら、\n戦士はその、本当の実力というものを発揮する。\: If you don't intend to come back alive, a warrior will show his true strength. Even a rookie can slay the enemy commander.
m200384.生命とは、想いを持つもの。\nその安寧なくして、死者の国を\n清浄に保つことがで: Life is something that holds feelings. Do you think you can keep the realm of the dead pure without that peace?
m200384.生者が冥界を訪れたのだから、当然の現象よ。\nこの地は死に満ちているの。\nただ:
Since the living have come to the underworld, it's a natural phenomenon.
This place is saturated with death.
Just being here should drain your life force.
m200384.申し遅れた、メフィスト団長の部下、マレブランケだ。\n……本当に助かった、この礼:
Sorry for the delay—I'm Malebranche, a subordinate of Director Mephisto.
...You really saved me; I'll be sure to repay this favor.
m200384.異種族が口を挟むことじゃなかったわね。\n人の国家のことは、人が決めていくべきだ: Lynx —It wasn't the place of other races to intervene. A nation's affairs should be decided by its people.
m200384.白の帝国――いや、白の王国というべきか。\n王政時代に領海を守護した、貴族たちの: The White Empire—no, perhaps the White Kingdom. A fleet led by nobles that protected our waters during the monarchic era.
m200384.白の帝国がその清算を終わらせる、\nその長くも短い時間を、\n物質界を狙う亜神た: The demigods targeting the material realm won't wait for the White Empire's long-or-short reckoning.
m200384.白の帝国が瓦解するより早く、\n決着をつけられるかどうか。\nそしてそこに、民を: Whether we can settle this before the White Empire collapses, and whether we can do it without dragging the civilians into it.
m200384.白の帝国が謳う実力主義に、権威など存在しない。\n皇帝の正当性とは、ひとえに先王: In the meritocracy the White Empire boasts, there is no such thing as authority. The emperor's legitimacy rests entirely on the previous king's abdication—that fact is the empire's greatest support.
m200384.白の帝国が限界に達していることなど、\n俺も既に、理解している。: I already understand that the White Empire has reached its limit.

The White Empire and the Kingdom were once enemies.
There might still be a way to exploit that, even now.

The time has come to reclaim the ancestral lands stolen by the White Empire!
Wolf folk, cattle folk, now is the moment to tell our ancestors!
We have come with our own hands to take back our homeland!
m200384.白の帝国は戦力と領土を必要としていた。\nあいつらはその地を守りたかった。\n―: The White Empire needed troops and territory. Those Orcs wanted to protect their land. —And we're here as the Empire's reinforcements.
m200384.白の帝国建国の折、あるいはそれ以前の、\n国を守るための戦いで散っていった、\n: When the White Empire was founded, or even before, the soldiers of the White Kingdom who fell defending the nation are now shouting in the Underworld.
m200384.白の王国を取り戻す、そのためならば、\nこのベラート、己を犠牲にすることすら厭わ: To reclaim the White Kingdom—I, Belart, will even sacrifice myself if that's what it takes!
m200384.白の王国貴族たちの\n無念を代表してここにあるのは確かですが、\nさりとて皇帝の: I may stand here as the voice of the White Kingdom nobles' regret, but that doesn't mean I'm eager to take the Emperor's head…
m200384.白の皇帝は今、生死の狭間にある！\nされど、彼に国を預けた王家の血は、\n今もな: The White Emperor now teeters between life and death! Yet the royal blood that entrusted him with the nation still stands with you on this battlefield!
m200384.皆さん、敵は城門で足止めされています。\n形勢は逆転しました。\nどうか、ご武運: Everyone, the enemy is stalled at the gate. The tide has turned. May fortune favor us!
m200384.皇帝に騎士団長、王国軍まで北方へ向かわせ、\nあえて作り出した弱点にて、\n敵を: The emperor dispatched the Grand Master of the Knights and the kingdom's army north, deliberately creating a weak point so we can crush the enemy like a lump of malice.

Still asleep, are you…

What's the escape route?

This time, the Underworld army is completely at our fingertips.

m200384.英雄王の系譜、その力を借りねば\n帝国の維持も出来ないとは……。\n何が力ある者: The Hero King's lineage… without borrowing that power, we couldn't even keep the Empire together… Who truly wields strength? Who truly is an emperor?
m200384.落ち着いてレーネ。\n慌てるとろくなことないんだから。:
Calm down, Lehne.
Panicking won't help anything.

Let's go, everyone! Take up your swords for the homeland!
We'll reclaim the country from those mercenaries!!
m200384.街の皆は、誰も死んでない！\n全員守ったんだよ、誇れよ皇帝！: Nobody in the city died! We protected everyone—be proud, Emperor!

m200384.西の砦……ふふっ、ならば問題ありませんわ。\n帝国の大動脈たるあの砦は、\n彼の: The western fortress… hehe, then there's no problem. That fortress, the empire's lifeline, is being defended by his troops.
m200384.西の砦に敵獣人の部隊が進軍！\nこちらの増援が間に合わない距離です！: Enemy beastmen are marching on the western fortress! They're too far for our reinforcements to arrive in time!
m200384.見くびってもらっては困る。\n城門なんざワシらの敵じゃないぞ。\nここはひとつ、:
Don't underestimate us.

We'll just punch a hole through the wall!!
m200384.見たか！ 若ぇの！！\nワシらの子孫の土地を奪った\n白の帝国の土手っ腹に風穴あ: See that, youngster!! We've blown a wind-hole in the White Empire's belly that stole our ancestors' land!!
m200384.見事耐えきるのならば、\nこちらも手段を講じる必要があるだろう。: If you manage to endure splendidly, we'll have to take measures as well.
m200384.覚えているとも！\nだが、それを押してなお、\n我らは未来の子らの為に、平和を願: I haven't forgotten! Yet even so, we still wish for peace—for the children of the future!
m200384.親友置いて逃げるわけないじゃん！\nそれより、急いで戦闘準備を！\n雪上兵はすぐ: I'd never ditch my best friend! Now hurry and get ready for battle! Those snow troops will catch up in no time!
m200384.詭弁は聞き飽きた。\n貴様の本心を引きずり出すには、\nどうやら、敗北を味わわせ:
I've heard enough sophistry.

it seems I must make you taste defeat.
m200384.誇りのために、命を捨てることだってある。\nオークとは戦いに生きる種族。\n戦場: Sometimes you have to give up your life for honor. Orcs are a race that lives for battle. Dying on the battlefield—that's glory.
m200384.誘い込んで叩く、というわけね。\n……勝てると思う？:
Luring them in and striking, huh.
…Do you think we can win?
m200384.誰かに助けてもらえるなんて思うなッ！！\n気高き獣人の誇りと、\n卑屈な負けライ: Don't expect anyone to save you!! The noble pride of beast-folk and that pathetic, defeat-loving lion spirit don't belong together!
m200384.調査の手を入れれば、\n冥界軍への関与を疑うことになりますからね。: If we start probing, it'll look like we're meddling with the Underworld forces.
m200384.諦めるな！\nここで耐えなければ、援軍は来ないぞ！！:
Don't give up!

m200384.貴様か……。\nどうした、ディアスのところにいると思っていたが。: So it's you… What brings you here? I thought you were with Dias.
m200384.貴様がまっさきに裏切ると思っていたのだがな……。\nいったいどんな心境の変化だ？: I figured you'd be the first to betray us… What kind of change of heart is this?
m200384.貴様は……どうしてそちら側に立っている。\n子爵よ、帝国騎士の誇りを忘れたか！: You… why are you siding with them? Count, have you forgotten the pride of an Imperial knight?
m200384.貴様ら、いったい誰に刃を向けたのか分かっているのか！\n古代龍様、黄金竜の姫様は:

The Ancient Dragon, the Golden Dragon Princess—
They're walking side by side with the kingdom!
m200384.軍の仕事が忙しくてね。\nなかなか里帰りもできない……って、\nアタシを薄情者み: Work's been crazy busy, so I can't really go back… Hey, don't call me heartless!
m200384.辞令は以上だ。急ぎ荷物を整えろ。\n他の者に口外することは許さん。: That's the order. Pack your things quickly. You're not to tell anyone else.
m200384.連中が退いたのは、壊滅したからではない。\nこれ以上の被害拡大を防ぐために退いた:

m200384.連中の目的は時間稼ぎだ。\nその命をかけてまで、仲間のために\nわずかな時間を稼: Their goal is just to buy time. They're willing to risk their lives to buy a few precious moments for their comrades.
m200384.違う……あれはもっと異質な……。\nあたしたちより、古い竜の雷……？: No… that's something far more alien… The lightning of a dragon older than us…?
m200384.避難しろって言われても――あぁもう！\nマルレーンのバカ！\nすぐ危険な場所に飛: Even if you tell me to evacuate… Ugh, you idiot Marleen! You always rush straight into danger!
m200384.部隊として進軍してくる者は、\n散兵よりも耐久力が高くなると予想されます。\n各:
Those advancing as units will likely have higher durability than scattered troops.
Everyone, remember the enemy is an army!
m200384.部隊を撤退させよ、威力偵察は十分だ。\n皆に小休止を取らせ、陣形を整え直すのだ。:
Withdraw the units; we've gathered enough intel on their strength.
Give everyone a short break and reform the lines.
m200384.銀の髪に、黒き外套……。\nおそらくは、ダークエルフを率いる首魁、\nセグナンド: Silver hair, black cloak… It's probably the Dark-elf leader himself, Segnand!
m200384.陛下、こちらも同意見です。\nあえてあちらが有利な、\n平地で迎え撃つ必要もない: Your Highness, I agree. There's no need to deliberately meet them on the plain where they have the advantage.
m200384.陛下、しゃべらないでください！\n早くヒーラーを……っ。\nトゥーダ！ 神官戦士: Your Majesty, don't speak! Send a healer quickly…! Tuda! Call in the priest-warriors!
m200384.陛下、ハイドースは戦場の黒炎を吸収してるんだ！\nめちゃくちゃな魔力をかき集めて:
Your Highness, Hydos is absorbing the battlefield's black flame!
He's gathering an insane amount of magical energy!
m200384.陛下、冥界軍が撤退していきます。\n……おそらくは、今の襲撃は威力偵察だったので: Your Majesty, the Underworld army is withdrawing. …It was probably just a power-reconnaissance raid.
m200384.陛下、各前線より伝令が。\nダークエルフ、オークの部隊により、\n各重要地点が占: Your Majesty, messengers from each front report that Dark Elf and Orc units have occupied the key points.
m200384.陛下、王子殿下、お気をつけを。\n子爵は帝国屈指の武人の家系。\n当主たるあの方:
Your Majesty, Prince, be careful.
The Count comes from the Empire's foremost warrior lineage.
Even the head of that house possesses superb martial skill.
m200384.陛下！ 敵の増援です！\n飛空戦艦がさらに出現！: Your Majesty! Reinforcements have arrived! More airships are appearing!
m200384.陛下！ 東の方角より、飛空船が接近中です！\nそれから、な、なんというのか……。: Your Highness! Airships are approaching from the east! And, uh, what's it called…
m200384.陛下！ 王子！\n警戒すべきは地面の下だよー！！:
Your Highness! Prince!
We need to watch out beneath the ground!
m200384.雪上装備の兵が迫ってるんだ！\n雪の上でも関係なく、高速で突っ込んでくるよ！！: Snow-equipped soldiers are closing in! Even on the snow they'll charge at full speed!!
m200384.領民や、伯爵領の兵にとって見れば、\n私たちこそ悪役だ、ということか……。\nそ: From the perspective of the peasants and his own soldiers, we're the villains… Right, I'll cool my head a bit.
m200384.顔に書いてあるじゃない。\nヘカティエ様大好き、置いていかないでってさ。: It's written all over your face. You love Hecatie and don't want to be left behind.
m200384.飛空戦艦も雪山を超えてきます。\nここからは総力戦ですよ！: The sky-ship will cross the snowy mountain. From here it's an all-out battle!
m200384.馬鹿な、どこから兵を――否、将を増員したというのだ。\nまさか本当に、冥界から喚: Ridiculous—so they've increased troops—no, commanders—from somewhere? Could they really have summoned them from the Netherworld!?
m200384.馬鹿者が、ワシらがいつまでも戦っていたら、\nお前たちの戦果を奪ってしまうだろう: Foolish ones, if we kept fighting forever, we'd end up snatching your spoils!
m200384.騎士団長のディアナ？ 神官戦士団長のトゥーダ？\nまさか王国の王子？ ……違うで:
Knight Commander Diana? Cleric-Warrior Commander Tuda?
Surely not the Kingdom's Prince…? …You think otherwise?
m200384.騎士殿、死ぬために戦うな。\n己の迷いを断ち切るために、戦え。: Sir Knight, don't fight to die. Fight to cut through your own doubts.
m200384.鬼が最強なのは事実だから。\nそういう揺るぎない事実と違ってさ、\n今やってるの:
Demons being the strongest is a fact.
Unlike that unshakable truth, what we're doing now is a fight we don't even need to have, right?
m200384.鬼の一族たるあたしが、\n帝国を裏切らないか近くで見ておけ、とかさ？: She wants me, a demon clan member, to keep an eye on whether I'll betray the Empire.
m200384.魔王決戦の時のものにしては古い……。\n千年戦争当時のものかな？: It's older than the time of the Demon King's final battle… Could it be from the Millennium War era?
m200384.魔界と物質界ではない、\n物質界の者同士による古戦場が、オレの死に場所か。: It's not the demon realm or the material world—it's a battlefield of the material world, where my death awaits.
m200384.魔界に住まうオークとは別に、\nかつての千年戦争以降、\n物質界に定住していたオ: Aside from the Orcs that dwell in the Netherworld, I've heard that after the Millennium War there were Orcs who settled in the material world.
m200384.魔神副団長殿……。\nすみません、つい不安になってしまって。: Deputy Demon Lord… I'm sorry, I just can't help feeling anxious.
m200384.黒き竜人、闇色の鱗持つ、竜神が子孫よ。\n汝の後悔、悲しみ、この戦にて晴らすがよ: Black drakes, bearing dark-colored scales, descendants of the Dragon Gods. Let your regret and sorrow be cleared on this battlefield.
m200384.黒き竜人の一族は、今は王国と共に歩んでいる。\n貴様の行為は、その同盟に泥を塗る: The black draconian clan now walks side by side with the Kingdom. Your deeds are a despicable betrayal, sullying that alliance.
m200384.黙れよ、こうして晴れ姿を見せてやったんだ。\nお前の息子は、今や物質界のオークを: Shut up. I've shown you my true form at last. Your son has become the king of the material-world orcs… —a defeated king who lost to the White Empire.
m200384.黙れアダマスッ！！\n力を失ったあの日、長き眠りより覚めた絶望の日、\nその片時:
Silence, Adamas!!
The day I lost my power, the day I awoke from a long slumber into despair,
not even for a moment have I forgotten my hatred for you!
m200384.（……こんな戦いは、間違っています。\n民を巻き込むような反乱が、正しいはずがあ: (…This kind of war is wrong. A rebellion that drags civilians into it can't be righteous.)
m200384.（……でも、あの子はリエーフの友だちでしょ。\nどうにかして、仲直りさせてあげな:
(…But that kid is Lev's friend.
We have to find a way to reconcile them.)
m200384.（……はい、姉さん。\n今回の襲撃に関わっているかどうかは不明ですが、\n確実に:
(…Yes, sister.
I don't know if they're involved in this raid, but they're definitely with the demigod Haidos.)
m200384.（……リエーフ、その友人って、\nもしかしてリンクスのこと？\nあの子の部族が冥:
(…Lev, that friend of yours,
could it be Lynx?
Is that child's tribe attached to the Underworld army?)
m200384.（あはは、分かった分かった。\nそれじゃあ、王子たちに報告しておこう。\n敵の獣:
(Haha, got it, got it.
Then I'll report to the princes.
The enemy beastmen— they're said to be quite formidable.)
m200384.（おっと失敬、転んだ時はよろしく頼むよ）\n――それにしても、いやぁ、心残りだな: (Oops, sorry—if I do fall, please take care of me.) —Anyway, I'm really left with a lingering regret.
m200384.（そっか……リンクスは、\nアタシたちの部族のこと嫌ってたもんね。\n獣人の誇り:
(I get it… Lynx hated our tribe, right?
Talking about the pride of the beastmen or something.)
m200384.（それは自分でがんばりますから！\n姉さんが口出しするといつも大変なことになるん: (I'll handle it myself! If you interfere, sister, it always gets messy!)
m200384.（アダマス様は、本当に眠っているのか？\nそれとも、あえてこの戦いに目を瞑ってい:
(Is Lord Adamas truly asleep?
Or is he deliberately turning a blind eye to this battle…?)
m200384.（マレブランケ、目ぇ閉じて歩いてると転ぶよ？）: (Malebranche, you'll fall if you keep walking with your eyes closed, you know?)
m200384.（仕方ありません。\n魔王の配下となり、次は人間に与する。\nそんな父の真意を、:
(It can't be helped.
She became a servant of the Demon King, and now serves humans.
She doesn't understand her father's true intentions.)
m200384.（初々しいなぁ……。\nこれが人間の友情、というものか）: (How fresh… Is this what human friendship is like?)
m200384.（変わろうとしている、のでしょうか。\nもしかしたら、王子の影響かもしれませんね: (He seems to be trying to change… perhaps it's the Prince's influence.)
m200384.（白の皇帝も、以前と比べて変わりましたね。\nまさか私に意見を求めてくるとは）: (The White Emperor's changed a lot since before… I never expected him to ask for my opinion.)
m200384.（誰もが己の欲望を、\n見せかけの正しさで覆い隠している……。\n亜神ハイドース: (Everyone hides their own desires behind a façade of righteousness… Hydrus, demi-god, what are you hiding?)
m200384.（門が突破されれば、一気に敵がなだれ込み、\nその利点も消えるのだがな。\nそれ: (If the gate is breached, the enemy will pour in at once and that advantage disappears. Not telling the troops is part of the marshal's scheme…)
m200384.１０００％もいらねぇ。\nデーモンみたいな強靭な種族には分からんだろうが、\n人:
You don't need a thousand percent.
You demons probably can't grasp it, but for humans, marching is hard labor enough on its own.

m400465.――うぉおおおおっ！！\nさすが王子！ さすが現チャンプだぜ！！\nよぉし、そう:
――Woooooo!!
Just as I thought, Prince! The reigning champ himself!!
Alright then, if that's settled, let me explain the rules!
m400465.……おや、あんまり乗り気じゃないみたいだね。\nしかし参加しないとなると困るな…:
…Hmm, you don't look that eager.
But if you don't take part, that'll be a problem…
m400465.『多くの敵を撃破すること』が重要で、\nライフが０になってもクリアした事になり、: The goal is to defeat as many enemies as possible; even if your life hits zero, you still clear the mission, and the number you've slain counts toward your score.
m400465.『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ奴とか、\nワルキューレを出撃メンバーに\n入れておく: It might be wise to bring someone with the “Call Reinforcements” skill, or slot a Valkyrie into your deployment team.
m400465.あたしはあんたの強さをよく知ってるけど、\nそうじゃない奴らがどんな噂をたてるか: I know how strong you are, but you never know what rumors the others will spread.
m400465.いったいどうしたんだい、ドゥーラ。\nそんなに焦らなくても王子はどこへも行かない:
What's the matter, Doula?
You don't have to rush— the Prince isn't going anywhere.
m400465.えーっとあとは、そうだ！\n魔界武術大会会場には、魔界の瘴気は入ってこない。\n: Uh, let's see… Oh right! The tournament arena is free of demonic miasma, so you can fight with your full, true power!
m400465.そ、そっか、現チャンプは王子だからな！\nうぉおおおっ、タイトル防衛戦ッ！\n熱:
I-I see, the current champ is you, Prince!
Wooooah, a title-defense battle!!
It's so hot… so hot!!
m400465.そ、それにっ！ せっかく数多の猛者と戦える、\nこんな貴重な機会を逃す手はないよ:
A-And besides! This is a rare chance to face countless fierce opponents—
there's no way we can pass it up, right? Right?
m400465.それから今回の魔界武術大会では、\n出撃コストが時間経過で回復しないことも\nし: Also, remember that in this tournament, your deployment cost won't recover over time.
m400465.それから敵を倒しても、EXPやゴールド、\nドロップ品を手に入れることは出来ない: And even if you defeat enemies, you won't earn any EXP, gold, or drops.
m400465.だ、だけど……！！\nチャンプ、本当に大事件なんだよ！！\nなんと、魔界武術大会:
B-but…!!
Champ, it's a huge deal!!
The Demon-World Martial Arts Tournament is finally happening!!
m400465.だから現チャンプらしく、傷つくことを恐れず、\n少しでも多くの挑戦者を倒すことを: So, stay true to the champion's spirit—don't fear getting hurt, and aim to slay as many challengers as you can!
m400465.へぇ、また魔界武術大会が開かれるのかい。\n――ということは王子、\n今回はタイ:
Oh? Another Demon-World Martial Arts Tournament, huh?
—so that means, Prince, this time it's a title-defense match.
m400465.やれやれ、楽しみ過ぎてから回っちゃってるね。\nさて王子、もちろん参加するんだろ:
My, my, you're getting all worked up.
So, Prince, you'll join, right?
m400465.よぉーし、気合入ってきた！\nそれじゃあ王子、魔界武術大会に出発だ！！: Alright, I'm fired up! Then, Prince, off we go to the Demon Martial Arts Tournament!!
m400465.多数の敵と相対する『大討伐ミッション』は\nもちろん知ってるよな？\n今回も基本:
You've heard of the “Massive Hunt Mission,” where you face hordes of enemies, right?
It works the same way this time.
m400465.王子はチャンプとして、\n向かってくる多数の挑戦者を、\nばったばったとなぎ倒さ: As the champ, you'll have to cut down the wave of challengers that comes at you.
m400465.魔界武術大会は名誉ある武の舞台。\nそれを現チャンプが辞退したとなると、\n王子:
The Demon-World Martial Arts Tournament is a prestigious stage for warriors.
If the reigning champ backs out, it'll tarnish not only your honor but also that of your comrades.

m400490.「勝てばオレが『大部族長』へ道が開ける。\n負ければ其方の領内から引き揚げる。悪: “If you win, the path to becoming Great Chieftain opens for me. If you lose, I'll withdraw from your territory. It's not a bad deal, is it? Let's see who's the strongest and duel.”
m400490.「勝手だが、これはオレが大部族長になる試練でもある。\n魔物が領内に滞在している: “It's selfish, but this is also a test for me to become Great Chieftain. If rumors spread that monsters are lingering in your lands, your reputation will suffer as well.”
m400490.「王子よ、其方の度重なる武勇は聞いている。\n魔界でも名を轟かせている王子軍を打: “Prince, I've heard of your repeated feats of valor. If you've defeated the Prince's army that's famed even in the Demon Realm, I could become the Great Chieftain of the orcs.”
m400490.『援軍要請』や、ワルキューレさん達、\nペガサスライダーさん達のような、\nコス: Let's deploy units like “Reinforcement Request,” the Valkyries, and the Pegasus Riders that restore our cost!
m400490.あ…！\nいえ、何かされた訳ではありません……！！\nご心配をおかけしてすみませ: Ah… No, they didn't do anything to me…!! I'm sorry for worrying you.
m400490.それでは、『大討伐ミッション』を開始します！: Now, let's start the Grand Hunt Mission!
m400490.それと、敵を倒してもEXPやゴールド、\nドロップ品を手に入れることも出来ません: Also, you won't receive any EXP, gold, or drops from defeating enemies—so watch out.
m400490.それに加えまして、\n今回のミッション中は出撃コストが回復しません。: Additionally, during this mission, your deployment cost will not recover.
m400490.ただ、王子に言付けをオークの部族長さんから頼まれました。\n…では、そのままお伝: The chieftain asked me to deliver a message to you, so I'll pass it along.
m400490.ですので、一体でも多くの敵を倒す事だけを\n考えて行動させましょう！: So focus solely on killing as many enemies as you can!
m400490.オークさんは魔界にいる方達と聞いています。\n不思議に思い、追いかけて様子を探っ: I've heard they're from the Demon Realm. Curious, I followed them to see what they were up to, and found the orcs setting up a camp inside our lands.
m400490.今回の戦いは\n一人でも多くの敵を倒す事を目的とした\n『大討伐ミッション』です: This fight is a “Grand Hunt Mission,” aimed at slaying as many enemies as possible.
m400490.以上で説明は終わりとなります！: That's the end of the briefing!
m400490.以上になります…。王子、いかがなされますか……？\nもし急に、オークの大軍勢に攻: That's all… Prince, what will you do? If a massive orc army suddenly attacks, it could be very dangerous…
m400490.先程、領内を見回りしていた時に\nオークさんの群れを発見しました。: While patrolling the territory earlier, I came across a herd of orcs.
m400490.大討伐ミッションは通常のミッションとは異なり\n『敵を撃破すること』のみが目的と: Unlike regular missions, the only goal here is to defeat enemies. Forget minimizing our own losses—let's just take them down.
m400490.強そうなオークさんが沢山いたので、\nとっても激しい戦いになると予想します！\n: There are a lot of strong orcs, so I expect a really intense battle! Please, don't be reckless…
m400490.急いで王子に報告するため戻ろうとしたら、\n見つかってしまって……。\nオークの: I rushed back to tell you, but they spotted me… and the orc chieftain captured me.
m400490.更に、今回のミッションは、\nライフが0になってもクリアとなり、それまでに\n倒: Moreover, this mission counts as cleared even if our life reaches zero, and the number of foes you've slain will be recorded as your achievement.
m400490.王子、ご報告があって参りました！: Prince, I have a report for you!
m400490.王子も有名になると、オークさんが魔界から\n戦いに挑んで来たりするのですね……。: It seems that once the Prince becomes famous, even orcs from the demon realm will come to challenge us… Thankfully, they're polite orcs.
m400490.討伐に向かう……ですか。分かりました！\nでは、これからの戦いについて説明を致し: You want to go on a hunt? Understood! Let me explain the upcoming battle.

m500147.……けれども奴の再生の力を上回る\n大きな傷を与えられたのも確かみたい。\n傷を: ...But it seems we did manage to inflict a wound greater than his regenerative power. To heal, he returned to the demon realm once.
m500147.……そうね、あなたならそう言うと思ったわ。\nこれ以上犠牲が増えてしまう前に、\: ...I thought you'd say that. Before more lives are lost, let's go defeat it right away.
m500147.……完全に倒す事は叶わなかったとしても、\n魔神フェネクスの侵攻を止められたこと: ...Even if we couldn't completely defeat him, let's be glad that we stopped Fenex's invasion for now.
m500147.あの地にはフェネクスを神と信奉する民達が\n住んでいた筈。奴に供物を捧げ、奴の行: That place was home to people who worship Fenex as a god. We've even found those who offer sacrifices and aid its actions.
m500147.くっ！ フェネクスの再生の力が\n更に強力に……っ！: Damn! Fenex's regeneration is getting even stronger...!
m500147.ここからが正念場ね。\n……皆、全力で行くわよ！: This is the critical moment. ...Everyone, give it your all!
m500147.しょうがねぇな……ちょっとどいてな！ \n俺の捨て身の力で\n回復する間もなくぶ: Can't be helped... Move aside! With my reckless power, I'll blast them before they can even recover!
m500147.そうですね……例え何度蘇ったとしても、\n王子がいる限り、\n私達は絶対に負けま: Indeed... No matter how many times he resurrects, as long as you, Prince, are with us, we will never lose!
m500147.それじゃ準備が出来次第出発しましょ。\n……と、大切な事を忘れてたわね。: Then, once we're ready, we'll set out. ...Ah, I forgot something important.
m500147.そんな……ただでさえ剣も魔法も\n通じにくいのに、フェネクスの力で\n傷が全く与: No... Even without Fenex, our swords and magic already struggle to work, and now we can't deal any damage at all!
m500147.だ、ダメです！ 我々の攻撃程度では\n普通の魔物でさえ傷が瞬時に再生され\n倒す: No, it's hopeless! Our attacks barely scratch even ordinary monsters—they heal instantly, we can't defeat them!
m500147.なるほど。\n強い一撃を放つ事が出来れば、\n確かに、すぐに敵を倒す事が出来ます: I see. If we can land a strong blow, indeed we can take the enemy down quickly!
m500147.なるほどな……。\nだが、急所をついた一撃ならば……！: I see... But if we land a strike to a vital point...!
m500147.はい。王子、此度の激戦さぞお疲れでしょう。\n今は休み、次の戦いに備え英気を養い:
Yes, Prince. That fierce battle must have exhausted you.
Let's rest now and regain our strength for the next fight.
Good job.
m500147.ふん……無駄だ。\n我が鉄壁の肉体には、\n貴様達の生半可な攻撃は通用しない！: Hmph... futile. My ironclad body won't be affected by your half-hearted attacks!
m500147.フェネクスの強力な再生能力は、\n自身だけでなく奴に与する者達にも\n影響を与え: Fenex's regeneration not only affects itself but also those who serve it, so be careful.
m500147.フェネクスは間違いなく強力な敵……でも、\nだからって勝手に死んだりしたら許さな: Fenex is undoubtedly a strong foe... but that doesn't mean I'll let you die on your own. We'll defeat it and all return together... promise!
m500147.フェネクスを倒しに行く以上、奴を信奉する\n砂漠の民達との戦いは避けられない筈、: Since we're going after Fenex, we can't avoid fighting the desert folk who worship it. Be prepared for that battle as well.
m500147.以前にも一度見かけた事があるでしょう？\n強力な再生能力を持つ、\n青い炎を纏っ: You've seen it before, haven't you? A demon god wrapped in blue flame, with a powerful regeneration ability.
m500147.半端な傷じゃすぐに回復されてしまうわ。\n強力な攻撃で、回復の隙も与えずに\n倒: Minor wounds heal instantly. A powerful attack that leaves no time to recover is the way to go. Don't neglect preparation.
m500147.各地の戦線で度々目撃されてはいたみたいだけど、\n今は随分と長く砂漠に留まったま: It seems it's been spotted on various battlefronts, but now it's lingered in the desert for a long time.

m920045.いけません、グローリアさん！\n心が憎しみで染まっては、また操られてしまいます！: We can't, Gloria! If your heart is stained with hatred, you'll be manipulated again! Let's fall back and let us handle this.
m920045.うっ……。\n別行動中……、奴らの親玉らしき魔物と接触した。: Ugh… While I was on my own… I came into contact with the monster that seems to be the leader.
m920045.お待ちください！ \nあなたが魔物を率いているのですか？: Wait! Are you leading the monsters?
m920045.くそ……。こんな状況なのに、あたしはまた我を\n忘れて魔物に突撃をするところだっ: Damn it… I was about to charge the monsters again, forgetting myself even in this situation. I'm such a disappointment…
m920045.くそっ、この程度で心を奪われるとは……\n修行が足りないのか……。: Damn it, to have my heart stolen so easily… Is my training insufficient…?
m920045.ぐ……、コレデ、終わりデハナイ……。\nモウスグ、グレーターデーモンが、王国を\: Grr… this isn't the end… Soon, the Greater Demon will launch a full-scale assault on the kingdom…!
m920045.ここには私が建てた孤児院があるんだ。\n私の数少ない大事なものだからな。\nそれ: This is the orphanage I built. It's one of my few precious things. More importantly, you—if you keep fighting like that, it's dangerous.
m920045.このまま突撃してもいいけど……、\nここは慎重に進んだ方が\nいいだろうねぇ。: I could just charge straight ahead, but… it'd be wiser to proceed cautiously here.

m920045.さっそく現れたようだね……。\nだけどワシが相手をするのはまだ早い。\nお前たち: Looks like they showed up right away… But it's still too early for me to step in. You all, I'll leave the rest to you.
m920045.しかし今回の襲撃……。魔物は直接住民を\n狙っているように見えました。王国の警戒: But this raid… The monsters seemed to be targeting the villagers directly. We might need to tighten the kingdom's defenses.
m920045.そうですね。\nまずは強敵を一体倒すことができました。\nさ、城に戻りましょう。: That's right. We managed to take down a formidable foe. Now, let's return to the castle.
m920045.そこらの魔物のように暴れることもない。: It won't rampage like the other monsters.
m920045.その力を利用しようとしたんだろうさ。: They probably tried to exploit that power.
m920045.それに、あんたらと戦っているとき、\nはっきりと覚えちゃいないが王子軍のやつらが: And when I was fighting you all, I can't recall clearly, but I felt like everyone in the Prince's army looked like monsters.
m920045.それに、魔物は『奥義』と口にしていました。\n用心してください。: Also, the monster mentioned an “ultimate technique.” Be on your guard.

m920045.だが、後悔するよりも前に進むことを選んだ。\n今は少しでも私のような子供を増やさ: But I chose to move forward rather than drown in regret. Now I run an orphanage in the forest so no child suffers as I did, spending each day atoning for my crimes.
m920045.ちっ……。\nあたしとしたことが魔物に操られるとは……。\n無様だな……。: Damn… To think I'd be controlled by a monster… How pathetic…
m920045.どうやら敵に鎧の魔物もいるみたいね。\n鎧の魔物には魔法が有効よ、王子。: It seems the enemy also has armored monsters. Magic works against armored monsters, Prince.
m920045.なんとか片付きましたね。\nしかし先ほど兵士から別の場所にも現れたと\n報せがあ: We managed to deal with it, but the soldier just reported another monster appeared elsewhere. We should hurry.
m920045.ひとまずここは一旦王城へ戻りましょう。: For now, let's head back to the castle.

m920045.ふむ……。人間などちっぽけで愚かな存在だと\n思っていたが、こうして恐怖におのの: Hmm… I always thought humans were tiny, foolish beings, but watching them quake in terror like this is truly entertaining…
m920045.ふんっ、今更こいつが何匹来ようが同じだ。\n今のあたしなら負けねぇ！: Hmph, it doesn't matter how many show up now. I won't lose!

m920045.もし何か守りたいと思うものを見つけたなら、\nもう大丈夫だ。: Once you find something you truly want to protect, you'll be alright.
m920045.やつの声を聞けば聞くほど、心の中の\n憎しみが増していって……、気付けば意識が\: The more I hear its voice, the more hatred builds in my heart… before I knew it, I lost consciousness…
m920045.やはり、先に戦っていたのは\nユリナさんだったんですね。\nどうして一人で戦って: So it was Yurina who was fighting first after all. How did you manage to fight alone…?

m920045.わかった。\n私も初めは暗黒騎士団の一人だった。: Understood. I was once a member of the Dark Knights myself.

m920045.グローリアさん、ユリナさん、\n魔物は私たちに任せて\nお二人は特訓に集中してく: Gloria-san, Yurina-san, leave the monsters to us and focus on the training.
m920045.グローリアさん、落ち着いてください！\nこれからは私たちがサポートします。\n一: Gloria-san, calm down! We'll support you from now on. Let's go together.

m920045.丁度いいところに王子もやってきたようだね。\nさぁ、戦うが良いよ。: Looks like the Prince showed up at just the right moment. Come on, fight!

m920045.何かを大事に思う強い心があれば、\n魔の力に打ち勝つことはできるはずだ。: If you have a strong heart that cherishes something, you can overcome the power of evil.

m920045.修行の旅に出て、一人前になったらこの国に\n戻ってくる。: Once I've become a true warrior, I'll come back to this land.

m920045.先ほどの戦い方では、魔物を憎む気持ちが\n強すぎるがゆえ、心に隙ができて\n操ら: The way you fought earlier shows your hatred of the monsters is too strong, leaving a gap in your heart that lets them control you.
m920045.先日、あたしの国は魔物の軍団に襲われてね。\nあっという間に国は滅びた……。: The other day, my kingdom was attacked by a horde of monsters. In an instant, the nation fell…

m920045.王子、私たちも加勢しましょう！: Prince, let's lend our support too!

m920045.私の大事なものを、これ以上奪わせないっ……！: I won't let anyone take what's precious to me any longer…!

m920045.自分でいうのもなんだが、あたしの国じゃそれなりに\n名の知れた剣士でね。この大剣: I may be bragging, but back home I'm a fairly renowned swordswoman. With this greatsword and my ultimate technique, I've buried countless monsters.
m920045.襲い掛かってくる以上致し方ありません。\n迎撃致しましょう！: Since they're attacking, we have no choice. Let's intercept them!

m920045.雪山の住人から山奥のイエティたちが\n暴れたとの報告ですが。\nここがその報告に: We've received reports that Yetis from deep within the mountains are rampaging. This appears to be the location mentioned.

m920045.魔物をせん滅することに無我夢中だったせいか、\nいつの間にか意識が遠のいて……気: I was so obsessed with wiping out the monsters that I lost track of myself… before I knew it, I was fighting you.
m920045.魔獣オルトロスもいるし、すぐに見つかるだろう。\n普段は凶暴で手がつけられないが: With the beast Orthros around, I'll find it soon enough. It's usually ferocious and uncontrollable, but if we forge a bond, it'll obey us.
m920045.（目に生気が……）\nそのまま、気持ちを強く持って。\n大丈夫だ。私たちがいる。: (Her eyes spark with life…) Keep that resolve. It'll be alright—we're here with you.

m920072.……すまない、情けないところを見せたね……。\nもう大丈夫だ。それにこれからの一: …I'm sorry, I showed you my weak side… It's okay now. And thinking about the clan and the forest ahead, we don't have time to mourn.

(If it comes to this, I'll do whatever it takes—no matter the cost—to find a way to bring the Prince down…)
