m920072.あの編成や布陣から察するに、\n相手も後がないということでしょうね……。\n王子: Judging by their formation and deployment, they've got nowhere to fall back… Prince, please lead us cautiously!
m920072.あの見た目や言動から察するに、\n彼らが教団の者たちのようですね……。: Judging by their appearance and behavior, they must be members of the cult…
m920072.あまりゆっくりはしていられませんね。\n王子、急いでベルゼビュートの捜索を進めま: We can't afford to linger. Prince, let's hurry and continue the search for Belzebuth.
m920072.いずれにせよ、まだまだ気は抜けませんね……。\n王子、森の中の案内は引き続き任せ: Either way, we can't let our guard down. Prince, leave the forest navigation to me!
m920072.いや……イヤぁッ……はな、してっ……！\nこんなの、絶対におかしい……！\nコレ: No… Noooo… Let me go…! This is wrong… Absolutely wrong… This isn't the god we believed in…
m920072.うまく、彼女達との戦闘を避けて\nベルゼビュートだけを倒す事が出来れば\n良いの: If we can avoid fighting them and take down Beelzebuth alone, that would be ideal…
m920072.おかげさまでね……けど本当に危ないところだった。\nまさか私の信じていた神が\n: Thanks to you… but it was truly dangerous. I never imagined the god we trusted was a monster that feeds on people…
m920072.おそらく、彼女達は\nベルゼビュートを守護する一族の末裔だと思います。: I think they're descendants of the clan that protects Belzebuth.
m920072.お前ら一族のような少人数の信者だけでは、\nベルゼビュート様の糧とは成り得ないと: A small group of believers like your clan can't serve as Belzebuth's sustenance.
m920072.お前達のせいでベルゼビュート様の居場所が\n森の外の者達に知れ渡ってしまったんだ: Because of you, Lord Belzebuth's whereabouts have been exposed to those outside the forest! How do you intend to take responsibility? Answer me!
m920072.お喋りはそこまでだ。\nこれ以上、この森に立ち入る事は許さん！: That's enough chatter. You're not allowed to set foot in this forest any further!
m920072.かなりの深手を負っているはずですし、\nあの傷ではもう何も出来ることはないでしょ: They're badly wounded; with those injuries they can't do anything now. Our priority should be treating the wounded.
m920072.くそ……。\nこのままではベルゼビュート様が、\n奴らの手に……。: Damn… If this keeps up, Lord Belzebuth will fall into their hands…
m920072.こ……このさなぎが、ベルゼビュート様……？\n伝え聞く姿とは随分と違うように見え: Th… this cocoon is Lord Belzebuth…? He looks quite different from the descriptions we've heard.
m920072.ここにいる者すべてで互いに協力しなくては、\nやつらを倒せないのは明白だ……。: It's obvious we can't defeat them unless everyone here works together.
m920072.ここは退くのです、ベルゼビュート様……！\n我ら配下が、貴方様を必ず真の姿への復: We must retreat, Lord Belzebuth… We, your subordinates, will guide you back to your true form… Come, let's go… Bubu!
m920072.ずいぶんと森の中を進んできましたが、\nまだまだベルゼビュートの居場所までは\n: We've pushed quite deep into the woods, but it still seems far from Belzebuth's whereabouts.
m920072.そ、そんな……ベルゼビュート様が……、\n動かない……くっ、うぅぅ……。\n守り: N-no… Lord Belzebuth… won't move… damn, ugh… I couldn't keep him safe…
m920072.そうだな……。\n早く皆にこのことを伝えないと、\nベルゼビュート様が危ない……: Yeah… We have to tell everyone quickly, or Lord Belzebuth will be in danger…
m920072.そうだな。ベルゼビュート様は強い神だ。\nお亡くなりになっても、\nずっと我々を: That's right. Lord Belzebuth is a mighty god. Even in death, he'll keep watching over us.
m920072.そうですね。\n少しの間しか相対していませんが、\nあの盲信ぶりは常軌を逸してい: Indeed. We only faced them briefly, but that blind devotion is beyond reason…
m920072.それでは、帰還しましょう王子。\nこの度の遠征、本当にお疲れ様でした。:
Well then, let's head back, Prince.
Thank you for all your hard work on this expedition.
m920072.そんな事を言っているから、\nベルゼビュート様がいつまで経っても\n復活できない: That's why you can't understand why Belzebuth can never be revived.
m920072.だ、ダメだ……もう終わりだ……。\nベルゼビュート様を、御守りすることは、\n私: No… it's over… We can't protect Lord Belzebuth… *sob*
m920072.ですが、魔神ベルゼビュートの復活が近いというのは、\n確かな情報筋から入手してい: Still, we've received reliable intel that Beelzebuth's revival is imminent. We can't just stand by.
m920072.ど、どういうことなんだ……？\nおい、説明しろ！: Wh-what does this mean…? Hey, explain it!
m920072.どうしたら……ああ、どうしたらいいのだ……。\nこのままではベルゼビュート様の復: How… how can we…? If this keeps up, Lord Belzebuth's revival… Aida, what should we do…?
m920072.どうやら、退けられたようですね。\n……ですが、何だか少しだけ怖かったです。: It seems they've been driven back. …But somehow it was a little scary.
m920072.なんてことを……！？\n王子、アイーダさんを助けましょう！: What…!? Prince, we must save Aida!
m920072.はい、ありがとうございます！\n私達も、アイーダさんの力になれることがあれば\n: Yes, thank you! If there's anything we can do to help you, we'd gladly cooperate!
m920072.はい。\n手に入れた情報の中に、\n思い当たるものがあります。: Yes. Among the intel we've obtained, there's something that matches.
m920072.ふむ……ここが『魔の森』か。\nなるほど、確かに不穏な空気に満ちているね。: Hmm… so this is the “Cursed Forest.” I can feel the unsettling atmosphere all around.
m920072.また、魔の森は古くからの伝承で、\n魔が取りつくと言われている為、\n人が近づく: The forest has been rumored since ancient times to be possessed by demons, so outsiders rarely venture near.
m920072.みんな……助けてくれて、ありがとう……。: Everyone… thank you for saving me…
m920072.やはり来ましたね……。\n王子、戦いの準備をお願いします。: As expected, they've arrived… Prince, please prepare for battle.
m920072.わかりました。\nそれでは王子、\n一先ず落ち着ける場所に移動しましょう。: Understood. Then, Prince, let's move to a place where we can settle down for now.
m920072.アイーダ達が敗れた今、\nベルゼビュート様を守ることができるのは\n我々しかいな: Now that Aida and the others have fallen, we're the only ones who can protect Lord Belzebuth… we alone…
m920072.アンタ達は命の恩人だ。\nもし困ったときは力になるよ。\nだから、いつでも声をか: You all saved my life. If you ever need help, I'll be there. So, just call on me anytime.
m920072.クソ……私達が長い間信じてきたものが、\nあんなおぞましいものだったなんて、\n: Damn… the thing we've believed in for so long turned out to be that hideous… If only this were a bad dream… I wish I'd wake up…
m920072.ハァ……ハァ……ば、バカな……！？\n我らの信仰心が足りないというのか……？\n: Ha… ha… this… this can't be…! Is our faith not enough…? To be defeated here… unthinkable…
m920072.バシラさんが入手した情報によると、\nこの森の奥に魔神ベルゼビュートが\n潜んで: According to Bashira's intel, a demon god named Beelzebuth is lurking deep within these woods.
m920072.ブブッ……。\nベルゼビュート様の為だ、\n私も戦闘に参加する……ブブッ。: Bubu… For Lord Belzebuth, I'll join the fight too… Bubu.
m920072.ブブッ……。\nベルゼビュート様を運ぶのだ……ブブッ！\n（こうなれば……もはや: Bubu… we have to carry Lord Belzebuth… Bubu! (If it comes to this… we have no choice but to use them as food)
m920072.ブブッ……どうした、アイーダ？\n何を怖がることがある……？\nベルゼビュート様: Bubu… what's wrong, Aida? What are you scared of…? You could become his nourishment.
m920072.ブブッ……やめないか、二人とも……。\n仲間割れをしている場合ではないだろう。\: Bubu… can't you both stop…? This isn't the time for infighting. Look, the enemy's right up there… Bubu.
m920072.ブブッ……ベルゼビュート様も、\n我らが力を合わせて戦うことを\nきっと望んでお: Bubu… Lord Belzebuth surely wants us to join forces… Bubu.
m920072.ブブッ……分からぬ……。\nだが、ベルゼビュート様に異変が起きていることは\n確: Bubu… I don't understand… But something's definitely wrong with Lord Belzebuth. We must get to him at once!
m920072.ブブッ……愚かな。\n自らの生きる意味を忘れるとは……。\n我らに仕えた一族の末: Bubu… Foolish. To forget the meaning of your own life… I can't believe you're the descendant of the clan that served us… Bubu.
m920072.ブブッ……早すぎたのだ……。\nまだ完全に復活する程のエネルギーを、\n充分に供: Bubu… we were too early… We couldn't supply enough energy for a full revival yet…
m920072.ベルゼビュートが復活……！？\n王子、急ぎ彼らを追いかけましょう！: Belzebuth revived…!? Prince, let's hurry after them!
m920072.ベルゼビュートの伝承や、その強大な力を目当てに\n森の人間以外の者たちが流入した: It's entirely possible that outsiders, drawn by Belzebuth's legends and his great power, have poured into the forest…
m920072.ベルゼビュートの命は\nもはや尽きたと思いましたが……。\n何を企んでいるのでし: I thought Belzebuth's life had already run out… What are they planning…?
m920072.ベルゼビュート様……どうかお許しください！\n今この時だけは、敵に背を向けること: Lord Belzebuth… please forgive us! Just this once, let us turn our backs on the enemy… please, please forgive us…!
m920072.ベルゼビュート様が……！\nそうだ、目的が同じであれば、我々は仲間同士\nである: Lord Belzebuth…! That's right—if our goals are the same, we should be allies. How did we not see that before!
m920072.ベルゼビュート様に仇なそうと企む\nお前たちのような賊を狩る者だ。: I'm the one who hunts rogues like you who dare plot against Lady Beelzebuth.
m920072.ベルゼビュート様に新たな僕などいらない。\n古くからお仕えする私達一族だけで十分: Lord Belzebuth doesn't need any new servants. Our clan, who have served since ancient times, is more than enough.
m920072.ベルゼビュート達が撤退していきます！\nこのまま追撃しますか……？: The Belzebuth forces are withdrawing! Shall we pursue them…?
m920072.一説によれば、絶大な力を有するベルゼビュートを、\n神と崇めることで彼女達の一族: It's said that by venerating the immensely powerful Beelzebuth as a god, their clan maintains a strong sense of community.
m920072.今はとにかく、魔の森を捜索して、\nベルゼビュートの居場所を探すしかないですね。: For now, we have no choice but to scour the forest and locate Beelzebuth's lair. I'll do everything I can to find it quickly!
m920072.伝承によれば千年戦争の際に、\nベルゼビュートと共に戦った者たちを祖先に持つと\: According to legend, their ancestors fought alongside Beelzebuth during the Millennium War.
m920072.何が何でもベルゼビュートを復活させようと\n思っているのでしょうね……。\n魔神: They'll do anything to bring Belzebuth back… even though they're supposed to be demons…
m920072.何だと……ッ！？\n新参者のくせに大きな口を叩きやがって……！\nこの森から早く: What the—! You newcomers talk big… Get out of this forest!
m920072.先ほどの侵入者どもか。\nベルゼビュート様を何としても守らなくては……。\n一番: Those intruders from earlier… We must protect Lord Belzebuth at all costs… We, the best of us, will definitely slay them!
m920072.先ほどは、私達の事を敵とみなしていましたし……、\n森の外の人間の私達とは、話も: Earlier they regarded us as enemies… and it doesn't look like they'll even talk to us, outsiders from beyond the woods.
m920072.前線の兵士の報告によると、\n敵側はベルゼビュートが復活したと\n騒いでいたよう: Front-line reports say the enemy side was shouting that Belzebuth had revived!
m920072.千年戦争の際に封印された力は、\n未だ完全に取り戻せてはいないとも聞いています。: I've also heard that the power sealed during the Millennium War hasn't been fully reclaimed yet. If we're going to defeat Beelzebuth, now's our chance!
m920072.報告！\n前方から敵が進軍してきます！: Report! Enemy troops are advancing from the front!
m920072.彼女達の部族は、\n魔の森に古くから棲みつく魔神ベルゼビュートを\n尊き神として: Their tribe has long worshipped Beelzebuth, who dwells in this cursed forest, as a holy deity.
m920072.心配ですね。\n王子、念のために、彼らの後を追いましょう。: That's worrisome. Prince, let's follow them just in case.
m920072.恐らく……危険が迫っているのを察して、\n自らさなぎの状態での復活を\n選ばれた: Likely… sensing the danger, he chose to revive in a cocoon state…
m920072.改めて、私が聞いた情報をお伝えします。\n先ほど戦った人達は、魔神ベルゼビュート: Let me reiterate the information I've gathered. The people we just fought are likely descendants of the clan that once guarded the demon god Beelzebuth.
m920072.教団のヤツら……？\n彼女の一族以外にも、\nこの森に仲間がいるのでしょうか？: The cultists…? Does that mean there are allies in this forest besides her clan?
m920072.敵が一斉に攻めてきます！\n王子、何としてでもここでベルゼビュートを\n倒しまし: The enemies are charging all at once! Prince, we have to take him down here, no matter what!
m920072.敵が戦闘態勢に入りました！\n王子、戦いの準備をお願いします！: The enemy has taken battle stance! Prince, prepare for combat!
m920072.敵の撤退を確認！\n全軍、森の奥へと退いていきます。: Enemy retreat confirmed! All forces, fall back deeper into the forest.
m920072.来るな……来るなぁぁあッ！？\n誰か、助けて……誰か……！: Don't come… Don't come!!! Someone, help me… anyone…!
m920072.王子、ご覧下さい！\nあそこにアイーダさん達がいます！: Prince, look! Aida and the others are over there!
m920072.王子、今後の進軍の為にも、\n私に彼女の一族に関する話をさせてください。: Prince, for the sake of our future advance, let me tell you about her lineage.
m920072.王子軍を森に引き寄せてしまった事は詫びよう。\nだが、これもベルゼビュート様への: We apologize for drawing the Prince's forces into the forest. But this is also necessary to spread devotion to Lord Belzebuth… it couldn't be helped.
m920072.王子！\nアイーダさん達がベルゼビュートを\n抱えて逃げていきます！: Prince! Aida and the others are lugging Belzebuth and fleeing!
m920072.終わりだ……全て終わってしまったのだ……。\n我らの神は死んだ……。: It's over… everything's over… Our god is dead…
m920072.見ていてください、ベルゼビュート様……！\n我らこそが貴方様の一番の僕であること: Watch us, Lord Belzebuth…! We'll prove right here and now that we are your most devoted servants!
m920072.貴様たちがベルゼビュート様の\n復活を阻止しようとしている者か……。: So you're the ones trying to stop Lord Belzebuth's resurrection…
m920072.貴様の一族もはるか昔にこうして\nベルゼビュート様に身体を差し出したものだ……。: Your clan, long ago, offered their bodies to Lord Belzebuth like this… Now fulfill your clan's duty… Bubu!
m920072.運ぶ？ そうか、確かにベルゼビュート様が\n安らかに眠れるよう、埋葬しなければな: Carry him? I see, we must bury Lord Belzebuth so he can rest in peace…
m920072.（ベルゼビュート様……ご安心ください。\n私が、一族の誇りにかけて、\n必ず貴方: (Lord Belzebuth… fear not. I swear on my clan's honor, I'll protect you to the very end…!)

m920087.――「お初」にお目にかかります、ぬらりひょん様。\n妖怪総大将シノ様の配下の妖怪: “It's an honor to finally meet you,” I say, Nurarihyon. I am Kasumi, a subordinate monster of General Shino.
m920087.――お、お花見中の所失礼致します！\n桜の姿をした魔物が出現しました！: —Excuse me for interrupting the hanami! A monster that looks like a cherry blossom has appeared!
m920087.――こちらがぬらりひょんの没した地です。: ——Here is the place where Nululihyon met his end.
m920087.――ごくろうだったネェ、妖怪娘。\n気配を消せるオマエが、首尾よく結界を\n破壊:
???: —You've worked hard, yokai girl.
Because you can erase your presence, you nicely destroyed the barrier, letting us finally get into the village.
m920087.――さぁ娘たち。将来私のように立派な\n女王になるためにも、しっかり花嫁修業に励: Now, daughters, study hard if you ever want to become queens like me. Today's lesson… is puppetry!
m920087.――さぁ陰陽師、その命尽き果てるまで、\n鬼門に力を注ぎ続けるといいヨ！: ――Now, onmyōji, keep pouring your power into the Demon Gate until your life runs out!
m920087.――せいっ！ ……拙者の封妖手裏剣の前には、\n妖怪など敵ではありませんね。\n:
――Sei! …Before my sealing shuriken, there's no such thing as a youkai enemy.
That should have taken care of all the youkai, right?
m920087.――それでは皆さん、人の畏れを集めましょうか。\nくれぐれも、村の人達に怪我させ: ???: ――Then everyone, let's gather some “fear” from people. Just be sure not to scare the villagers enough to hurt them, okay?
m920087.――ぬらりひょんさん、敵として相対していた頃とは\nまるで別人のようでしたね。: —Nurarihyon, you seemed like a completely different person compared to when we faced you as an enemy.
m920087.――ふむ……これは……しっかりとした香りの奥に\n確かな味わい、それでいて飲みや: …Hmm… this has a solid aroma, a definite flavor, and it's easy to drink… …a fine sake indeed.
m920087.――んもうっ！ そういう訳には行かないのっ！\n大切な親友でライバルの前よ、\n: —Enough! I can't just stand by! In front of my dear friend and rival, I can't show up looking like this.
m920087.――ゴブリンクイーンの娘達……彼女達も\n操り術が使えるようですね。今後も注意し: —The Goblin Queen's daughters... they can use manipulation magic too, it seems. We'll need to keep an eye on them, Prince.
m920087.――！\nよ、妖怪！？\n王子、妖怪が現れました！:
――!
A youkai!?
Prince, a youkai has appeared!
m920087.――！ な、なんでぇありゃ！？\nでっけー門がいきなり現れやがったぞ！: ――! Wh-what the—?! A massive gate just appeared out of nowhere!
m920087.…………ぅう……。\n頭が痛い……。ここは一体……。: ………Ugh… My head hurts… Where am I…?
m920087.……あの巨鬼、確かに大きな気を放ってはいますが、\n一体の持つ気の強さはそこまで: …That giant demon's certainly radiating a huge amount of ki, but its actual ki strength doesn't seem that impressive. It's probably because the soul-stealer was split.
m920087.……あら？ 皆さん、お久しぶりです。\nその節は大変お世話になりました。:
…Oh? Everyone, long time no see.
Thank you for all your help back then.
m920087.……お二人に任せておけばひとまず\n鬼門は大丈夫そうですね。コヨミさん、\n無事: …If we leave it to you two, the gate should hold for now. Koyomi, I'm so glad you made it back safely.
m920087.……このままでは村に大変な被害が及びます。\nまずはこの場をなんとかする事が先決: …If this continues, the village will suffer terrible damage. First, we have to deal with this situation.
m920087.……この場は一旦、戦ってコヨミさんを\n無力化するしかなさそうですね。: …It seems our only option is to fight here and neutralize Koyomi.
m920087.……ってごめんなさい、\n昔話をしにきたんじゃなかったわね！: …Oops, sorry, I wasn't here to tell a story!
m920087.……でも、すっかり力を使っちゃったから、\n私一人の力じゃ鬼門を完全に封印するの: …But I've used up all my strength, so sealing the Demon Gate on my own is going to be tough…
m920087.……は、はんっ！ 酒呑童子がなんだってんだ！\n一度倒した相手だ、\n何度でもぶ: …H-ha! What the heck is the Wine Cellar Boy! He's an opponent I've beaten before, and I'll crush him again and again!
m920087.……はい！ カスミ、これより\nシノ様の百鬼夜行に入らせて頂きます！\nよろしく: …Yes! From now on, I'll join General Shino's Hundred Night Parade! Please take care of me!
m920087.……ふぅむ。なるほどのぅ、鬼門が開いている間なら\n地上界に肉体を再現する事も可: …Hmm. I see… While the demon gate is open, it might be possible to recreate a physical body in the human realm… Huh? Oh, there's Shino… what the—!?
m920087.……やめておいたほうが良いかと。\n鬼門を通っての移動など、聞いた事がありません: …I'd advise against it. I've never heard of traveling via a demon gate. It's probably only possible because of that hermit's power.
m920087.……カスミ……とやら。\n百鬼夜行に入ったお前の覚悟、よう伝わった。\nこれから: …Kasumi, is it? I can feel your resolve since you joined the Hundred Night Parade. Continue to aid General Shino's hand.
m920087.……以前よりも強力な霊符術……！\nこのままでは本当にコヨミさんの命が危ない……: …A more powerful spirit-seal technique than before…! If this keeps up, Koyomi's life is truly in danger…!
m920087.……先ほどまでこちらにいたのに……どうやら\n鬼門を通り移動をしているようですね: …She was just here a moment ago… It seems she's moving through the demon gate.
m920087.……剥がした人は正直に\n名乗り出てください。: …If you took them off, please step forward and own up.
m920087.……勝機はあるかもしれませんね。\nここで逃げてはコヨミさんも都も無事では済みま: …There might still be a chance. If we run now, Koyomi and the capital won't be safe. Prince, please get ready for battle!
m920087.……彼女の力を借りるのは不本意ですが、\n事態が事態ですので、そうも言っていられ: …I'm reluctant to ask for her help, but given the circumstances, I have no choice.
m920087.……普段お世話になっているシノさんの頼みを\n無下にもできませんね。わかりました: …I can't just turn down Shino's request, especially since she's always helped us. Very well. Prince, please make the preparations.
m920087.……行ってしまわれました。\nあの、退治しなくても\n本当に大丈夫なのですか？:
... They've gone.
Um, is it really okay not to exterminate them?
m920087.……辛い事を思い出させてしまいすみません。\n鬼門の封印、頼りにさせて頂きますね:
…I'm sorry for bringing up painful memories.
I'll rely on you to seal the demon gate.
m920087.……！ ね、ねえさ……あ、いえ、総大将シノ様も\nご一緒だったのですね。失礼しま: ……! Hey, uh… oh, I see General Shino is also here. My apologies, I'm Kasumi. I'm just a lowly monster from the frontier…
m920087.あ、そうだミコト。少しだけあの娘たちの相手をしてくれ\nないかしら。初めて戦う貴: Ah, Mikoto, could you spare a moment to deal with those girls? Since it's your first battle, they'll get their “fear” quickly and head back right away.
m920087.ああ、妖怪総大将に二言などない。\nカスミ、今日からお前もぬらりひょんの、\n私: Yes, a monster General doesn't need second-guessing. Kasumi, from today you're also of the Nurarihyon—my—family!
m920087.あっさりと洗脳が解けちゃうなんて。\n三人とも、まだまだ未熟ねぇ。: How disappointing—your brainwash fell apart so easily. You three are still so inexperienced.
m920087.あと、結界を破壊したですって！？\n村全体に術を施すの、どれだけ\n面倒だと思っ:
And you destroyed the barrier, huh!?
Do you realize how troublesome it is to cast a spell over the whole village!?
m920087.あのアンデッドは落ち武者ですね。体力が減る程に\nその攻撃は熾烈さを増します。カ: That undead is an Ochimusha. The lower its HP, the more ferocious its attacks become. I'll evacuate the villagers, so please be careful, everyone.
m920087.あの仙人、妖天君でしたっけ？ アイツがまたいつ\n現れるかも判らないしね。\n鬼: That hermit… was it Yotenkun? We never know when he'll show up again. If it's about the Demon Gate, leave it to me!
m920087.あの娘、姿を消す事ができたのね。: So she could make herself disappear, huh.
m920087.あの子ってば昔っからそうなのよぉ～！\n子供の頃は妹みたいに私に懐いてたんだけど: That kid's been like that forever! When we were little she clung to me like a little sister. Ah, those memories…
m920087.あの時の仲間がいれば詳しく判りそうだけど、\n都の襲撃で陰陽寮の仲間はもう……ね:
If those comrades were still around we'd know for sure, but after the capital's attack the Onmyoji Dormitory members are… gone.
Ah, but if it's a demon gate, I can seal it with my talisman, so don't worry!
m920087.あの門……もしかすると「鬼門」やもしれぬ。: That gate… could it be a “Demon Gate”?
m920087.あら？ あなた達は……まさかミコトのお友達！？ \nよかった～！ 私以外のお友達: Oh? You two… are you friends of Mikoto!? Yay! So I have friends besides me! Hey, why don't you come over to my house? I've got some tasty tea sweets!
m920087.あら？ あの娘達ってば……また来てるのね。\n何度も来たら、みんな馴れちゃって\: Oh? Those girls… they're back again. If they kept coming, everyone would get used to them and stop feeling any fear…
m920087.あら？ ミコト……それに皆さんも。\n……なんとなくだけど思い出してきたわ。\n: Oh? Mikoto… and everyone else. …I've got a vague memory returning. I guess I've caused you all a lot of trouble…
m920087.ありがと……でも、あの鬼門を放っておく訳にも\nいかないでしょ。この始末はちゃん: Thanks… but we can't just leave that Demon Gate unchecked. I have to deal with it properly! I'll wipe that gate out in a flash… Gah!
m920087.あれは……コヨミさん！\n良かった無事だったのですね！: That's… Koyomi! Thank goodness she's alright!
m920087.あれ？ あそこにいるのは先ほどの\nカスミさん……と呼ばれてた娘ではないでしょう: Huh? Isn't that the girl they were calling Kasumi earlier?
m920087.あれ？ 陰陽師のお姉さんと……猫娘さん……？\nあ、畏れでしたら余ってますのでも:
Huh? The onmyōji lady and… the cat-girl…?
Ah, if you're scared I have some leftovers, so if you'd like…
m920087.あんなに操りやすそうな相手でしたのに……。\n私はまだまだですね。もっと精進致し: Even though she was such an easy target... I'm still not good enough. I'll train even harder.
m920087.い、いつの間に王子の後ろに！\nそれに今、本気で首をはねようと……\n……！？:
W-when did you get behind the Prince!?
And now you're actually trying to behead me…
…!?
m920087.い、一体何を……ぐッ……\n力が……抜けて……！: W-what… ggh… my strength… it's draining…!
m920087.いえ、不仲という訳ではないのです。\nただ彼女と私は数少ない女陰陽師として、\n: It's not that we're unfriendly. She and I have been rivals for years, being two of the few female onmyōji.
m920087.いえ、私はお酒は飲みませんので。\n……それにしても本当に見事な桜です。\n本来: No, I don't drink alcohol. …Nevertheless, the cherry blossoms are truly splendid. Under normal circumstances, this would herald a bountiful year.
m920087.いつも何でも一人でやっちゃうあなたが私を\n頼りに来てくれて、すっごくうれしかっ: You always do everything alone, so when you came to rely on me, I was thrilled. Just let me get dressed properly!
m920087.いや、今の総大将はシノじゃ。それに現世に\n留まれるのは鬼門が開いてる間のみ……: No, the current Grand General is Shino. And we can only stay in the mortal realm while the demon gate is open… So, humans, could you do me a favor?
m920087.いりません！ この間違われ方、\nなんだかどこかで……。:
I don't need it! This mistaken identity…
Somehow feels like… somewhere…
m920087.う……ああ……陰の気が、\n体に………………。: U… ah… the shadow energy… entering my body…
m920087.うむ。そこにおるシノ、カスミと共に百鬼夜行に挑みたい。\nその相手をしてもらえん: Yes. I want you, Shino, and Kasumi to take on the Hundred Night Parade. Will you face it with me? The Parade exists to gather fear, and it can't function without opponents.
m920087.えぇ～！？ \n魔除けの霊符を貼っておいたはずなのに、\n一体どういうことよぉ～: What?! I thought we'd put up protective talismans, so what the heck is going on!!
m920087.お、お久しぶりです、コヨミさん。相変わらず\nお元気……すぎるようで、何よりです: Uh, long time no see, Koyomi-san. You're as lively… maybe a bit too lively as always, which is great. Um, could you stop hugging me and step back, please?
m920087.おかしいわねぇ～。\n魔除けの霊符はちゃんと……\n……って、あら？ おかしいわ: That's odd… The protective talismans were properly… Wait, what? That's strange.
m920087.お前も妖怪なら私の百鬼夜行に入らぬか？\n辺境では仲間も少ないだろう。\n我がぬ: Since you're a monster, why don't you join my Hundred Night Parade? You must be short on allies out there. Consider yourself welcomed as a member of my Nurarihyon family.
m920087.お待ちくださいモーティマさん！ \n鬼門に逃げたヤツを追うのは危険です！: Please wait, Mortimer! Chasing after the one who fled through the Demon Gate is too dangerous!
m920087.お待ちくだされアンナ殿！ 何やら\n様子がおかしいようでござる！: Please wait, Lady Anna! Something about the situation seems off!
m920087.お母様。操り術でしたら私はとっくに\nマスターしてるわ。誰だって操って見せるわよ: Mother, I've already mastered puppetry. I'll show you how I can control anyone.
m920087.お父さま……ご報告です。\nお父さまが亡くなられて以降、姉さまは\n立派に総大将:
Father… I have a report.
Since you passed away, my sister has admirably taken on the role of Grand General.
m920087.お話中のところ失礼致します！ 陰陽師の方よりの\n言伝です、陰の気が集まっており: Excuse us for interrupting! We have a report from the onmyōji—dark energy is gathering, a demon gate may appear, so stay on guard… Ah, ah!
m920087.お話中の所失礼。配下の忍より\n妖天君、それとコヨミ殿が都に現れたとの\n報告で: Excuse my intrusion. Our ninja reports that Yōten-kun and Lady Koyomi have appeared in the capital.
m920087.き、鬼門ですと！ フドウ殿、それは確かでしょうか！？\n鬼門といえば、妖怪達の棲:
D-Demon Gate! Lord Fudou, are you sure!?
A Demon Gate is said to be a portal to the other world where youkai dwell!
Why would such a thing appear here…?
m920087.くっ……また力が……。これでは、\n敵の攻撃を受けきれない……っ！: Damn… My strength is fading again. I can't even withstand the enemy's attacks…!
m920087.こちらが陰陽師、コヨミさんが住む村です。: This is the village where the onmyōji, Koyomi, lives.
m920087.こんな所に鬼門とは……全く、少しは\n場を弁えてほしいものだがな。気をつけろ、: A demon gate here… Seriously, you could at least be a bit more aware of your surroundings. Stay sharp—monsters are coming out of it! …What!?
m920087.こんな時だからこそ、たまには息抜きも必要よ！\nミコトも張りつめすぎないように…: Times like these call for a little break! Mikoto, don't stress yourself out too much, okay?
m920087.ごめんなさぁーい。良い男だったからある程度は\n自我を残した方が面白そうだったか: S-sorry! He was a good guy, so I thought leaving some of his will would be more fun… Guess I didn't control him well enough.
m920087.ごめんなさいですわ。もっとお母さまに近づけるよう\n努力致しますので……三女、貴: I'm sorry. I'll work even harder to get closer to Mother... Third Daughter, you too! Keep pushing yourselves!
m920087.ご苦労様です。ですが、まんまと\nコヨミさんを連れ去られてしまいましたね。: Good work. But unfortunately they've managed to snatch Koyomi away.
m920087.さぁ陰陽師、ついてくるヨ……この地上を、\n鬼門で埋め尽くしてやるネェ！: Come, onmyōji, follow me… I'll fill this land with demon gates!
m920087.さあ、今日はもう帰りましょうか。\n……貴方達、さっさと\n騎獣の用意をなさい！: Alright, let's call it a day and go home. ...You all, hurry up and get the riding beasts ready!
m920087.さあ行こう皆！ 世界が俺達を待って……\nん？ ここは……どこだ？: Let's go, everyone! The world's waiting for us… Huh? Where… are we?
m920087.しかし、元々出現する事自体が珍しく幾つも同時\nに出現するなどは、通常ありえない: But the very appearance is rare, let alone several at once. That's definitely an abnormal situation.
m920087.しょうがない娘たちねぇ……まぁいいわ、\nこれからもっともっと上手になって行けば: My dear daughters... Well, that's fine. Just keep improving from now on. Next time, let's work even harder.
m920087.すぐに治癒の魔法をかけますので！\n癒しの奇跡よ……！: I'll cast a healing spell right away! Miracle of restoration…!
m920087.すみませんコヨミさん、お誘いは嬉しいですが、\nゆっくりしてもいられないんです。: Sorry, Koyomi-san, I appreciate the invitation, but we can't linger. Actually—
m920087.そういう質の妖なのよ。彼らの生きる糧、\n「畏れ」をいつも少しだけ集めて帰ってい: They're that kind of spirit. They collect a little “fear”—the sustenance of their existence—and then leave.
m920087.そうだ、何かお話があったのよね？ 立ち話もなんだし\n家に向かいながらでも聞かせ:
Right, you said you had something to tell me? Since we're just standing around, why not tell me on the way home!
Come on, this way!
m920087.そうだミコト、貴方も手伝ってちょうだい！ \n二人でだったら、あんな鬼門の封印楽: Mikoto, help me out! If we work together, that gate will be a piece of cake! Come on, let's head for it right now!
m920087.そうねぇ……畏れは妖怪にとってご飯みたいなものでしょ。\n私達もお腹が空くと辛い:
Well… fear is like food to yokai, right?
If we're just a little hungry, it's not so bad—just a bit of surprise to collect it, so maybe we can just leave them be.
m920087.そうねぇ……私はあの男にしようかしら。\nふふ、中々良い男じゃないの。: Hmm… I think I'll take that man over there. He's not a bad catch.
m920087.そうねぇ。以前、陰陽寮の術士総出で鬼門を\n封じた事もあったわ。その時は東方の者:
Hmm… Once we sent all the onmyoji from the Onmyoji Dormitory to seal a demon gate.
Back then it wasn't someone from the east, but a sorcerer from another country who opened it.
m920087.そこの陰陽師のお陰だネェ。その力、死ぬまで\nボクの為に役立ててもらうヨ。: Thanks to that onmyōji over there. I'll make use of that power for me until I die.
m920087.そのような術を村中に施せるとは。きっと\n陰陽師として高名な、ご立派な方なのでし: To be able to cast such a technique over the whole village… she must be a renowned, distinguished onmyōji.
m920087.その報告ですが、本当に妖怪だったのですか？\n彼奴等は拙者の祖国、東の国にしかい: As for that report… are you sure it was really a youkai? Those creatures only exist in my homeland, the Eastern lands…
m920087.それが、畏れを集め帰ってる途中だったのですが\n帽子を被った方に話しかけられて…:
Well, I was on my way back gathering fear when someone in a hat talked to me…
…Sorry, I don't remember much after that.
m920087.それじゃ、気を取り直して\nお花見の続きといきましょうか！\nかんぱ～いっ！！: Alright, let's shake it off and continue the hanami! Cheers!!
m920087.それじゃ王子、これからもよろしく頼むわね！\n私の陰陽道で、あなたの厄を払ってみ: Then, Prince, I'm counting on you! With my onmyōdō I'll cleanse your misfortune!
m920087.それでは王子、彼女の住まう村へといきましょう。\n彼女は今、小さな村で都から逃げ: Then, Prince, let's head to her village. She should be protecting the refugees who fled the capital with her onmyōji arts.
m920087.それでは私は……あの操りやすそうな\n魔法剣士の娘にしますね。\n操りやすそうで: Then I'll go with that easy-to-control magic-swordsman's daughter. She seems pliable.
m920087.そんな……。物の怪による都の襲撃以降、\n陰陽寮の方々の行方は分からなくなってい:
That… since the monster attacks on the capital, the onmyōji lodge has disappeared.
Is there really no other way…?
m920087.そんなに畏まる必要はないと思いますよ。\nなにせ都務めですし、私はあの空気は\n: I don't think we need to be that formal. After all, we're on official business, and that atmosphere… well, it's more of a rumor, really.
m920087.そんな！ 辺り一帯に鬼門が！？: No way! The whole area is filled with demon gates!?
m920087.ち、ちょっと、コヨミさん分かりましたから、\n袖を引っ張らないでください！\nそ: W-wait, Koyomi— I get it, but don't pull me into this! And… please, don't push yourself too hard…
m920087.ち、父上は亡くなったハズでは！\n一体何故ここに！: Father… you're supposed to be dead! How are you here!?
m920087.っつーことはよ、あれを通れば\n俺達もすぐ都へ行けるんじゃねーのか！？: So, if we go through that, we can get to the capital right away, can't we!?
m920087.てめぇ、待ちやがれ！！: You there, hold it right there!!
m920087.で、伝令！ 新たな門が出現しました！: Hey, messenger! A new gate has manifested!
m920087.できれば、大将って\n呼んでほしいのですけども……。: If possible, I'd prefer you call me “General”…
m920087.でも、ボクの落魂陣は魂パクを操るだけじゃなく、\nこんな事もできるんだヨ……ほほ: But my Fallen Soul Formation can do more than just control a soul-stealer… look at this… hoho!
m920087.とりあえず一安心ってところか。\nけどよ、あの門は一体どういう仕掛けをしてんだ？:
For now, at least we can breathe a sigh of relief.
But seriously, what kind of mechanism is that gate?
Youkai keep popping up one after another.
m920087.どれ、時間はあまり多くもないが少しばかり\n稽古をつけてやろうて。カスミ、お前も: Anyway, we don't have much time, but I'll give you a bit of training. Kasumi, you too!
m920087.な、なぁに、鬼門の集める陰の気を利用すれば、\n我が肉体の再生も可能なのでやって: Well, you see, by using the dark energy the demon gate gathers, I can regenerate my body, so I just gave it a try. (Wait, is that Kasumi? Why is she here?)
m920087.な、なんでぇあのばかでっけぇ鬼門は……\n……げ、げげぇっ！ あいつは！？: Wh-why is that massive Demon Gate… …g-gee! That thing…?!
m920087.なんという数の鬼門が……これでは\nコヨミさんを追う事も……！: What a sheer number of demon gates… At this rate we can't even chase after Koyomi!
m920087.なんとか魔物は掃討できたようですね。: It looks like we managed to wipe out the monsters.
m920087.ぬらりひょんの真の力……王子、\n次に彼女達に出会うのが楽しみですね！\n期待し: Nurarihyon's true power… Prince, I'm looking forward to meeting them again! Let's wait with anticipation!
m920087.ねえアナタ。なんだかいつもと\n様子が違ったけれど……何かあったの？: Hey, you. You seemed different than usual… what happened?
m920087.は、はい！ 王子、我々はしばし父の元で\n修行を積んで参ります。次にお会いする際: Yes, sir! Prince, we'll train under our father for a while. The next time we meet, we'll be sure to show you Nurarihyon's true power!
m920087.は、私は何を！？: W-what am I supposed to do?!
m920087.はい、恐らく自然に発生したものではないかと思います。\nコヨミさんなら、何か心当:
Yes, I think they were probably not formed naturally.
Koyomi-san, do you have any idea what might be causing this?
m920087.はい。それは敵としてではなく、共に戦うという道も\nあったのかもしれません……シ: Yes. Perhaps there was a path where we could fight together rather than as foes… If we can make that happen with Shino and the others, that would be wonderful.
m920087.はい。ですが相手は鬼門を操る仙人。\n何の用意もなく向かうのは危険に思えます。:
Yes. But our opponent is a hermit who controls the demon gates.
Going in unprepared would be dangerous.
m920087.ば、馬鹿な！？ \n酒呑童子が……あんなに……っ！！: N-No way! The Wine Cellar Boy… that…!
m920087.ひとまず出現は止まっているようですが。: It looks like the appearances have stopped for now.
m920087.ふふ、驚いたかイ？ 力が弱まっていたとはいえ、\n酒呑童子の魂パクを操るのは、\: Heh, surprised? Even though my power's waned, controlling the Wine Cellar Boy's soul-stealer was a real challenge for my Fallen Soul Formation.
m920087.ふむ、あっぱれじゃ。昔、百鬼夜行に参加したいと\nせがまれたのを思い出すわい。危: Well done. It reminds me of the time I was begged to join the Parade. I refused because it was dangerous, but that worry seems gone now.
m920087.ふん、だがお主らはまだまだぬらりひょんとしての力を\n全く引き出せておらん。その: Hmph, you still haven't tapped into the true power of Nurarihyon. At that level you can't even build a Parade, and as Grand General you're still inexperienced.
m920087.へい、カスミお嬢！ お嬢の手前、\n無様な姿なんて見せられやせんぜ！！\n燃えて: Hey, Miss Kasumi! As a lady, I can't show such a sorry sight!! I'm burning up!!!
m920087.へぇ、驚いタ。酒呑童子の気が弱まったのは\nお前達のおかげだったのカ……仙人でも: Huh, surprising. The weakening of the Wine Cellar Boy was thanks to you… even though you're just humans, not even hermits, you did well.
m920087.ほ、報告です！ 村の至る所に鬼門が出現！\n鬼門より妖怪も現れ始めているとの事で:
R-Report! Demon gates are appearing everywhere in the village!
And yokai are starting to emerge from the gates!
m920087.ほほっ、良い所に来たネェ。ちょうど\n極鬼門が完成した所だヨ！\nあとはヤツの魂: Hoho, you've come at a perfect time. The ultimate Demon Gate is just finished! Now, with that soul-stealer, we'll… there!
m920087.みんな～、おちょこは\nちゃんと行き渡ったみたいね～！: Everyone, looks like the little cups made it to everyone!
m920087.む。見た事のない妖怪だな？\n私が知らぬ妖怪などいないと思っていたが……。\nま: Hm. I've never seen a monster like you before. I thought there were no monsters I didn't know… Well, that's fine.
m920087.もぅ、そんなに暗い顔しないの！\n民を良き方へと導くのが、陰陽師の役目でしょ。\: Come on, don't look so gloomy! It's the onmyoji's job to guide the people toward the right path. If we're all gloomy, everyone gets uneasy!
m920087.もし本当に、鬼門だとすれば、\n滅するには陰陽師の力を借りるしかあるまい。: If it truly is a Demon Gate, the only way to seal it is with an onmyōji's power.
m920087.や、やっだもぉ～！ そんな面と向かって言われると\n恥ずかしいじゃない！ ……ん:
N-no, that's enough! Hearing that straight to my face is embarrassing!
…Ugh!
m920087.や、奴は……ま、間違いありません、\nあれは紛れもなく、酒呑童子です！！: Y-yes, that… there's no doubt about it, that's definitely the Wine Cellar Boy!!
m920087.やはり、報告は本当だったようですね。\n王子、急ぎ迎撃の準備を！:
So the report was true after all.
Prince, prepare to intercept immediately!
m920087.よ、妖怪！？\nいつのまに結界の中に……！: Y-yōkai!? How did they get inside the barrier…!
m920087.んもぅ、風情ってものが判ってないわねぇ～！\n……あら？ ちょっとミコト～！\n: Ugh, you really don't get the atmosphere! …Oh? Hey, Mikoto! Mikoto, join us and have a drink too!
m920087.んもぉ～！ ……なんて、まぁ別にいいわよ。\n折角のお酒の席、細かい事は言いっこ: Ugh! …Well, whatever. It's a drinking party, no point fussing over details! Let's just enjoy today!
m920087.カスミは表に出られぬ愛人の娘。お父さまに愛人がいたと\n知れば姉さまはきっと傷つ: I'm the daughter of a concubine who can't appear publicly. If my sister learned you had a concubine, she'd surely be hurt. I'll keep this truth in my heart and support her from the shadows… please rest peacefully.
m920087.ククッ！ さぁて、これで鬼門を封じる厄介な\n陰陽師は手中に落ちタ。ついでにそこ: Heh heh! Now that pesky onmyōji is in my grasp, sealing the demon gate. I'll take care of those guys over there, too… Heh!
m920087.コヨミさん、そのような体で無茶しないでください！\n私の結界で時間を稼ぎますので: Koyomi, don't push yourself in that condition! I'll buy us some time with my barrier, so for now—
m920087.コヨミさん、不用意に近づいては……！: Koyomi-san, don't get too close carelessly…!
m920087.コヨミさんが使う陰陽術の一つですね。魔の力を\n奪う霊符が各所に仕掛けられており: That's one of the onmyōji techniques Koyomi uses. Spirit talismans that drain demonic power are set up everywhere, so the monsters are probably staying away.
m920087.コヨミさんが鬼門の奥へと姿を消すのを見ました。\nあの先は一体どこに繋がっている: I saw Koyomi vanish deep within the demon gate. I wonder where that leads…
m920087.コヨミさんの使う霊符術は、\n攻撃への耐性を奪います。\n皆さんどうかお気をつけ: Koyomi's spirit-sigil technique strips resistance to attacks. Everyone, please be careful!
m920087.コヨミさんの身から感じる陰の気……妖天君に\n完全に操られてしまっているようです: The dark aura emanating from Koyomi shows she's completely under Yōten-kun's control.
m920087.ヒエンさん、助かりました。\nこれでなんとかコヨミさんの足掛かりは\n途絶えずに:
Thank you, Hien.
Thanks to this, we've at least prevented Koyomi's trail from being cut off.
m920087.ボクは華の国の仙人、十天君が一人、\n妖天君。酒呑童子の気配が消えたから、\n今: I am a sage of the Land of Flowers, the lone Juttenshi—Yotenkun. Since Shuten-dōji's presence vanished, I'm thinking I'll take over this country this time.
m920087.ミコトさん……はい、その通りですね。\n王子、急ぎ戦闘のご準備をお願いします！:
Mikoto… Yes, exactly.
Prince, please hurry and prepare for battle!
m920087.ミコトってば、私が寝込んでるときは\nずっと看病してくれてた癖に、快復したらすぐ: Mikoto, you nursed me when I was ill, then as soon as I recovered you ran off to train! Isn't that terrible!?
m920087.ミコト～～～～っ！ 久しぶり～～～～っ！！\nもしかしたらと思ったけど、やっぱり: Mikoto~~~~! It's been forever~~~~!! I thought maybe, but it's really you, Mikoto! What's with the sudden appearance? Did you come to see me!?
m920087.一家の……一員……？ \n私がシノ様の家族になど……\n……ほ、本当によろしいの: A member of the family…? Me, becoming part of General Shino's family… Is this really okay?
m920087.一時凌ぎではありますが、私は鬼門に\n結界を施します。皆さんは現れた妖怪の対処を:
It's only a temporary fix, but I'll seal the demon gates with a barrier. Everyone, take care of the yokai that appear.
…When she returns, she'll be heart-broken if the village is gone.
m920087.一連の妖怪出現の報せ、全てこの門が原因だとしたら\nやっかいですね……。未だ門は:
If all these youkai sightings are caused by that gate,
that's a real headache… The gate hasn't vanished yet,
and we have no idea when the next youkai will emerge…
m920087.中々やるねぇ……陰陽師、\nもっと力を込めるといいヨ！: Not bad at all… Onmyōji, you should put even more power into it!
m920087.主、妖天君が向かったのは\nあちらの方角……どうやら\n都に向かっている様でござ: Lord, Yōtenkun headed that way… seems he's heading toward the capital.
m920087.人と妖怪の共存……ですか。\nコヨミさんはお優しい方なのですね。:
Coexistence between humans and yokai…?
Koyomi-san, you're so kind.
m920087.仕方ないわね。ごめんなさいみんな、\nまた少しあの子の相手をしてあげてくれないか: Can't be helped. Sorry, everyone—could you watch over her again for a bit?
m920087.以前は世話になったわね！\nあの時のお礼を言ってなかったから、\n改めて言いに来: You helped me before! I never thanked you for that, so I'm here to say it now! Thank you sooo much!
m920087.伝令、前方より妖怪の群れが接近中との事！: Messenger, reports a horde of monsters approaching from the front!
m920087.充分畏れは集まりましたね。これでしばらくは、\n妖怪の力を失わずにすみます。\n:
We've gathered plenty of fear. With this, we can go without losing the yokai's power for a while.
Heh, then shall we all head home?
m920087.全ての元凶は妖天君です。\nコヨミさん、今はゆっくりと休んでください。: The root of all this is Yotenkun. Koyomi, just rest for now.
m920087.冗談だろ、一体でもやべぇ相手\nだってのによ……さ、流石に\n逃げるしかねーだろ: You're kidding, right? This opponent is already dangerous enough… we've got no choice but to run!
m920087.分身とは言え、まさか酒呑童子を倒しちゃうとは\n驚いたネェ。東の国を支配するには: Even as a clone, I never expected you to defeat the Wine Cellar Boy. To rule the Eastern lands, I'll need a bit more preparation… I'll remember your faces.
m920087.初めまして王子、私は陰陽師のミコトと申します。\n今後ともお見知りおき頂ければと: Nice to meet you, Prince. I'm Mikoto, an onmyōji. I hope we'll get to know each other from now on.
m920087.嘘ならむしろありがたいですが、\n兵士が私に虚偽の報告を上げてきた事はありません: If it were a lie, I'd actually be grateful, but no soldier has ever given me a false report. It's unlikely we're just seeing things.
m920087.地の淀んだ気をはらう事で鬼門も消失\nしますが……私の流派は破邪、\n妖怪退治を: By dispelling the stagnant energy the Oni Gate will vanish, but my school focuses on exorcising evil and hunting youkai.
m920087.報告！ 戦場に鬼門が発生！: Report! Demon gates have manifested on the battlefield!
m920087.報告！ 辺りに残敵の気配はありません！\n鬼門より現れた妖怪は、全て退治できたと:
Report! No enemy presence remains nearby!
It looks like we've eliminated all the yokai that came out of the demon gates!
m920087.変ですね～？ カスミさんの姿が\nどこにも見当たりませんが……: That's odd… I can't find Kasumi anywhere…
m920087.変ねぇ。いつもなら畏れを集めたら\nしばらくは村にはこないんだけど。\n畏れが足:
Strange. Usually once we gather enough fear, they don't show up in the village for a while.
Maybe we didn't collect enough…
m920087.妖天君といいましたか。各地で鬼門が\n出現していたのは、彼の仕業のようですね。: You mentioned Yōten-kun. It looks like those demon gates popping up everywhere were his doing.
m920087.妖天君も気になりますが、それよりも今は……: Yotenkun is intriguing, but right now…
m920087.妖怪は全て倒しましたが……\n……コヨミさんの姿は見当たりませんね。: We've defeated all the monsters, but… I can't find any sign of Koyomi.
m920087.復活した魔物達により、今では\n満足に米を作ることすら叶いませんが……。: Because of the revived monsters, we can't even grow rice properly these days…
m920087.心配はご無用にござる。拙者の配下の忍に、\n先程の仙人の後をつけさせております故:
There's no need to worry. I've dispatched one of my ninja subordinates to tail that hermit we just encountered.
A direct report should be coming soon.
m920087.急ぎコヨミさんを救い出さなければ。\n王子、都へと急ぎましょう！: We must rescue Koyomi quickly. Prince, let's hurry to the capital!
m920087.急に建物が現れるなどあるわけないじゃないですか。\nきっと何かのカラクリであろう:
There's no way a building would just appear out of nowhere.
It must be some kind of mechanism.
I'll investigate—
m920087.戦や飢餓、悪政等で生まれた人々の陰の気、\nそれにより土地の龍脈が淀んだ際ごくま: When people's dark energy—born of war, famine, corrupt rule—stagnates, it can foul the land's ley lines, and on rare occasions a gate like this appears.
m920087.救出するためには、しっかりとした作戦を\n練る必要がありそうです。一度帰還致しま:
To rescue her we'll need a solid plan. Let's return for now.
Prince, good job.
m920087.敵ではありましたが、種をまとめる立場として\n果たすべき責務の為に動いてた部分も: He was an enemy, but as the one who unites the races, he also had responsibilities he was fulfilling.
m920087.気配もなく、姿を消して近づく妖怪……\nぬらりひょんと性質が似ていますね。: A yokai that vanishes without a trace and draws near… its nature is similar to Nura-hyon.
m920087.流石お姉さま、お目が高いですわ。それじゃ私は\nあの小さい娘にしますわ……一生懸: Well chosen, sister. I'll take that little girl… dragging a cannon around—she'll be fun to tease.
m920087.流石私の娘たち、その意気よ。あら、ちょうど\n私達の姿に釣られた馬鹿な人間達がや: As expected of my girls—such spirit. Ah, looks like those foolish humans have come, drawn by our presence. Choose your puppets from among them.
m920087.父の最期の場所……案内頂き感謝致します。\nこれで父に花を手向ける事が……おや？:
My father's final resting place… Thank you for guiding me.
Now I can lay flowers for him… huh? Looks like we have guests.
m920087.父上がご復活なされたという事は、\n妖怪総大将の座に復権なされるのでしょうか？: If Father has returned, does that mean he'll reclaim the position of Monster General?
m920087.父上の百鬼夜行に！？ 王子、私からもぜひ\nお願いします！ 危害を加えないと\n: Father's Hundred Night Parade…? Prince, I'll gladly ask for it too! I promise we won't cause any harm!
m920087.王子、このような時にも黙っていたら\n犯人にされちゃいますよ！\nしっかり意思表: Prince, if you stay silent now, you'll be blamed as the culprit! You have to speak up!
m920087.王子、妖怪出現の報告があったのはこの辺りです。: Prince, the report of a youkai sighting came from around here.
m920087.王子、魔物の付近に泥酔した兵が\n取り残されているようです。急ぎ救援を！: Prince, there's a drunken soldier left near the monster. We need to rescue him quickly!
m920087.王子も激戦でお疲れでしょう。\nゆっくり休まれて下さい、お疲れ様でした。: Prince, you must be exhausted from the battle. Rest up—thank you for everything.
m920087.生前のぬらりひょん様のご活躍、名もなき辺境妖怪の\n私も聞き及んでおりました。お: I've heard of your deeds in life, Nurarihyon, even as a nameless monster from the frontier. I'm honored to meet you.
m920087.皆決めたようね。それじゃ、\nあなた達の実力を見せてちょうだい！: You've all decided. Show me what you've got!
m920087.破魔の修行をしている際、知り合った陰陽師がおる。\n陰陽寮にも入らず、都務めを放:
While training in the art of demon-breaking, I met an onmyōji.
He never joined the lodge, abandoned his duties in the capital to devote himself to training—a bit of an eccentric—but he's our only hope now.
m920087.確かに美味いけどよぉ。こんなちまちました\n飲み方より、俺はもっとグァーっ！ っ: Yeah, it's tasty and all, but this lame way of drinking— I wanna chug it hard! Hey, bring it over already!!
m920087.私はこれからも村を守らないといけないけども、\nもし何かあれば呼んでちょうだい。: I still have to protect the village, but if anything comes up, just call me. I'll be there to help!
m920087.私も覚えがありませんね。: I don't recall doing that either.
m920087.私も頑張りますので、\nお母さま、見ていてください！ \n……三女、貴方もしっか: I'll do my best, too, Mother—watch me! …Third, you better step up as well!
m920087.自分から近づいてくるとは\n手間が省けたネェ！ ほいっ！: Since you came right up to me, that saves me the trouble! Here we go!
m920087.良かったぁ～。目を覚ましたみたいね。: Good! Looks like you've woken up.
m920087.良かった！ 気が付きました！: Thank goodness! You've come to your senses!
m920087.華の国の仙人……この国をまとめる……！？\nあのさ、ボク？ \n悪戯も程ほどにし:
A sage of the Land of Flowers… taking over this country…!?
Listen, me?
If you keep messing around, it'll get serious!
m920087.落魂陣の力を使えば、\n操った魂パクを分割して、\n分身を作り出すことも可能だヨ: With the power of the Fallen Soul Formation, I can split the controlled soul-stealer and create copies. Hoho!
m920087.話はフドウさんより聞いています。王子達が遭逢した門、\n鬼や妖怪、またその魂が住: I've heard the story from Fudō. The gate you encountered—indeed a path to the other world where demons, youkai, and even souls dwell—is what we call the Oni Gate.
m920087.近づかれるまで姿が見えないんじゃ\n弓で狙いようがないですぅ……。: If I can't see it until it gets close, there's no way to aim with my bow…
m920087.都が襲撃にあった際、陰陽寮から逃げ延びた一人ですが、\n方忌みを専門とする陰陽師: When the capital was attacked, I was one of the few who escaped from the onmyōji dormitory. I have a contact—a onmyōji who specializes in hōki. If she's involved, she could completely eradicate the gate.
m920087.酷い、あんなに衰弱しているなんて……。\n王子、このままではコヨミさんの命が……: How terrible, she's so weakened… Prince, if we don't act, Koyomi-san won't make it…!
m920087.陣の後方に……！？ 王子、前線だけでなく\n拠点の周囲にも充分警戒を！: Behind our lines…! Prince, keep a close watch not just on the front but around the base as well!
m920087.陰陽師さん…ですか。\nも、もしかして、あの門、陰陽師さんでなければ、\n消す事:
An onmyōji…?
Could it be that only an onmyōji can erase that gate…?
m920087.陰陽師さんは礼節を重んじると聞いています。\nさぞ厳粛な方に違いありません、\n: I've heard onmyōji value etiquette above all. They must be incredibly solemn, so we need to be careful not to commit any faux pas…
m920087.陰陽師としては、退治しなきゃなのかもだけどぉ……\n……でも、あの娘達みたいな妖: As an onmyoji, maybe we should eliminate them… but… with yokai like those girls, I think we could actually coexist with humans.
m920087.陰陽道では絶対に負けたくないのです……！\n頼りきりになる事が、少々悔しいような: In onmyōdō we can never afford to lose! Relying on her feels… a bit frustrating—just a childish rival feeling, so please don't worry about it.
m920087.霊符がはがれちゃってるのよ……全く、\n誰がこんな事したのかしら。: The talismans have come off… Seriously, who would do something like that?
m920087.静かで落ち着いた村ですね。\n道中見かけた魔物達も、村に近づくにつれ\n数が減っ:
Such a quiet, tranquil village.
Even the monsters we saw on the road seemed to thin out as we approached the village.
m920087.高位の術者であれば、鬼門を自在に開く事もできる。\nかつて一度鬼門を見た事がある:
A high-rank onmyōji can open a Demon Gate at will.
I once saw one that looked exactly like this gate.
Back then, an onmyōji destroyed it.
m920087.鬼門についての心得は少なく、出現した鬼門を\n封じようと試みましたが、やはり一時: I know little about sealing the Oni Gate. I tried, but I could only manage a temporary barrier. I'm sorry.
m920087.鬼門の封印については方忌みを得意とする、\n専門の流派の力を借りるしかありません: To seal it properly we'll have to enlist a school that specializes in hōki—rituals that banish evil.
m920087.鬼門を封じる事が出来るコヨミさんを狙ったのは\n分かります。ですが、そのまま連れ: We understand they went after Koyomi, who can seal the gates. But to just snatch her away… Yōten-kun, what on earth is he planning?
m920087.（姉さま……すみませんカスミは嘘をつくしかありません。\n私の存在を知ったら、姉: (Sister… I'm sorry, I have no choice but to lie. If she learns I exist, she'll be hurt…)

m920154.――あ、足音って……。\nすごい数ですよ！？:
――Ah, footsteps…
There are so many of them!
m920154.――ここが、温泉のお湯が\n湧き出している場所なんですね。:
――So this is where the hot spring water
is gushing up from.
m920154.――その顔、鋼の都にいた連中か。\nなるほど、良い戦士たちにござる。:
――Those faces. You're the ones from the Steel Capital, aren't you?
I see. You are indeed fine warriors.
m920154.――た、たいへんですー！！\nエマさ――お、女将さん！！\n団体客のオークさんた:
――Th-this is an emergency!!
Ema-sa―― oh, Innkeeper!
The group of Orcs is rushing into the bath!
m920154.――た、助けてくれぇー！！\nおばけが！ 温泉におばけがー！！:
――H-help meee!!
There's a ghost! A ghost in the hot spring!
m920154.――ちょっとまって。\nあっちから何か聞こえない？:
――Wait a moment.
Can't you hear something over there?
m920154.――では、私が女将を務めましょう。\nこういったことは、過去に経験がありますので:
――Then, I shall serve as the proprietress.
I have experience with such matters in the past.
m920154.――でも、さすがに本気で争ったら\n王子さまに迷惑かけちゃいますぽん。:
――But, if we really fought in earnest,
we'd be causing trouble for the Prince, pon.
m920154.――とうとう、この日が来たぽんね。: ――So, this day has finally come, pon.
m920154.――なれば死にゆく者達よ、ご笑覧あれ。\nこれより先は死地、戦場にござるゆえ。:
――Then, you who are about to die, witness this.
From here on, this is a death trap, a battlefield.
m920154.――はーい、オーク慰安旅行のみなさーん、\n今日のお宿はこちらですよー！:
――Hey there, everyone on the Orc Retreat!
This is your accommodation for today!
m920154.――ふぅ、これが温泉……。\n悪くないわ、まるで生き返るような心地ね。:
――Phew, this is a hot spring…….
Not bad at all. I feel like I'm coming back to life.
m920154.――ふぅ、ようやく今日のお仕事も終わりですね。\nサオシュちゃん、一緒に温泉入り:
――Phew, I'm finally done with today's work.
Saoshu, would you like to join me in the hot spring?
m920154.――ふふ、女将だからですよ。\n仮初とはいえ、一国一城を預かる身とあらば、\nこ:
――Heh heh, because I'm the Innkeeper.
Even if it's just a temporary role, if I'm entrusted with a castle,
I have to show I can pull off something like this.
m920154.――ふふん、化け合戦の審判といえば王子さま。\nそして王子さまを悩殺するにはどう:
――Hehe, the Prince is the judge of the transformation battle.
And how to captivate the Prince?
We thought about it while soaking in the hot spring, pon.
m920154.――ふむ。\n並の戦士ではないと思っておったが……。\nもしや貴公らが、魔王殺し:
――Hmph.
I had assumed you were no ordinary warriors…
Could it be that you belong to the royal army that slew the Demon King?
m920154.――ほう。\nあの爆発を生き延びるとは、称賛に値する。:
――Hmph.
To survive that explosion… you have my praise.
m920154.――わっ、わっ、わぁぁぁぁ！？\n床がつるつるして止まりませんー！！:
――Waa, waa, waahh!?
The floor is so slippery, I can't stop!
m920154.――ギャギャ！\nオンセンハイル！ ビリビリスル！\nカラダ、ツヨクナル！！:
――Gyagyaa!
Onsen Hairu! Biribirisuru!
Karada, Tsuyoku Naru!!
--- scene: Contamination!? The Mutated Bath (battle, battle) ---
m920154.――今回の遠征も大変でしたね……。: ――This expedition has been quite a ordeal, too…….
m920154.――山奥だからこそ、なのでしょう。\n人の子が日頃の疲れを癒やすためには、\nや:
――It is likely precisely because it is so remote.
People seek out places different from their usual surroundings to ease the weariness of daily life, do they not?
m920154.――待て。あれに見えるは、\n鋼の都にて相対した、絡繰り忍者ではないか？:
――Wait. That figure over there…
isn't that the Karakuri Ninja
we faced in the Steel Capital?
m920154.――本当に、グレーターデーモンは\n温泉に入りにきただけみたいですね。: ――It really does seem like the Greater Demon just came to enjoy the hot spring.
m920154.――温泉に魔物が現れたとは聞きましたが……。: I heard monsters appeared in the hot springs……
m920154.――王子に止められたので引き分け、よな。: —a draw, since the Prince stopped us, huh.
m920154.――笑止。\nこれは愉快な娘に一本とられた。\n褒美に拙者の術を、ひとつご覧にい:
――How laughable.
This delightful girl has bested me.
As a reward, I'll show you one of my techniques.
m920154.――美人女将三姉妹の宿か。\nウム……いいね……。:
――So, this is the inn run by the three beautiful proprietors.
Hmm... not bad at all...
m920154.――良いではありませんか。\nこれも魔物調査の一環といたしましょう。:
――How wonderful.
Let's consider this part of our monster survey.
m920154.……あの男、親切心や酔狂で動く者ではありません。\n変異薬を我々に採取されぬよう:
……That man is not one to act out of kindness or whims.
We should assume he neutralized the water
to prevent us from collecting the mutagen.
m920154.……あれ？ 温泉の色、もとに戻っていませんか？: ……Huh? Isn't the hot spring water returning to its original color?
m920154.……いっせいに入ったら温泉が溢れちゃいます。\nそれに入泉料もいただいていません:
……If they all enter at once, the hot spring will overflow.
And we haven't even been collecting entrance fees.
m920154.……いつもの変異種と気配が違います。\nびりびり……雷をまとってます……！:
……It feels different from the usual mutants.
It's crackling… with electricity…!
m920154.……お、おばけ？\nうぅ、温泉はお預けみたいですね。\nもうひと仕事しないといけ:
……A ghost?
Ugh, it looks like our soak is on hold.
Seems like we have one more job to do.
m920154.……おんせん、ぽかぽかですからね。\nみんなでゆっくりする所です……。:
……Hot springs are so warm and cozy.
It's a place for everyone to relax…….
m920154.……おんせんっ！\n一緒に入って良いのですか……？:
……A hot spring!
Is it really okay for me to join you……?
m920154.……お外は雪、ぶるぶる寒くて、\nだから動物さんたちが\n温泉に殺到しちゃったの:
……It's snowing outside, and it's freezing cold,
so perhaps the animals
rushed to the hot spring…?
m920154.……これも美しき輝きのひとつ。\n限りある生を、存分に楽しむのも、\n人の子に許:
……This, too, is a beautiful radiance.
To fully enjoy our limited lives
is a precious right granted to us.
m920154.……だがもてなしと、料理は一級品だよ。\nワシが本気で欲しくなるほどに、\nこの:
...But the hospitality and the food are first-rate.
This hot spring inn is truly a wonderful place,
enough to make me desperately want it.
m920154.……ということがあったらしいんですけど！\nどうして妖狸さんたち、\nみんな私に:
……Apparently that's what happened!
Why are all the Tanuki-yokai
transformed into me?!
m920154.……な、なるほど。\n他のお客さんを怖がらせないように、\n深夜にお風呂に入って:
……I see.
You were bathing in the middle of the night
so you wouldn't scare the other guests.
m920154.……はいっ！！\nよぉし、サオシュちゃん、私たちも頑張りましょう！:
……Yes, ma'am!!
Alright, Saoshu-chan, let's do our best too!
m920154.……ふふ、可愛い若女将たちに免じて、\n女将さんには伝えないようにしておくわ。:
……Heh, for the sake of these cute young innkeepers,
I'll keep this from the Innkeeper.
m920154.……むぅー、今回の化け化けあやかし大決戦は――: ……Hmph, so this Great Yokai Transformation Battle is—
m920154.……んっ、あれ？\nあっちのお湯、色がおかしくありませんか？:
……Huh, wait?
Isn't the color of that water over there
off?
m920154.……エマさん、過去にいったい何があったのでしょう。\nともかく、これから忙しくな:
……What on earth has happened in Ema-san's past.
Anyway, things are going to be busy from here on out.
m920154.……妙ですね。\n温泉に異物を混入されたのかと思いましたが、\nこうも同時に全て:
……That's strange.
I thought the springs were contaminated,
but for all of them to change at once……
m920154.……王子、ちょうど兵の休養が\n必要な頃合いでしたよね。\n温泉宿を手伝ってあげ:
……Prince, it's a good time for the soldiers to rest, isn't it?
How about we help out at the hot spring inn?
m920154.……皆さん、喧嘩していたにしては、\nずいぶんあっさりと手を引くんですね？:
……Everyone, for a fight,
you're giving up surprisingly easily, aren't you?
m920154.……若女将たち、油断してはいけませんよ。\nこの忍、並々ならぬ使い手のようです。:
……Young innkeepers, please do not let your guard down.
This ninja appears to be a far more formidable opponent than he looks.
m920154.……落ちつきましょう？\nいっしょに深呼吸です、すー、はー。:
……Let's calm down, okay?
Let's take a deep breath together. In, and out.
m920154.……見誤ったか。\n良い戦士たちとは思ったが、\nまさかこれ程の実力を備えていた:
……I underestimated you.
I thought you were capable warriors,
but I didn't expect you to be this strong.
m920154.あ、当たり前ですよー！！\n――でも、ちょっと楽しそうです、わかおかみ！:
Oh, that goes without saying!!
――But, it sounds a bit fun, assistant proprietress!
m920154.あたし様たちは妖怪！\nそして因縁尽きないたぬきときつねですぽん！:
We are yokai!
And we are a tanuki and a fox with endless grudges, pon!
m920154.あっ……妖怪の皆さんは、\n人の畏れが必要なんでしたよね……。:
Ah… so the yokai all
need humans to fear you, right…?
m920154.あっ、それじゃあ山奥の秘湯に、\n動物さんたちを案内しちゃいましょうか♪:
Oh, how about we guide the animals
to the secret hot spring deep in the mountains?♪
m920154.あっ、グレーターデーモンさん。\nお湯加減はいかがですか？:
Oh, Greater Demon.
Is the water temperature to your liking?
m920154.あっそうだ！\nよかったら三人で秘湯めぐりしちゃいませんか？\n動物さんたちと一:
Oh, I've got it!
Why don't we all go on a secret hot spring tour together?
You, me, and the animals!♪
m920154.あなたが……ちょこまか逃げ回るからです。\nまだ続けますか……？:
That's because you keep dodging around.
Are you going to keep this up…?
m920154.あなたが、温泉に薬品を混入していたんですね？\nいったいどうしてこんな事を！:
So you're the one who was adding chemicals
to the hot spring?
Why on earth would you do such a thing!
m920154.あの一件以来、絡繰り忍者は\n完全に姿をくらませてしまいましたね……。:
Since that incident, the Karakuri Ninja
has completely disappeared from view…
m920154.あはは……実はそんなに\n仲が悪いというわけでもないんですぽん。:
Ahaha… actually, we're not
exactly on bad terms, pon.
m920154.あら、そこに見えるのは\nお風呂セットだと思うのだけれど……？: Oh, is that a bath set over there?
m920154.あー、あれは見覚えがある、かも……？\nうぇぇぇ、生物化学は本業じゃないんだけど:
Ah, I feel like I've seen something like that before…?
Ugh, biochemistry isn't really my field, though.
m920154.い、行きません！\n――あっ、で、でもちょっと行きたいような……。\nってみなさ:
I-I'm not going!
—Ah, b-but I kind of want to go…
Everyone! Wait for me!!
m920154.いいのよ。\nそれに温泉に争いは似合わないでしょう？:
It's nothing.
Besides, conflict doesn't suit a hot spring, does it?
m920154.いえ、こんな傷くらい\nどうということは――ぐぁあっ！？:
No, a wound like this
is nothing to worry about――gaaah!?
m920154.いえ！ お客様を襲撃しちゃったので、\nむしろ私たちが謝らないと……。:
No! We ended up attacking a guest,
so we're the ones who should be apologizing…….
m920154.いわく、ひとりの主に仕えることなく、\n金次第でどんな忍務ですら遂行する、\n伝:
They say he serves no single master,
and will carry out any ninja mission
for the right price—a legendary mercenary ninja…
m920154.う、動いちゃだめです！\nひどい傷じゃないですか！\nすぐに治癒魔法をかけますか:
P-please don't move!
That's a serious wound!
Let me cast a healing spell on you right away!
m920154.うぅぅぅ～！\nだからって、バスタオル姿は恥ずかしすぎます～！:
Uuuuugh~!
But being wrapped in a bath towel is way too embarrassing~!
m920154.うおおおおおおッ！ これが温ッ！ 泉ッ！！: UOOOOOOH! This is the power of the hot spring! The true essence of the waters!
m920154.うっ、それはそうなんですけど……。\n良いんですか？ せっかくのんびりされている:
W-well, that's true, but……
Are you sure? You were just about to relax……
m920154.うん……私も、やってみたい、です。: Mm…… I'd like to try it, too.
m920154.え、エマさん！？\n温泉宿で働いていたことがあるんですか！？:
Huh, Ema-san?!
You've worked at a hot spring inn before?!
m920154.えぇ、ごめんなさい、\n私も一言相談しておくべきだったわね。:
Yes, I'm sorry.
I really should have checked with you first.
m920154.えぇ、なればすべきことは唯ひとつ。\nソーマ、サオシュ、温泉を封鎖なさい。\n魔:
Yes, there is only one course of action.
Soma, Saoshu, seal off the hot springs.
We will not let a single one of those monsters escape.
m920154.えぇぇっ！？\nき、きっと見間違いですよ！\n絶対そうに決まってますから！:
E-ehhh!?
I-I'm sure it's just a trick of the light!
It absolutely has to be!
m920154.えぇと、お宿に代わりに\n働いてくれる方はいないのですか？:
Um, is there no one else
who could work at the inn in your place?
m920154.えっ、で、でもお客様と一緒に入るわけには……。: Wha…… b-but we can't bathe with a guest……
m920154.えっと……でも私たちには、\n若女将としてのお仕事がありまして……。:
Um… but, you see, we have duties
as the assistant proprietors…
m920154.えっ？ えっと、それは駄目ですよ！？\nちゃんと身体を洗ってから――わっ、わー！:
Huh? Um, you can't do that!
You have to wash your body properly first――Wha, wha-!?
m920154.お、温泉に入ったゴブリンが、\n変異種になりましたよ……！？:
T-the Goblin that entered the bath……
has become a mutant……!?
m920154.おぉ……なんという強者……。\n我らの進軍を、こうも容易くいなすとは……。:
Oh…… what a powerful foe…….
To so easily repel our advance……
m920154.おぉ、泉から湯気が立っています！\nこれが噂に名高い、温かな泉……温泉なのですね:
Oh, the steam rising from the spring!
So this is the famed, warm spring…… a hot spring!
m920154.おんせん！！ 温泉があるんですかー！？: Hot spring!! There's a hot spring here?!
m920154.お楽しみいただけましたか？\nしかし宿には他のお客様もおりますゆえ、\nけっして:
Did you enjoy yourselves?
However, there are other guests at the inn,
so please refrain from causing any more scenes in the hot spring.
m920154.お返事は、若女将。: I'm waiting for your answer, junior innkeeper.
m920154.きゃぁぁっ！？\nな、なにっ！？ 敵襲！？ 敵襲なのね！？:
Kyaaa!?
Wh-what!? An enemy attack!? It's an enemy attack!?
m920154.きゃぁっ！？\nだめっ、だめです！ こんな熱波の中じゃ、\nみんな体力を削られる:
Kyaa?!
No, no! In this heat,
everyone will just exhaust themselves and won't be able to rest!
m920154.くくっ……愉快なり。\nひ弱な娘だと思えば、そんな顔をするのでござるか。:
Kukku… How amusing.
I thought you were a frail girl, but you have quite the expression on your face.
m920154.けほっ、けほっ……うぅ、\nすみません、見失ってしまいました……。:
Cough, cough… ugh,
I'm sorry, I lost sight of them…
m920154.けれど、一線を踏み越えるような日が来たなら、\nその時は引導を渡してやりましょう: But if the day comes when he crosses the line, I'll be ready to deliver his downfall.
m920154.けれど、戦い続きの日々でしたから、\nきっとこれも、素敵な休暇になりそうですね♪:
But after all those days of constant battle,
I'm sure this will turn out to be a wonderful vacation♪
m920154.けれど次からはふたりで協力して、\n困難に立ち向かうのですよ？\n常に私を頼るば:
But next time, the two of you should work together
to face difficulties, alright?
You can't just rely on me all the time.
m920154.この辺りの魔物の生息地を探している時に、\n偶然ばっちり発見しちゃったんですよー:
I stumbled upon it by chance
while I was scouting for monster habitats in this area!♪
m920154.これから新しい従業員を募集して、\n少しずつ温泉宿を元通りに\nしていこうと思っ:
I was just planning to recruit new staff
and slowly get the inn back to normal…… grr……
m920154.これは、いったい……？\n温泉が緑色に染まってます！:
What is this……?
The water has turned green!
m920154.これは、この辺りの温泉すべての一大事。\n湯を汚す最低の行いに、\n我らが爪牙に:
This is a crisis for every hot spring in the region.
We will punish that despicable act of contamination
with our own claws and fangs.
m920154.さぁかかってきなさい、オークの子らよ。\n私の仕切る温泉で、無法を働くことは不可:
Now then, come at me, you Orcs.
No lawlessness will be tolerated in the hot spring I oversee.
m920154.さすがはガオレオンの部下だ、\n肝が据わっているな、サオシュ。\nさぁ王子、私た:
You certainly live up to being Gaoreon's subordinate.
You have real guts, Saoshu.
Now, Prince, let's get ready for battle!
m920154.しかし、核には届かなかったか。\nあと拳ひとつ逸れていたなら、\n拙者の機関を止:
But I couldn't reach the core.
Had I been just one punch closer,
I could have stopped my mechanism.
m920154.す、すー、ひゃー……。\nこほん……い、一大事なんですー！\n温泉が動物さんに占:
I, in… hyah…
Ahem… I-it's a major incident!
The hot spring has been occupied by animals!!
m920154.すみません、\nみんなぽかぽかな泉を見て、\n思わずはしゃいでしまったみたいで…:
I'm sorry,
but seeing everyone so cozy in the spring,
they couldn't help but get a little excited……
m920154.ず、ずいぶんと育ちがいいんですね！\n私だって、質問されても答えませんから！:
Y-you really are well-mannered!
I'm not going to answer your questions either!
m920154.そう、例えばこれくらいの温度がいいんだよ。\nワシの魔力で温泉を沸騰させてやろう:
Yes, that temperature is perfect.
I'll boil the spring using my magic.
m920154.そうだなぁ、ゆっくり休みたいところだが――\nん、そういえばこの辺りには、\n確:
Yeah, I'd love to rest up, but――
Hm, come to think of it, wasn't there a hot spring nearby?
m920154.そうだ！ ぜひ王国軍の皆さんに御礼をさせてください！\nこの近くに私が経営する温:
That's right! Please let me express my gratitude to the Royal Army!
I run a hot spring inn nearby――grrh!?
m920154.そこなおなごよ、どうやら育ちが良いようだ。\nどんな相手でも質問すれば答えてくれ:
Still a woman, are you? You seem well-bred.
You must have been born into an environment
where anyone answers your questions.
m920154.それから若女将に、ソーマ、サオシュ、\nあなたたちの力を借りましょうか。: And I shall borrow the strength of Soma and Saoshu as my assistant proprietresses.
m920154.それが、魔物が復活した時に、\n安全を考慮して全員故郷へ帰してしまったのです。:
Well, when the monsters returned,
we sent everyone back to their hometowns for their safety.
m920154.それじゃあお腹も膨れたことだし、\nこの後は一緒に温泉でもいかがぽん？:
Anyway, now that we're full,
how about we all go to the hot spring together, pon?
m920154.それでは細かな役職も。\n皆さん、こちらへ集まってくださいな。:
Then, let us assign the specific roles.
Everyone, please gather here.
m920154.それでは若女将たち、宿に戻りましょうか。\n宿の温泉がもとに戻ったか、\n確認し:
Now then, young proprietors, let us return to the inn.
We must check if the hot spring has returned to normal.
m920154.それにあれは……ゴブリン……？\nうぅん、他にも魔物の群れが……！:
And that's…… a Goblin……?
Hmm, there's a whole horde of monsters……!
m920154.それに比べ、そこな女将の冷酷なことよ。\n如何に拙者を破壊するか、\n先程よりず:
――Compared to that, the innkeeper is truly cold-blooded.
She seems to have been thinking about how to destroy me
ever since we first met.
m920154.それより王子、こちらの報告書を。\n――件の、絡繰り忍者の情報をまとめたものです:
Now then, Prince, here is the report.
――It summarizes the information we have on the Karakuri Ninja.
m920154.そんな……それはできません！\n温泉宿には団体さんの予約も入っているんです。\n:
But…… I can't!
We have group reservations coming in.
If I'm not there, the guests will be disappointed……
m920154.そんなぁ……。\nぽかぽか……おんせん……すん……。:
Nnngh……
It's so warm…… the hot spring…… I'm so sleepy……
m920154.た、たたた、たいへんなんですー！！: H-help, help, help, it's an emergency!!
m920154.た、大変です！！\n向こうで誰かが魔物に襲われてます！！:
T-this is bad!!
Someone's being attacked by a monster over there!!
m920154.だからほら、ふたりとも\nもう少し近くへ来たらどうかしら？: So, come here a little closer, both of you.
m920154.だから無理しちゃだめなんですってば！\n傷は塞ぎますけど、しばらくは絶対安静です:
I told you not to push yourself!
The wound will close, but you must stay in bed for a while, understood?
m920154.だが、やはり物質界の民は甘い。\nいずれ全ての商店は、ワシの支配下となるのだ。\:
But it seems the people of the material world are still too naive.
Sooner or later, every shop will fall under my dominion.
I suggest you look forward to that day.
m920154.だが、無意味にて候。\n貴公らの末路は爆死なり。:
But it is all in vain.
Your end shall be a fiery explosion.
m920154.つまり、そろそろ異物混入犯の\n居場所に近づいてきたってことだな。:
That means we're getting close to the
culprit who's been contaminating the water.
m920154.ですっ……わ、私たちは、\nこの温泉の若女将……ですからっ！:
Th-that's right… we, we are
the young proprietors of this hot spring inn…!
m920154.ですね！\n急いで王子を呼びに行きましょう！:
Exactly!
Let's hurry and go call the Prince!
m920154.ですよね……うーん、どうしたら……。: I know… hmm, what should we do…
m920154.でも……こんな雪が積もっている中で、\n温泉に入らず帰れっていうのは可哀想ですよ:
But… with this much snow,
telling them to go home without bathing would be cruel…
m920154.でも、それで争ってたら\n両方の種族が滅んじゃうからね。:
But if we keep fighting,
both our species would go extinct, you know.
m920154.でも温度が足りないねえ。\nワシとしては、もう少し、そう、\n沸騰しているくらい:
But it's not hot enough.
For me, it should be a bit... well,
boiling is just right.
m920154.というわけで、兵の慰安も兼ねて、\nしばらく温泉宿の業務を代行しつつ、\nこの周: So, to keep the troops in good spirits, we've taken over operations at the hot spring inn for a while. We'll also be clearing out the monsters in the area.
m920154.ところで、脱衣所の方が騒がしくないかしら？\nまるで誰かが、\nこちらへ向かって:
By the way, is the changing room not so quiet?
It's as if someone is
running straight toward us…….
m920154.とはいえ、ここを出たら再び敵同士。\nワシの覇道を邪魔するようであれば、\n美人:
Still, once I leave here, we are enemies again.
If you stand in the way of my path to dominance,
I will crush even the three beautiful proprietors.
m920154.どうしたんですかシュシュちゃん！？\nタオル姿で出てきちゃだめですよー！？:
What's wrong, Shushu-chan!?
You can't just run out wearing a towel like that!
m920154.どうやら良くない成分が、\n外部から温泉に流れ込んでいるようですね……。:
It seems some harmful substance
has been flowing into the springs from outside……
m920154.なっ……けほっ、けほっ！\n絡繰り忍者さんはどこに……！？:
Wha… cough, cough!
Where did the Karakuri Ninja go…!?
m920154.なに、仮のものですよ。\nあくまで温泉の若女将であって、\nおふたりを吸血種にし:
Don't worry, it's just a title.
You will simply be assistant proprietresses of the hot spring.
I have no intention of turning you into vampires.
m920154.なるほど、一理ある。\n――それで、私たちは何をすればいいんだ？:
I see, that makes sense.
――So, what exactly are we supposed to do?
m920154.は、はい……っ。\n油断禁物……ですねっ。:
Y-yes…!
No letting our guard down… right!
m920154.はぁ……はぁ……助かりました。\nまさか宿の近くにまで、魔物が出現するとは……。:
Villager?: Haa…… haa…… You saved me.
I never imagined monsters would appear so close to the inn……
m920154.はぁ……温泉宿、最高でしたぁ……。: Phew… That hot spring inn was the best…
m920154.はいっ、温泉防衛戦です……！: Yes! It's a hot-spring defense mission…!

I'll be right back!!

Hehe… It was always impossible

Hehe, I simply let my nostalgia get the better of me

m920154.ふふっ、そういうわけで今日は、\nソーマちゃんの畏れをいただいたぽーん♪:
Fufu, well, that's why today,
we got to experience Soma-chan's fear, po~n♪
m920154.ふふっ、ソーマちゃんも一緒に来ますかぽーん？: Fufu, will Soma-chan come with us, po~n?

m920154.ふむ……やけに自信がありそうよな。\n何か隠し玉があるとでも？:
Mm… You seem unusually confident.
Do you have some hidden trump card?
m920154.ほう、それはよい。\n件の温泉宿に遊びに行くとしようかのう。:
Hm, that sounds good.
Let's go visit that hot spring inn.
m920154.ほらー！ 見てください！\n王子さまも温泉入りたいって顔してますよー！:
Look! See?
Even the Prince looks like he wants to soak in the hot spring!
m920154.ぽかぽか温泉……最高だったぽん……。\nそしてその結果、温泉の思い出を\n鮮やか:
The warm hot spring… it was the best, pon…
And as a result, we acquired this Transformation
that vividly revives our hot spring memories, pon…!!
m920154.ぽっかぽかー♪ おんせん～♪: So warm and cozy~♪ Hot spring~♪

Popon♪
Of course, it's a transformation battle, pon♪
m920154.ぽぽん、若女将してるソーマちゃんが\nあまりに可愛すぎて、\nずーっと見つめちゃ:
Popon, the way Soma-chan acts as a young proprietor
was so cute that
we couldn't help but stare at you the whole time, pon?
m920154.ま、魔界ボアが変異種になりましたよ！？: Well, that Demon Realm Boa has become a mutant!
m920154.まさか王子たちが手伝っているとはねえ……。\nこれでは事業乗っ取りも難しいか。:
I didn't expect the Prince and his party to help...
This makes taking over the business difficult, doesn't it.
m920154.まずは皆さんで分担して、\n温泉宿のお仕事をこなさないといけませんね。: First, we need to divide up the work and keep the inn running smoothly.
m920154.まずは私が女将の戦いの手本を見せましょう。\n若女将として、お客様のあしらい方を:
First, let me show you the Innkeeper's way of battle.
As the junior innkeepers, you must learn how to handle guests.
m920154.み、みなさーん！ 助けてくださいー！！\nこのままじゃ温泉が沸騰しちゃいますー！:
E-everyone! Help me!!
The spring is about to boil over!!

m920154.むっ……この緑色、\n温泉宿に流れ込んでたのと同じ色だね。:
Mmm… this green color is
the same as the one flowing into the inn.
m920154.もうへとへとです……。\n王国に戻ったらふかふかのベッドで眠りたいですね。:
I'm completely exhausted…….
I just want to sleep in a fluffy bed once we're back in the kingdom.
m920154.もしかして、源泉に異常が……？\nそれなら、源泉につながるすべての温泉が、\n同:
Could there be something wrong with the source?

m920154.もちろんですよ、臨時若女将どうし、\n仲良く一緒に入りましょう！:
Of course! We're both acting innkeepers, after all.
Let's enjoy it together!
m920154.やったぁー！\nそれじゃあおふたりとも、\nお風呂の準備を整えて集合ですよー！:
Yatta!

m920154.やったー！ 温泉ですか？ 温泉ですねー！？: Yaaay! A hot spring? It's a hot spring, right?!
m920154.わ、私には牙とかないですけどね……。\nでもがんばりますよ！\n急いで異物混入の:
I-I don't really have any fangs, but...
I'll do my best!
Let's hurry and find whoever contaminated the water!
--- scene: The Demon Likes It Hot (battle, start) ---
m920154.わっ……温泉宿より、\nここの方がお湯があつあつです……！\nどうして温度が違う:
Whoa… the water here is
much hotter than at the inn…!
Why is the temperature different?
m920154.ウム、商売敵として\n実に魅力的な宣戦布告だよ。:
Hmm, as a business rival,
that is a truly charming declaration of war.

Hmm, the water quality isn't bad.
My slimy little pets seem to be
getting even slimmer... I mean, smoother, too.
m920154.ギャギャ……カラダ……ボロボロ……。: Gyagya…… my body…… is falling apart……
m920154.シュシュちゃん、\n私たちは任務でここに来ているんですよ？\n王国に帰るまでが遠:
Shushu-chan,
we're here on a mission, you know?
The expedition doesn't end until we're back in the kingdom!
m920154.シュシュちゃんっ！\n温泉に入りに行くんじゃなくて、\n温泉宿のお手伝いをしに行:
Shushu-chan!

m920154.ソーマ、サオシュ、覚えておきなさい。\nお客様とて神にあらず、亜神とてまだ遠い、:
Soma, Saoshu, remember this.
Guests are not gods, and demigods are still far from divine.

Soma-san, Saoshu-san… no, that's not right!
The young proprietors, it's a crisis!
m920154.一番風呂は猛者の証と聞く。\nこれは誰より先に、湯船に突撃しなくてはな！:

I must be the first to charge into the tub!
m920154.事業乗っ取りも、温泉沸騰もだめですよ？: Taking over the business *and* boiling the spring are both no good!

We are both yokai who deceive people.
Our ancestral turf war is as fierce as fire, pon.
m920154.人を化かして生きるあやかし。\nそんなあり方がゆえに、衝突することはありますぽん:
We're yokai who survive by deceiving humans.
Because of that way of life, conflicts do happen, pon.
m920154.今は地道に調査を続けるしかありません、よね。\n王子、今後も警戒を続けていきまし:
For now, we have no choice but to keep investigating methodically.
Prince, let's stay on high alert!
m920154.傭兵……変異種の薬品を実験するような雇い主……。\nうぅ、思いつかないですね……:
A mercenary… an employer who experiments with mutant species…
Ugh, I can't think of anyone…
m920154.去年の事業乗っ取りには失敗したが、\n次はこの宿を乗っ取るのも悪くないねェ。:
I failed to take over that business last year,
but seizing this inn wouldn't be a bad idea either.
m920154.古い温泉宿ですから……もしかしたら、\n本物のおばけかもしれませんね……。: It is an old hot spring inn…… so perhaps it is a real ghost…….
m920154.可愛いペットのクラーケン君も、\nどうやらあの女将たちと、\nこの湯を気に入った:
My cute pet Kraken seems to have taken a liking
to those proprietors and this bathwater, too.
m920154.商売とは、乗っ取り、買収こそ王道。\nそれをいずれ分からせてやろうねえ。:
In the world of business, acquisition and takeover are the true path to power.
I will make sure you understand that, eventually.
m920154.団体客とは、こんな山奥の温泉宿なのに、\n随分とすごい人気なんだな。: A group booking? For a hot spring inn tucked away in the mountains like this? It must be quite popular.

m920154.変異種……鋼の都に現れた、\n強力な変異を起こした魔物でしたよね。\n再生能力も:
Mutants…… like the powerful ones
that appeared in the Steel Capital, right?
Their regeneration must be incredible too……
m920154.大気中で目視できる程の、あの放電量！\n近付くだけで絶対ヤバイし、\nずっと電気:
And that's a visible amount of discharge in the open air!
Just getting close is dangerous, and
if you keep getting zapped, you might not be able to move at all!
m920154.女将さん！\nえへ、女将さんがそういうなら、\n私たちも秘湯めぐりに行きましょう:
Proprietor!
Heh, if the Proprietor says so,
then let's go on that hot spring tour!
m920154.奴が鋼の都から盗んだのは、\nゴブリン博士の「変異種」を生み出す研究資料。\nそ:

Doctor Goblin's research on "mutant species."
And if the monsters touching this water are mutating, then――

With…… force?

As for helping at the inn, I suppose

m920154.引き際を心得た相手ほど、戦場では恐ろしいもの。\n王子、あの者には警戒を怠らぬよ:
An opponent who knows when to retreat is the most dangerous on the battlefield.
Prince, please remain on guard against him.
m920154.当然でしょう？\n――仲間と一緒にお風呂、素敵じゃない。:
Of course.
Bathing with friends…… doesn't that sound lovely?

Even though we are enemies, I must acknowledge that much.

Contaminating a place of rest,
and even creating mutants……

The first phase of my experiment is complete.
There is no longer any reason for me to stay in this place.
――Therefore, I shall concede victory in this battle.
m920154.日々の疲れが取れました……。\nお仕事もしていたはずなのに、\nきっと温泉の癒や:
It really helped me shake off the stress of the day…
Even though I was working,
it must be the healing power of the hot springs…
m920154.明日には次の団体客さんの予約が入っています。\n目指せ、エマさんみたいなカッコイ:
We've got a reservation for a group of guests tomorrow.
Our goal is to be a cool proprietress like Ema!
m920154.最初は一緒に仲良く入ってたんですけどね……。\nそれが評判になっちゃったのか、\:
At first, we were all getting along just fine…

because listen, there are so many footsteps coming from the mountain side right now――
m920154.気をつけて、あいつ爆弾と入れ替わっていったよ！\nすぐにその辺りから退避してー！:
Watch out, it swapped places with a bomb!
Get away from that area right now!!
m920154.温泉で……走る、からです……っ！\nわっ、ま、前っ、気をつけてください……！:
Because we are…… running…… in the hot spring!
Waa, p-please, watch out for me……!
m920154.温泉の平和を守るために――\n行くわよ、みんな！！:
To protect the peace of the hot springs—
Let's go, everyone!!
m920154.温泉はお預けだな。\n王子、急いであの男を助けにいくぞ！:
The hot spring will have to wait.
Prince, let's hurry and save that man!

The hot spring, occupied by animals…!?

Ninjutsu: Summoning Art――Demon Realm Boa!!

We were putting on a friendly front

Prince, please help me stop them!
Hurry! Quickly! As soon as possible~!!

Prince, have you ever seen a fish that generates electricity?

m920154.王子に止められちゃ仕方ないよねー。: I guess it can't be helped if the Prince stops us.
m920154.王子に迷惑はかけたくないしね。\nうーん、じゃあ今日の化け化けあやかし大決戦は\:
We don't want to trouble the Prince either.
Hmm, then what shall the content of today's Great Yokai Battle be?
m920154.王子も連れて行こ。\n夜遅くまで報告書を片付けてたし、癒やしてあげよー。:
We'll take the Prince along.

m920154.珍しく、女将さん――こほん、\nエマさんも乗り気でしたしね♪:
It was rare to see the innkeeper—ahem,
Ema so enthusiastic too♪
m920154.皆さんが来てくれなかったら、\nいったいどうなっていたことか。\n感謝してもしき:
Villager?: If you hadn't come,
I don't know what would have happened.

m920154.確かに休憩は必要ですし、\n少しくらいなら――:
You're right, we do need a break,

m920154.秘湯……？\nシュシュちゃん、いつのまにそんなものを……。:
A secret hot spring…?
Shushu-chan, when did you find that…
m920154.絡繰り忍者……いったい\n何を目的にしているのでしょうか……。:
The Karakuri Ninja…
what on earth is his objective?

The legends surrounding the Karakuri Ninja

m920154.致し方ない。\n物質界の流儀とは面倒なものだ。:
I suppose it can't be helped.

Young proprietors… What an unusual term

m920154.若女将よ、その身体で\nちょうどいい湯加減を覚えていくといい。:
Young proprietor, with that body of yours,

m920154.誰も、傷つけさせませんよ！\nそれに温泉も元に戻します！:
We won't let you hurt anyone!

And that would explain why no one saw the culprit……
Yes, it makes sense if the source is the problem!
m920154.身体をくぐつに置き換えた、\n腕利きの忍者でしたっけ……。:
The skilled ninja who replaced his body

m920154.過去の戯れのひとかけら、そこに郷愁を見出すのは、\n我ら血族とて人の子たちと同じ:

We of the bloodline are no different from other humans in that regard.
m920154.間違えて他のお客様が温泉に入っていたら、\nきっと大変なことになっていました。\:
If any other guests had been in the bath,

I absolutely, absolutely cannot forgive this!
m920154.頑張る若女将、かーっこよかったですぽーん♪: A hardworking young proprietor, how cool, pon♪
m920154.魔界の影響が弱くなったとはいえ、\n未だに魔物は各地に潜んでいますからね。:
Even though the influence of the Demon Realm has weakened,

A Demon Realm Boa is electrified?
What kind of mutation is that?
m920154.（……かっこよかったですよね。\nエマさんって、どうしてこんなにカッコイイんでし:
(……You really were cool.
Why is Ema so amazing?)
m920154.（もしかして、エマさんあの旅館で働いたことが……？）: (Could it be that Ema used to work at that inn…?)
m920154.（エマさん……うぅん、女将さん、\nとってもかっこよかったです……！）:
(Ema…… no, Innkeeper,
you were so cool……!)

――No, holy sites are often places with dense mana.
The theory that they seek high concentrations of mana is quite plausible.

――I am honored by your praise,
you lowly, vulgar creations of the Creator God.

――There was nothing of value here either.

is a stroke of luck.

m920163.――それならば、私からお話しましょう。: ――In that case, allow me to explain.
m920163.――それは、人類を愛していたからでしょう。: ???: —It must be because he loved humanity.
m920163.――そろそろ雑談の停止を進言します。\n前方に多数の天界兵を確認しました。:
――I suggest we stop the small talk.
I've spotted a large number of Celestial troops ahead.
m920163.――だが、ドゥマルデだけは、それを理解して\n付いてきてくれていると思っていたの:
――But I thought Domalde, at least, understood that
