What a shame, my friend.
m920163.――とはいえ、だ。\n神ならぬ貴様に、未来の話を答えることはできまい。\n少々意:
――That said.
You are no god, so you cannot answer questions about the future.
I suppose I asked a rather mean question.
m920163.――とはいえ、失敗したのは確か。\nせめてもう何人か、正気に戻してやりたかったの:
――That said, it was a failure, certainly.
I had hoped to restore a few more to their senses.
m920163.――どうやら、予想は当たっていたようだな。\n王子、前方に神聖騎士団がいるぞ。:
――It seems our suspicions were correct.
Prince, there are Holy Knights ahead.
m920163.――ほう、この娘の知識は使えるな。: —Hm, this girl's knowledge might come in handy.
m920163.――ほう、僕らの道を塞ぐつもりか。\n王子、前方に敵の新手だ。:
――Hmph, trying to block our path, are we?
Prince, there's a fresh enemy force ahead.
m920163.――まさか物質界への侵攻を無視し、\n逆に天界に攻め入ってくるとは……。:
――To think they would ignore the invasion of the Material World
and instead launch an assault on the Heavens…….
m920163.――まるで、全て知っていたとでも言いたげな顔ですな。\nどうやら一筋縄では行かな:
――You wear a look that suggests
you knew all along.
It seems you are no ordinary person.
m920163.――ようやく来たか、千人隊長。\n物質界で手こずっていたのか？:
—So you have finally arrived, Captain of the Thousand.
Were you held up in the material world?
m920163.――ケラウノス様が、いない……？\nならば我らは、いったい誰の命令で……ぐぅっ…:
――Lord Keraunos is…… not here……?
Then whose orders are we…… ghh……!?
m920163.――ダークエルフの教化も終わったな。\nこの地に、我らが主の求めるものは無かった:
――The conversion of the Dark Elves is complete.
This place held nothing our Lord sought,
but they should serve well enough as a vanguard for the assault on the Fairyland.
m920163.――ドゥマルデ審問官ッ！！\n貴様ら、この方に何をしたッ！！:
――Inquisitor Domalde!!
What have you done to him, you wretches!!
m920163.――何と弱い。実に弱い。\nどこが創造神の似姿だと？\nあれが本当に、世界を受け:
—How weak. Truly weak.
What makes you resemble the Creator God?
Is that truly the one destined to inherit the world?
m920163.――千人隊長は間に合わなかったか。\n物質界にも、手練れがいたようだ。:
――The Captain of the Thousand was not in time.
It seems there are skilled fighters in the Material World as well.
m920163.――大天使長の撤退を確認。\nマスター、このまま突破が可能です。:
――Archangel's retreat confirmed.
Master, we can break through from here.
m920163.――天界における、内戦の影響ね。\nケラウノス様が力を失ってからは、\nどの勢力:
――It's the impact of the civil war in the Celestial Realm.
Since Lord Keraunos lost his power,
every faction has been keeping each other in check to seize the upper hand.
m920163.――嫌な感じの正体は、こいつらか？\n木の陰に、うつろな目をした連中が大勢隠れて:
—So that's what the bad feeling was.
There are a lot of them hiding in the shadows of the trees,
all with those hollow eyes.
m920163.――撤退するぞ。\nこれ以上は無意味な戦いだ。:
――We are retreating.
Any further fighting is meaningless.
m920163.――殿下、物質界からの魔力通信が入りました。\n世界各地の神殿、聖地の防衛ですが:
――Your Highness, we've received a magical communication from the Material World.
Regarding the defense of temples and holy sites across the globe,
reports indicate that several front lines have already been breached.
m920163.――砂漠の国は、まだ襲撃を受けていないはずだ。\n襲撃を受けた地は、どれも著名な: ――The desert nation should still be safe. All the places that have been attacked are famous sacred grounds. It's highly likely the pyramids will be the next target.
m920163.――聖地への連続襲撃、ですか……。: ――Consecutive attacks on the holy sites, you say……
m920163.――覚えていますか？\nまだ策はある、そう言ったことを。:
Do you remember?
I said we still had options, didn't I?
m920163.――記録回想。\nダークエルフの居留地には、\n千年戦争当時の大規模魔法の魔力が:
――Recall from records.
The Dark Elf settlements retain
residual mana from large-scale spells used during the Millennium War.
m920163.――陣形の崩壊を確認。\nマスター、このまま突破が可能です。:
――Formation collapse confirmed.
Master, we can break through from here.
m920163.――驚いたぞ。\nあれだけのマンドラゴラと、ダークエルフを退けるか。:
――I am impressed.
You managed to repel that many Mandragoras and the Dark Elf.
m920163.……あ、あれ……変な魔力が……？\nドゥマルデ審問官の中で、大きくなって……？:
……Ah, that…… strange power……?
It's growing inside Inquisitor Domalde……?
m920163.……あいつ、随分と無茶をしたようだな。: ……He took quite a few risks, it seems.
m920163.……あっ、も、もしかして、なんですけど。: ……Ah, um, I, I have a question.
m920163.……あなたに、王子の何が分かると？: ...How do you know anything about the Prince?
m920163.……いざとなれば、\n神の楔を使う事態にもなるかもしれません。\nその時は、判断: ……If it comes to that, we might have to use the God's Wedge. In that case, I'll leave the decision to you.
m920163.……うん、そう、だよね。\nよし、まずは情報収集しなきゃ！:
……Yeah, that's right.
Alright, first things first: we need to gather information!
m920163.……お前のその言葉、\n王子に惑わされてのものだと思っておこう。: ……I'll assume those words of yours are the result of the Prince's influence.
m920163.……くっ、以前より精神支配が強くなっているのか？\n本来のアラエル様ならば、\n:
……Damn it. Has the mind control grown stronger than before?
If this were the true Lady Arael,
she would surely have fought by our side…
m920163.……そう、ですね。\n私たちは常に、前を向いていないと。\nすみません王子、つい:
...Yes, you're right.
We must always keep our eyes on the road ahead.
I apologize, Prince. I let my guard down for a moment.
m920163.……ちっ。\n物質界連合がいくら最強でも、\n精神支配で手勢を増やせる敵とかイン:
……Tch.
No matter how powerful the Material World Coalition is,
an enemy that can recruit soldiers through mind control is just too unfair!
m920163.……ならば、攻勢に出るしかないのでしょうか。: ……Then, is there no choice but to take the offensive?
m920163.……はい、我らが、主のため。\nうぐっ……リコラ……私は……っ。:
……Yes, for our Lord.
Ugh…… Ricola…… I'm……
m920163.……ますます、気に入らねぇな。\nトラム、この支配魔法を使ってる奴が、\nオリュ:
……I'm getting more and more irritated.
Tram, the one using this dominion magic
is in Olympus, isn't he?
m920163.……まだ、この遠征を続けるつもりですか？: ……Do you truly intend to continue this expedition?
m920163.……オリュンポスの結界を前に、撤退？\n神聖騎士団、転移門で移動していきます。:
……Retreat? Before the barrier of Olympus?
Holy Knights, we are moving through the teleportation gate.
m920163.……ドゥマルデ、審問官？\nお願いです、目を覚まして……うぅ、ぐすっ……。:
……Domalde, Inquisitor?
Please, wake up…… ugh, sob…….
m920163.……リ、コラ……。\nあなたも、正しき信仰の、道へ……。\nぐっ……あ、頭が、痛:
……Ri, cola…….
You too……to the path of……true faith…….
Gh……ah, my head……it hurts……aaah.
m920163.……ローズ、きっとこんな事したくないはずなのに。: ……Rose must not have wanted this to happen.
m920163.……亜神ディアス。ようやく姿を見せたな。\n僕が誰だか、覚えているか。:
……Dias, the Lesser God. So you finally show yourself.
Do you remember who I am?
m920163.……妖精郷の至るところに\nマンドラゴラの種をばらまかれて、\n兵が上手く動けな:
……Mandragora seeds have been scattered
all over the Fairyland,
making it impossible for the soldiers to move effectively.
m920163.……師匠、頼む。\nこいつをぶん殴りてぇのは、師匠だけじゃない。:
……Master, please.
It's not just you who wants to punch him.
m920163.……物質界の連中、やけに手応えがないと思えば。\nなるほど、王国軍は天界に来てい:
……I wondered why the ones from the Material World
seemed so easy to handle.
So the Royal Army came to the Celestial Realm, I see.
m920163.……王子、気をつけてください。\nドゥマルデ審問官が敵に回った以上、\nこちらの:
……Prince, be careful.
Now that Inquisitor Domalde has turned against us,
our demons and undead will be significantly weakened.
m920163.……知っていたさ、我が友よ。\nだが、その未来に待つのは破滅だ。:
...I knew, my friend.
But what awaits in that future is ruin.
m920163.……神の楔を使うなら、今しかありませんね。\n王子、よろしいですか……？:
……If we are to use the God's Wedge, now is our only chance.
Prince, is that all right…?
m920163.……神聖騎士団、また姿を消しました。\nあの転移魔法をどうにかしない限り、\n足:
……The Holy Knights have vanished again.
Unless we find a way to counter that teleportation magic,
it's going to be hard to stop them…….
m920163.……神聖騎士団、転移魔法を使うようです！: ……The Holy Knights are using teleportation magic!
m920163.……神聖騎士団、転移魔法を使用したようです。: ……It seems the Holy Knights have used a teleportation spell.
m920163.……策というには、頼りないけどね。\n気休めにはなるかなと思っていたけど……。:
……It's a bit of a stretch to call it a plan.
I was only thinking it might help ease our minds…
m920163.……自ら精神支配を解こうとしているのか。\nこれならば……あとひと押しだな。:
...She is trying to break free of the mind control on her own.
If that's the case... one final push should do it.
m920163.……襲撃だけならまだしも、\n彼らは精神支配によって手勢を増やしているわ。:
……If it were just the attacks, that would be one thing,
but they're using mind control to increase their numbers.
m920163.……貴様か。\nたかが被造物を愛するだと？\n天使も神獣も人も、下僕以外の何者で:
……So it is you.
To love mere creations?
Angels, divine beasts, humans—none of them are anything but servants.
m920163.あ、あの、それは、分かるんですけど……。\nこの魔力の流れ、おかしくないですか！:
Ah, um, I get that, but…
Isn't this flow of magic power off somehow?!
m920163.ああ、まだ大丈夫だとも。\nあの娘は人一倍意志が強いようだからね。:
Ah, she is still safe.
That girl seems to possess a will stronger than most.
m920163.ああ、良かった……。\nすぐにこの邪魔者たちを浄化して……。\nそうだ、トラム様:
Ah, how wonderful…
I will purify these nuisances right away…
Yes, let's invite Lord Tram's angels to come play with us.
m920163.あっ、あっちにローズも倒れて……！\n待ってて、今そっちに――:
Ah, Rose is over there too……!
Hold on, I'm coming to you—
m920163.あはは……新たなる千年戦争、ですからね。\nこの次の、千年の平和を勝ち取る戦い…:
Ahaha…… it's a new Millennium War, after all.
The battle to win the next thousand years of peace…….
We absolutely have to win!
m920163.あらゆる奇跡を起こすという、神の楔。\nこの力で、オリュンポスに侵入できれば良い:
The Divine Wedge, said to be capable of performing any miracle.
If only we could use its power to breach Olympus...
m920163.いいえ、大手柄ですよ。\nローズさんがリコラさんを逃したからこそ、\n王国軍が神:
No, it was a great service.
Because Rose let Ricola escape,
the Kingdom's army was able to move ahead of the Holy Knights.
m920163.いえ、薬草採集の案内を頼んだのは私の方ですから。\n――それよりリコラ、どれだけ:
Please, don't apologize. I asked you to guide me to the medicinal herbs.
—More importantly, Ricola, how much time do we need to buy
for you to run off and get help on your own?
m920163.いや、今はこう呼ぶべきか？\n余の力を簒奪せし、三女神の信徒どもよ。:
Or should I call you that now?
You followers of the Three Goddesses who have usurped my power.
m920163.いわく、原初の存在によって神の位を奪われし、\n空を生み出した神だとか……。:
Legend says he was a god who created the sky,
stripped of his divinity by the primordial beings…
m920163.うぅ……ローズ、\nごめん、アタシがもっと強ければ……。:
Ugh……Rose,
I'm sorry. If only I were stronger……
m920163.うぅん一緒に戦ってくれるだけで心強いよ！\n――ローズ、すぐに助けるからね！！:
Mm, it's reassuring to have you fighting with us!
—Rose, I'll save you right away!!
m920163.うん……でも、何だか嫌な感じ。\n森がざわめいて、獣たちがずっと怒ってる……。\:
Yeah……but something feels off.
The forest is restless, and the beasts have been angry the whole time……
Rose, please, stay safe……
m920163.え、えっと、では……。\n生きて帰ってこないと許しませんよ！！\nめちゃくちゃ苦:
E-eh, um, well then…….
I won't forgive you if you don't come back alive!!
I'll make you drink some really, really bitter medicinal herbs!
m920163.えぇ、おそらくこれも、\n創造神の遺構を悪用したものだと思うわ。:
Yes, it is likely another misuse
of the relics of the Creator God.
m920163.えぇ、各地の聖地、神殿といった、\n信仰の中心地ばかりを狙って、\n神聖騎士団が: Yes. It seems the Holy Knights are targeting only the centers of faith, such as holy grounds and temples across the land.
m920163.えぇ、彼女は優しい娘のようですからな。\n早く精神支配を解いてやらねば。:
Yes, she seems to be a gentle soul.
We must break her free from the mind control as soon as possible.
m920163.おぉ、僕の小鳥たちよ。\n罪深き者の甘言に惑わされ、我らが主に刃を向けるとは。:
Oh, my little birds.
To be so easily swayed by the sweet lies of sinners, and to turn your blades against our master.
m920163.おぉ、邪教の言葉に耳を貸すからだ。\nさぁ信仰を示し、その迷いを断ち切るのだ娘よ:
Ah, it is because you listen to the words of heresy.
Now, show your faith and sever that delusion, my child.
m920163.おっと……それならば、私も同行しましょう。\n教団に見限られた以上、これからは\:
Oh, very well. I shall accompany you.
Now that the Order has cast me aside,
I am free to oppose them openly.
m920163.お任せください。\n誰も戦場に取り残したりしませんよ。\nひとりぼっちは寂しいで:
Leave it to me.
No one will be left behind on the battlefield.
It would be lonely if I were alone, you know.
m920163.お前が王子を信じているのは、よく分かる。\n私も言葉だけで伝わるとは思っていない:
I can see you trust the Prince.
I don't think words alone can convey the truth, either.
If they could, I never would have offered my knights
to a false god.
m920163.お前たち、こいつらを薙ぎ払うのです！\n汚らわしき者たちへ、浄化による救済を！:
You, wipe them out!
Grant the wretched ones salvation through purification!
m920163.お前たち、撤退しなさい。\nこれ以上の戦闘は……くっ、\n何なのですか、この記憶:
You, all of you, retreat.
Further combat is…… grrr,
what is this memory……!?
m920163.ぐっ……その顔は……どこかで……。\nソ、フィー……？ ソフィーなのですか……？:
Grrr… that face… I've seen it somewhere…
So…phie…? Is that you, Sophie…?
m920163.ここを抜ければ、オリュンポスは目の前です。\nこの戦いに勝利し、物質界の騒乱を鎮:
Once we clear this point, Olympus will be right before us.
Let us win this battle and quell the turmoil in the material world!
m920163.ここを抜ければ、目的地はもうすぐそこだ。\n……皆、覚悟はできているかい？:
Our destination is just beyond this point.
...Everyone, are you ready?
m920163.こちらとしては好都合です！\nすぐに神の楔で、障壁の解除を試みましょう！:
That works in our favor!
Let's try to break the barrier using the God's Wedge!
m920163.こちらの戦力を奪う神聖騎士団とは、\nまさに真逆の立ち位置、かな。\n長引くほど:
The Holy Knights, who seek to strip away our strength,
are truly the polar opposite of us, aren't they?
The longer this drags on, the slimmer our chances of victory.
m920163.こちらは支配された仲間に\n剣を向けなければならないわけですからね。\nどこまで:
We are forced to turn our blades on our own comrades who have been dominated.
No matter how you look at it, this is a battle where we are at a disadvantage…….
m920163.このままだと、時間が経過するほどに、\n被害は拡大し、こちらも不利になっていくわ:
At this rate, the longer it goes on,
the more the damage will spread, and the more the odds
will stack against us…
m920163.このままでは騎士団が全滅しかねない。\n――ここは、偽りの神の実力を見せてもらお:
At this rate, the entire order could be wiped out.
――Let us show you the true power of the false god.
m920163.このまま敵の包囲を突破するよ。\nシャール、タイミングは任せるから。:
We'll break through the enemy's encirclement from here.
Char, I'm leaving the timing to you.
m920163.このマンドラゴラをもって、\n王国軍の戦力を削っておくとしようか。:
Let us use these Mandragoras
to whittle down the Kingdom's army's strength.
m920163.この魔力の乱れ方は……アレクシアさん、\nドゥマルデさんにも、精神支配の魔法がか:
This magical disturbance…… Alexia,
Domalde is under the influence of a mind control spell too!
But this one is…… slightly different from the others……?
m920163.これじゃ、神の楔を打ち込む隙もないわ！？\n創造神の遺構、だったかしら。\nいっ:
This leaves us no opening to strike with the God's Wedge!
It was a relic of the Creator God, wasn't it?
What is going on?!
m920163.これだけ荒らしてるんです。\n敵だって必死になりますよね。:
We've caused quite a ruckus.
The enemy must be desperate, too.
m920163.これでも、神聖騎士団長の腹心でしたからな。\n――現在、騎士団が探しているもの、:
I was once a trusted confidant
of the Holy Knight Commander.
The Knights are currently searching for a treasure
known as the "Divine Wedge."
m920163.これは……薬草の調合レシピみたいですね。\nそれから……おや？ 裏に何か書いてあ:
This looks like a recipe for a herbal remedy.
And…… oh? There's something written on the back.
m920163.こんな時に王子がいてくれたら……。\nごめんねローズ、巻き込んじゃって。:
If only the Prince were here right now……
I'm sorry, Rose, for dragging you into this.
m920163.ご自分の主の顔も忘れたのですか？\nケラウノス様はいま、\n力を失って眠りについ:
Have you forgotten the face of your own master?
Lord Keraunos is currently
sleeping, stripped of his power!
m920163.さぁ、当初の目的を果たしに行くぞ。\n妖精郷への転移門を開け！:
Now then, let us proceed to fulfill our original objective.
Open the portal to Fairyland!
m920163.さぁドゥマルデ審問官、\nいま一度、清らかなる教化の魔力を受け取るがいい。:
Now then, Inquisitor Domalde,
receive the power of holy purification once more.
m920163.さぁローズよ、次なる地へ行くぞ。\nお前の働きは実に素晴らしい。\nその献身をも:
Well, Rose. Let us move to our next destination.
Your efforts have been truly admirable.
With such devotion, the day you cast off your mortal form is near.
m920163.さぁローズよ、種を撒け！\nお前の薬草は、異端を殺すためにあるのだ！！:
Captain of the Thousand: Now then, Rose! Scatter the seeds!
Your herbs exist to slay the heretics!!
m920163.さぁ剣をとれ、王子。\n貴様の理想が如何に脆いのか、\nこの戦いをもって証明しよ:
Draw your sword, Prince.
Let this battle prove just how fragile
your ideals truly are.
m920163.さて、何を愛するかは心に秘めるものなれば。\nですが――私は世界の味方ですとも。:
Well, what one loves is a matter for the heart.
But know this—I am on the side of the world.
m920163.しぶとい連中に足止めを喰らいましてな。\nですが、この戦いはこれからの様子。\n:
We were delayed by a stubborn group.
But this battle is only just beginning.
I trust we still have a chance to make a name for ourselves?
m920163.せめてこの戦いが終わった後には、\nお前の墓を、我らの神殿に立てるとしよう。:
At the very least, once this battle is over,
we shall raise your tomb in our temple.
m920163.そうか、砂漠の国には、神にも、\n神殺しの槍にも縁のある遺跡がやまほどあるからな: I see. The desert nation is full of ruins with ties to both the gods and the Godslayer's Spear.
m920163.そこをどいてください。\nドゥマルデさんから聞きました。\nあなた方も平和を願っ:
Please step aside.
I heard from Dumarde.
That you, too, fight for the sake of peace.
m920163.そしてその力は三なる欠片に砕かれ、\nそれぞれケラウノス、\nアイギス、アダマス:
And that power was shattered into three fragments,
each becoming a new god:
Keraunos, Aegis, and Adamas.
m920163.そして王子よ、私は貴様を絶対に許さない。\nいずれ必ず、この剣の錆としてくれよう:
And you, Prince. I will never forgive you.
Someday, I will surely make you rust upon this blade.
m920163.その代わりに、進軍の足を止めたら\n全周包囲されるということだぞ。\n……こうい:
On the other hand, if we stop our advance,
we'll be surrounded on all sides.
……I don't mind a bit of tightrope walking, though.
m920163.その伝説は、概ねあっているわね。\n彼は創造神によって神の力を剥奪されたの。:
That legend is largely accurate.
He was stripped of his divine power by the Creator God.
m920163.それから、王国軍が全員無事に、\n物質界にたどりつけたことも、ですね……。:
And the entire Royal Army made it back
to the Material World safely…
m920163.それが、あなたたちにとっての信仰だと？: Is that what you consider faith?
m920163.それが分かっただけでも良かったよぉ……。\n王子、急いで妖精郷に向かおう！？:
Just knowing that is enough…
Prince, let's head to the Fairyland in a hurry!
m920163.それに、そう、あの薬草師の娘も、\n魂の深くまで教化の魔法が蝕む前に助けなければ:
Besides, yes, that herbalist's daughter as well.
She must be saved before the magic of indoctrination
corrodes her soul to its very depths…
m920163.それに、上に立つ者が不安がっていると、\n兵にもその気持ちは伝わってしまうもので:
Besides, if those in command are anxious, that unease will inevitably spread to the troops.
So, hold your head high. You are the Chief of Staff, after all.
m920163.それは……。\nですが、王子なら……！:
That may be…
But the Prince…!
m920163.それもまたひとつの真実。\nですが、創造神の考えもまた、ひとつの真実でしょう。:
That is one truth, indeed.
But the Creator God's perspective is a truth as well.
m920163.それゆえに、神聖騎士団は\n神の楔が隠されている可能性の高い地点を、\n総当りで:
Therefore, the Holy Knights are
conducting a blanket investigation
of all locations where a Divine Wedge
might be hidden.
m920163.それゆえに、私は我が友、ドゥマルデを裏切ってまで、\n教団を、我らが主に明け渡し:
That is precisely why I betrayed my friend, Domalde,
and handed the Order over to our Lord.
m920163.そんな……どうしてあなたが、こんなところで……。: No…… why are you, of all people, here…….
m920163.ただ、こちらの保有する神の楔で、\nオリュンポスの障壁を\n破壊できるかどうかは:
However, whether the Divine Wedges in our possession
can break through Olympus' barrier
is something of a gamble…
m920163.ただ、こちらの被害も拡大しています……。\nこれ以上敵の増援が現れると、\n魔力:
However, our casualties are mounting…….
If more enemy reinforcements show up,
our mana, herbs, and reserves will be stretched thin.
m920163.ただ民を甘言に惑わし、一時の幸福と引き換えに\n未来を奪うその所業――断じて許す:
That act of deceiving the people with sweet words,
trading their future for momentary happiness—I will never forgive it.
m920163.だ、だめっ、だめだって！\nローズは薬草師でしょ！？ 軍人じゃないんだよ！？:
N-No, no way!
Rose, you're a herbalist! You're not a soldier!
m920163.だからこそ、大規模な戦力を一点に集中すれば、\n敵の増援を振り切りながら戦うこと:
That's why, if we concentrate a large force on a single point,
we can fight through the enemy's reinforcements.
……We really should be thanking the other sub-gods for their civil war.
m920163.だが、その甘さが弱さとなるのだ。\n本当に大切なものがあるのなら、\nそれ以外を:
But that very gentleness will be your weakness.
If you truly have something precious to protect,
you must be prepared to sacrifice everything else.
m920163.だが、我らが主が、王国を危険視する理由は分かった。\n邪なる者たちにとって、\n:
But I now understand why our Lord views the Kingdom as a threat.
For the wicked,
the Prince's words are a truly sweet poison.
m920163.だが、此度は個人的な興味があってのこと。\nふむ……貴様が王子、ガリウスを倒した:
However, this time I was driven by personal interest.
Hm... So you are the hero who defeated the Prince, Garius.
m920163.だがちょうどいい、ローズよ、\nお前の信仰心を見せる時だ。:
But this works out well. Rose,
it is time to demonstrate the depth of your faith.
m920163.だめ……っ、皆、離れて！！\nこっちの魔力まで焼き切られるわッ！！:
No…! Everyone, get away!
It's burning through our magic power too!!
m920163.だめです、転移魔法陣打ち消せません！\n全員衝撃に備えてください！\nどこに転移:
No good, I can't cancel the teleportation circles!
Everyone, brace for impact!
I don't know where we're being sent to—
m920163.つまりやることは一緒だろ？\n短期決戦で、連中をぶちのめせばいいわけだ。:
So the goal is the same, right?
We settle this in a short, decisive battle and crush them.
m920163.ですが……アイギス様の力に\n頼り続けるわけにはいきません。\n次なる作戦を考え:
But we can't keep relying on Aegis's power.
We need to come up with a new plan, but…
m920163.ですが、時間を稼いでくれました。\n後で感謝の言葉を伝えておきましょう。:
But he bought us time.
Let us convey our gratitude to him later.
m920163.では、まずは即応可能な部隊で進軍を。\n同時に各地に伝令を送り、\n聖地や神殿の: Then, let's advance with the units that can deploy immediately. At the same time, we'll send messengers to every region to reinforce the defenses of the holy sites and temples.
m920163.では、参るとしましょう。\n次なる目的地、妖精郷へ。: Very well, then. Let us set out for our next destination: the Fairy Realm.
m920163.でも、被害が広がる様を黙ってみてるより、\n少しでも可能性の高い選択肢を選ぶのは:
But rather than just standing by and watching the damage spread,
choosing the option with the best chance of success
seems like a reasonable plan.
m920163.ということは……。\n神聖騎士団による襲撃は、\n全ての地点を捜索するまで続くと:
So that means…
The Holy Knights' attacks will continue
until they've searched every single location?
m920163.とうとうここまで来ましたか。\n罪深き人の子らよ。:
So, you have come this far, have you?
Children of sin, I see.
m920163.ともあれ、まずはこの周囲を制圧しないと\n捜索もできませんね……。\n王子、急ぎ:
In any case, we can't search the area
until we secure the perimeter……
Prince, please prepare for battle at once!
m920163.ともあれ、次に襲撃を\n受けそうな場所に目星をつけましょう。\nまだ被害を受けて: In any case, let's identify the next likely target. If we're looking for sacred places that haven't been attacked yet……
m920163.ど、どうしたって、し、死んでたんじゃないんですかぁ！？: W-what do you mean "what is the matter," d-didn't you die?!
m920163.どう、して……。\nソフィー……？ トラム様……？\nああ、僕の小鳥たち、なぜ僕:
Why...
Sophie...? Lord Tram...?
Ah, my little birds, why are you... AAAAAAAHH!!
m920163.どうか、同行の許可を――: Please, grant him permission to join us—
m920163.どうしたのですか、アレクシア、\nそれに、おぉ、あの時の騎兵に、\n懐かしい顔に:
What is the matter, Alexia,
and oh, that cavalryman from before,
familiar faces, and even the Prince have gathered.
m920163.どうしてとはおかしな事を。\n神聖騎士団のあるところ、それすなわち我が戦場なるぞ:
Why? That is a strange question.
Where the Holy Knights are, that is my battlefield.
m920163.どうやら神聖騎士団に\n精神支配の魔法をかけられていたようですね……。:
It seems the Holy Knights
had been using a mind-control spell on you……
m920163.どこまでもしつこいな、王国軍は。\n我らが同胞、ドゥマルデ審問官を惑わせた罪、\:
The Kingdom's army is truly persistent.
For the crime of leading our comrade, Inquisitor Domalde, astray,
we shall punish you here and now.
m920163.どちらにせよ、次の目的地は決まりましたね。\n王子、ダークエルフの集落へ急ぎまし:
Either way, our next destination is set.
Prince, we must hurry to the Dark Elf settlement!
m920163.どちらを見ても敵ばかり……。\n完全に包囲されているように見えるのに、\nどうに:
It's enemies on every side…….
We appear to be completely surrounded,
yet the enemy's offensive feels surprisingly sluggish. What's going on?
m920163.なぜ創造神は、あんな矮小な人間などに、\n物質界を与えてしまったのだ……。:
Why did the Creator God entrust the material world
to such petty humans…
m920163.なっ……これは神聖騎士団の転移門……！？\n殿下！ 下がってください！！:
What… is this a Holy Knight teleportation gate…!?
Your Highness! Get back!!
m920163.なっ……ローズをどうするつもり！？: W-What are you planning to do to Rose?!
m920163.なっ……殿下、周囲の魔力が……いえ、これは！\n周辺一帯、全てに転移魔法陣が！？:
Wha-… Your Highness, the magic power around us is… no, this is!
There are teleportation magic circles everywhere?!
m920163.なに、正しき信仰の道を取り戻させるだけだとも。\n邪神アイギスの信徒よ、\n貴様:
What? We're simply guiding her back to the path of true faith.
Believers of the False God Aigis,
if you too repent your ways, you are welcome to join us.
m920163.なるほど、この魔力は我らが主の……。\n総員撤退せよ、撤退だ！:
I see. This magic power belongs to our master…
All units, retreat! Fall back!
m920163.なるほど、それで魔力の濃い地点ばかりを……。:
I see. That explains why they are
only targeting places with high magical energy…
m920163.は、はい……。\nでは今後も、王国のために尽力しますね。:
Y-yes…
I will continue to do my best for the Kingdom.
m920163.はぁ……はぁ……っ！！\n何よこれ、こんな術式を組めるなんて……。:
Haa…… haa……!!
What is this? To be able to weave such a formula…….
m920163.はい、身体に異常はないので……。\nでも、王子殿下にご迷惑をおかけしてしまって…:
Yes, there is nothing wrong with my body…
But, I am so sorry to be a burden, Your Highness…
m920163.はいっ！ バトルタンク、\n次弾装填、砲撃――ってぇーッ！！:
Yes ma'am! Battle Tank,
loading next round, firing――!!
m920163.はて、誰だったか……。\nああ、あの鍛冶神の連れか？\n無様に散った、鍛冶しか能:
Hm, who was it again…….
Ah, the companion of that smith god?
The one who met such a wretched end, that Lesser God who could do nothing but forge!
m920163.ははっ、異教の術に一番詳しいのが異端審問官ですよ。\n異教の術で、仮初の死を演じ:
Ha! The Inquisitor is the one most versed in heretical arts.
I merely used a heretical technique to feign death.
m920163.ははっ、苦い薬草は勘弁だ。\n――王子、増援到着前にケリをつけるよッ！！:
Haha, I'll pass on the bitter herbs.
――Prince, let's finish this before the reinforcements arrive!!
m920163.ひとりでって……ローズ、おとりになるつもり！？\nだめだよ、こいつらに捕まったら:
On my own? Rose, you're planning to be a decoy?!
No! If they catch you,
they'll turn you into one of those living armors!
m920163.ひとりの英雄によって作られた偽りの平和が、\nその後に何をもたらしたのか知らない:
Do you not know what the false peace
created by a single hero led to?
m920163.ほう……やるではないか。\nひとりも傷つけることなく無力化したか。:
Hm……well done.
You have incapacitated them all without a single casualty.
m920163.ほう、創造神の被造物にしては、\n中々に悪くない顔をしている。\nだが何と弱い、:
Hm, for a creation of the Creator God,
you have quite the look of defiance.
But how weak you are. Weak beyond measure.
m920163.ほう、王国軍か。\nまさか襲撃より早く、砂漠の国へ来るとはな。:
Hm, the Kingdom's army.
I didn't expect you to reach the desert nation so quickly,
before even launching an assault.
m920163.ほんとっ！？\n王子、お願い、力を貸して！\nローズを絶対に、絶対に取り戻すの！:
Really?!
Prince, please, lend us your strength!
We absolutely, absolutely have to get Rose back!
m920163.まさか神聖騎士団が聖なる森にまで……。\nそれでリコラさん、\nローズさんと別れ:
I can't believe the Holy Knights have reached the Sacred Forest……
So, Ricola-san,
is this where you parted ways with Rose-san?
m920163.まずは野営地へ戻りましょう。\nもしかしたら、何か情報が入ってきているかもしれま:
Let's return to the camp first.
Perhaps some news will have come in by then.
m920163.また転移魔法を使うつもり！？\nローズを、ローズを返して！！:
You're planning to use that teleportation magic again?!
Give Rose back! Give her back!
m920163.むっ……それに何じゃこの植物は――って、\nわ、わわ、わーっ！？\nこやつ、マン:
Hmph……and what is this plant—
W-W-W-Waaah?!
It's a Mandrake!
m920163.もしかしたら、神聖騎士団と戦うために、\nローズが種をばらまいていたのかも……。:
Perhaps Rose scattered the seeds
in preparation for fighting the Holy Knights……
m920163.やめろ師匠ッ！！\n結界に焼かれるぞッ！！:
Stop it, Master!!
You'll be burned by the barrier!!
m920163.よいか王子、マンドラゴラに触れると、\nこやつは命を奪うほどの断末魔の悲鳴をあげ:
Listen well, Prince. If you touch a Mandrake,
it will scream in such agony that it can kill you!
Though, of course, the Mandrake dies at the same time.
m920163.ようやく後手から、先手に回れますかね。\n王子、他の候補地の情報も集めつつ、\n: Finally, we can move from a reactive to a proactive stance. Prince, while we gather information on other potential targets, how about we get a head start on the desert nation?
m920163.よぉし、ローズちゃん奪還ッ！！\nリコラ！ 受け止めて！！:
Alright, let's get Rose-chan back!!
Ricola! Catch her!!
m920163.よし、儀式を始めるぞい。\n皆、魔力を神の楔に集中するのじゃ。:
Very well, let us begin the ritual.
Everyone, focus your magic power on the God's Wedge.
m920163.よし、増援は追いついていないようだね。\nこのまま突っ切ればオリュンポスを守る結:
Good. It seems the reinforcements haven't caught up.
If we push straight through, we'll face the barrier that shields Olympus and stands in our way.
m920163.わっ、あ、ありがとうございます！\nすぐに傷を治しますからね。:
W-ah, thank you so much!
I'll treat your wounds right away.
m920163.ん……待って。\n嫌な感じがします……この魔力は……。:
Hm… wait.
This feels wrong… this magical power is…
m920163.ん……？ あれ？\nローズさんの立っていたところに、何か落ちてますよ？:
Hm……? Oh?
There's something on the ground where Rose was standing.
m920163.アイギス神殿は防衛に成功しましたが、\n防備が手薄な場所では、\nすでに多くの被: We managed to defend the Aigis Temple, but it appears that places with weaker defenses have already suffered significant damage.
m920163.アイリーン姐さんは！\n人使いがっ！ 荒い！ なぁッ！！:
Irene's got it all planned out!
She's such a taskmaster! Isn't she, huh!!
m920163.アラエル、てめぇの苦しみは目に焼き付けたぜ。\nそれ以上の槍を、\nオリュンポス:
Arael, I have etched your suffering into my memory.
I will drive a spear far beyond that pain
into the heart of Olympus's master.
m920163.アラエルさまっ！？\nどうしてここに……。:
My lady Arael!?
Why are you here…?
m920163.オリュンポスの障壁まで、まだ距離がありますが……。\nこれならほぼ最大の戦力で到:
We still have some distance to go before we reach the barrier of Olympus…….
But at this rate, we should be able to arrive with nearly our full strength.
m920163.オリュンポスを起動した存在には、\n何人か見当をつけていたけれど……。\nその中:
I had my suspicions about who activated Olympus,
but…
it seems my worst fear has come true.
m920163.クソッ、クソッ、クソォォォッ！！\n死ねっ！ 勝手に死ねッ！\n嫌いだ、皆みんな:
Dammit! Dammit! DAMN IT!!
Die! Just die already!
I hate you! I hate all of you!!
m920163.ダークエルフたちも厄介ですが、\nこちらの布陣にもご注意を！:
The Dark Elves are troublesome enough,
but please watch your formation too!
m920163.ダークエルフを襲撃、いや、味方にするつもりか？\nだが、連中がそんな悠長なことを:
They intend to raid the Dark Elves? No, to recruit them?
But surely they wouldn't be so leisurely about it…….
m920163.ドゥマルデ審問官、邪教に惑わされたあの発言は、\nこの戦いをもって雪ぐのだ。:
Inquisitor Domalde, your words, misled by that cult,
will be washed away in this battle.
m920163.ハハハッ！ ならば余の味方をしておけ。\n貴様にも、穢れなき蒼空の世界を見せてや:
Hahaha! Then join my side.
I shall show you a world of pristine blue skies!
m920163.ローズ……ぐすっ……必ず、必ず戻るからッ！！: Rose……sob……I'll come back. I promise I'll come back!!
m920163.ローズちゃん！ 怪我した人、回収してきたよ！\n――王子、このまま前方の索敵に出:
Rose-chan! I've picked up the injured!
――Prince, I'm heading out to scout ahead!
m920163.三女神が力を失っている今、\n新たに神の楔を生み出せる者は存在しません。:
With the Three Goddesses having lost their power,
no one exists who can create a new Divine Wedge.
m920163.上等だ。\nこっちは最初から戦争をするつもりなんだ。\n全力でかかって来てもらわ:
Good.
We've been planning to wage war from the start.
They'll have to come at us with everything they've got.
m920163.世界樹の魔物化を防ぐこともできなければ、\nオリュンポスの結界を破ることもできな:
You cannot prevent the World Tree from turning into a monster,
nor can you break the barrier of Olympus.
m920163.人の子とは、どこまでも愚かな存在ですね。\nケラウノス様の慈悲の御心すら分からな:
Children of man, you are truly foolish creatures.
You don't even understand the mercy of Lord Keraunos…….
m920163.今だ！ セブン、ベルナ！！\nローズの身柄を取り戻せ！！:
Now's the time! Seven, Berna!!
Get Rose back!
m920163.今はオリュンポス到達が最優先です。\n王子、増援部隊を撃破しましょう！:
Reaching Olympus is the top priority right now.
Prince, let's defeat the reinforcements!
m920163.仕方あるまい。\n異端に最も触れる機会が多いのが異端審問官だ。\n一時の気の迷い:
It cannot be helped.
The Inquisitor is the one most exposed to heresy.
Our Lord will surely forgive a momentary lapse of judgment.
m920163.他の神への嫌がらせ、ってわけでも無いんだろうな。\n連中、いったい何が目的なんだ: It's not just a prank against other gods, is it? What on earth are they aiming for?
m920163.何、それはどういう意味だ。\nまさかドゥマルデ、誰よりも敬虔な信徒であるお前が、:
What is that supposed to mean?
Surely not you, Domalde, the most devout of believers,
have been led astray by the words of a cult?
m920163.何を馬鹿なことを。\nケラウノス様は――ぐっ……なんだ、この記憶は……。:
What nonsense.
Lord Keraunos is――grrr…… what is this memory…….
m920163.全員まとめてアイギス神殿の前にいたんだ、\n眠りについていながらも、\n女神アイ:
They were all gathered before the Temple of Aegis.
Even while they slept,
the goddess Aegis must have protected them.
m920163.分かるとも！ 正義を志したその決意、\n痛いほどによく分かる。:
I know well enough!
That resolve to pursue justice,
I understand it all too painfully.
m920163.創造神の被造物にして、アイギス様の信徒……。\n私たちは、彼にとって許しがたい存:
Created by the Creator God, and followers of Aegis…
We must be an unforgivable sight to him.
m920163.創造神の遺構、ビフロストを\n生み出す手段すら失いつつあるのだぞ、あの者どもは。:
The remnants of the Creator God, Bifrost,
are even losing the means to be created.
How ridiculous. They are not even fit to be servants.
m920163.力尽きた、か……。\nドゥマルデ審問官、惜しい男だった……。:
So, you have run out of strength…….
Inquisitor Domalde, you were a fine man…….
m920163.千年前、魔王が封じられた後に残されたのは、\n乱立する国々と、戦乱の時代だったで:
After the Demon King was sealed a thousand years ago,
what remained was a world of warring nations
and an age of constant conflict.
m920163.千年戦争より前、神話よりさらに前の、\n実在すら疑われている物語の登場人物ですね:
A figure from a story that predates the Millennium War,
and even the myths themselves… one whose very existence is doubted…
m920163.否、だ。\nドゥマルデ審問官、お前が信じようとしたものに、\nほんの一欠片の興味:
No, it did not.
Inquisitor Domalde, I merely felt a shred of interest
in what you chose to believe.
m920163.哀れなる邪教の徒よ、その盲目は罪だ。\n至高の存在を知らぬがゆえに、\nこの神聖: Poor, blind heretics. Your ignorance is a sin. Because you do not know the Supreme Being, you cannot even comprehend the purpose of this holy crusade.
m920163.堕天した身なれど、\n私にもアラエルを縛る魔力の波動が感じられます。:
Though I am a fallen one,
I can still feel the magical waves binding Arael.
m920163.大天使長まで操るなんて、\nいったいどれだけの力を……。:
Even the Archangel is being manipulated……
just how much power could they possibly have…….
m920163.大空に投げ出されていたら、\n全滅していたかもしれませんからね……。:
If we'd been left out in the open sky,
we might have all perished…
m920163.天使たちの支配を解くこともできなければ、\n――余の転移魔術に抗する術もない。:
You cannot free us from the angels' dominion,
nor do you have the means to resist my teleportation magic.
m920163.天使に施された支配の力は、\nおそらく神の楔にも匹敵するものです。:
The power of dominion imposed upon an angel
is likely on par with the Divine Wedge itself.
m920163.天界と物質界は、長らく断絶していましたからね。\n手駒を増やそうと考えるのは、\: The Celestial Realm and the Material World have been cut off from each other for a long time. It's a reasonable motive if they're looking to expand their influence.
m920163.天界に、乗り込む……。\nわ、私もお手伝いします！\n遠征なら、薬草も必要ですよ:
Storming the heavens…
I, I'll help too!
We'll need medicinal herbs for the expedition, right!
m920163.失敗した時のことも、策は練ってあります。\nどれも厳しい道程ではありますが、\n:
We have already devised plans for the event of failure.
Though each path will be arduous, leave such matters to us.
m920163.当然だ、ドゥマルデ審問官。\n此度の遠征では審問の必要がないと託宣があったゆえ、:
Naturally, Inquisitor Domalde.
Since the oracle declared no inquisition was required for this expedition,
are you suggesting you're simply bored to death?
m920163.後手に回ってしまった以上、\nもはや一刻の猶予もありません。\n今は障壁まで、一:
Since we've already been forced onto the defensive,
there is no time to spare.
For now, let us make a single-point breakthrough and push through to the barrier.
m920163.心惑わす偽りの聖地を破壊し、\nその場に集う邪教の徒をすべて\n我らが正しき神の: We are to destroy these false, misleading sacred grounds and guide all the heretics who gather there toward the path of our true god.
m920163.必死なのは兵か、あるいは将か。\nどちらにせよ僕らが脅威とみなされたのは間違いな:
Whether it's the soldiers or the generals who are desperate,
there's no doubt we've been marked as a threat.
m920163.悔やんでいる時間はないわ。それより、\nどう助けにいくか考える方が先じゃないかし:
There's no time for regret. Besides,
shouldn't we focus on how to rescue her?
m920163.我が友よ、君にしては殊勝な言葉だな。\n――少しはこの言葉が、届くと思ってもいい:
My friend, that is a rather noble sentiment for you.
—Do you think any of it reached him?
m920163.我らが雷の主は、迷える民を救わんと\n邪教の聖地を破壊せよと命じられたのだ。: Our Lord of Thunder has commanded us to destroy the holy sites of heresy in order to save the lost people.
m920163.我らは次代の礎となる。\n民が争うことなく、漫然と平和を甘受する時代の。\n――:
We shall be the foundation of the next age.
An age where people live in peace without conflict,
accepting it without question.
For that reason, Prince, you are in the way.
m920163.戦いが長引けば、神聖騎士団の増援が来てしまうと……。\n敵の戦力は強大ですが、\:
If this fight drags on, the Holy Knights will get reinforcements…
The enemy's strength is formidable,
so it seems we have no choice but to end this quickly.
m920163.戦うしか、なさそうですね……。\n王子、戦闘の指揮をお願いします！:
It seems we have no choice but to fight…….
Prince, I leave the command of this battle to you!
m920163.攻勢にとは言っても、いったいどこに？\n神聖騎士団の拠点は、\nもはや世界全土に:
Taking the offensive, you say, but where exactly?
The Holy Knights' bases
are now spread across the entire world.
m920163.敵対勢力に睨みをきかせるために、\n薄く広く兵を展開してる、と……。:
They're spreading their forces thin and wide
to keep an eye on their rival factions…….
m920163.断言はできないわね……。\nオリュンポスは創造神が築いた遺構、\nその障壁もまた:
I can't say for certain….
Olympus is a relic built by the Creator God,
and its barrier is likewise the work of a divine hand.
m920163.普段から無茶しちゃうのが王子の仲間だから、\nローズ、もっといっぱい言ってやって:
The Prince's allies are always being reckless, so
Rose, please scold them a bit more!!
m920163.朗報があるとすれば、\n神聖騎士団の侵攻が止まったことねぇ。\nこれが一時的なも:
If there's good news,
it's that the Holy Knights' invasion has stopped.
I don't know if it's just a temporary lull, though.
m920163.森の皆を傷つけて、森を荒らして、\nいったい何が目的なの！？: You're hurting the forest and its inhabitants, destroying everything! What is your purpose?!
m920163.機甲部隊、突撃。\n王子の道は、私たちで拓くよ。:
Armored unit, charge.
We'll clear the Prince's path.
m920163.次代はどうだ、その次は。\n貴様の子らが、\n貴様と同じく全てを救う英雄となると:
What of the next generation? And the one after that?
Can you assert with certainty that your children
will become heroes who save everything, just like you?
m920163.此度の征伐に、審問は不要と我らが主も仰っていた。\n逆らう邪教の徒は、\nこやつ:
Our Lord said no inquisitions were needed for this campaign.
Any heretics who resist
can simply be purged with this Mandrake.
m920163.油断は禁物ですよ。\n物質界に残してきた者たちにとって、\n私たちだけが唯一の希:
We can't afford to let our guard down.
To those we left behind in the Material World,
we are their only hope.
m920163.無事に、ローズさんを取り戻せましたね。\n……ただ、事態はより深刻になったようで: We've safely recovered Rose… However, the situation seems to have gotten even more serious. For now, let's consider our next course of action.
m920163.無条件に救いの手を差し伸べてくれる英雄、か。\nそんな都合のいい存在が、\n永遠:
A hero who offers salvation unconditionally, huh.
I suppose no such convenient existence
could possibly last forever.
m920163.無論、私もお供しましょう。\n神を名乗る者の顔、一度見ておきたいですからね。:
Naturally, I shall accompany you.
I wish to see the face of the one who claims to be a god.
m920163.無駄なことを……。\n愛とは主の恩寵、人が人に向けるそれなど、\n信仰に満たされ:
Such a futile attempt.
Love is the Lord's grace; the affection one human shows another
can never reach a girl filled with such faith.
m920163.然り。我らは天罰の代行者。\n穢らわしい邪教の徒を浄化する戦士ゆえに。:
Indeed. We are the agents of divine punishment.
Warriors who purify the abominable heretics.
m920163.物質界の見える高台を見つけたんです。\nきっと楽しいですよ……ああ……皆で、皆、:
I found a high vantage point where you can see the material world.
It's bound to be fun… Ah… everyone, everyone, ah, ahh!
Damn it! What is this? What is this?! These memories…?!
m920163.王子、よろしいですか……？\n――と、聞くまでもなさそうですね。\nそれでは王子: Prince, may I…? —Actually, I doubt I even need to ask. Then, Prince, please prepare for the expedition!
m920163.王子、ドゥマルデ審問官は、\n神聖騎士団の精神支配を解こうと\n密かに活動してい:
Prince, Inquisitor Domalde has been
secretly working to break
the Holy Knights' mental domination.
m920163.王子、天界からの干渉は初めてではありませんが、\nどうにも嫌な予感がします。: Prince, this isn't our first interference from the Celestial Realm, but I have a bad feeling about this.
m920163.王子、手伝ってほしいことがあるんだ。\n――ボクらは、世界樹を再調査すべきかもし: Prince, there's something I need your help with. —We might have to re-examine the World Tree.
m920163.王子、来てくれたか。\n妖精郷の現状は、見てのとおりだ。\n防衛部隊も散り散りに:
Prince, you've come.
The state of the Fairyland is as you see.
Our defense forces have been scattered.
m920163.王子さま、あの霊鳥はアラエル様と繋がっているの。\n先にアラエル様を倒さないと、:
Prince, that spirit bird is connected to Lady Arael.
If we don't defeat her first,
the spirit bird is immortal, so be careful!
m920163.王子さま、まずいです。\n転移門にまた魔力が集まっています。:
Prince, this is bad.
Magic power is gathering at the teleportation gate again.
m920163.王子を信じて戦う者が、\n世界中にこれだけいたことは覚えておこう。:
Remember that there were so many in this world
who fought believing in the Prince.
m920163.現実的に考えるなら、\n信徒――いえ、精神支配を施した\n物質界での尖兵を増やす: If we think realistically, it's probably to increase the number of vanguard forces in the Material World—no, to increase the number of believers under mental domination.
m920163.異教徒との対話が必要ないと、\nそう告げる言葉が、本当に我らが主のものであると、:
Do you genuinely believe that the words declaring
no dialogue with the heretics is necessary
are truly from our Lord……?
m920163.皆さん、傷は私たちが癒しますが、\n絶対に死ぬような無茶はしないでくださいね。:
Everyone, I'll heal your wounds, but
please don't do anything so reckless that you end up dead, okay?
m920163.目標と言っても、連中が何の目的で\n戦っているかも分からないんだろう？:
Objective? We don't even know
what purpose they are fighting for, do we?
m920163.神がこの世界をひっくり返すと言うのだ。\n救いの道は、強き神に示す方にしかない。:
The god says he will overturn this world.
The path to salvation lies only in following the strong god.
m920163.神聖騎士団と、\nオリュンポスに繋がりがあるのは確かです。:
It is true that there is a connection
between the Holy Knights and Olympus.
m920163.私たちが……希望……。\nそうですね、気合を入れないと！:
We are…… their hope…….
Right, we need to keep our spirits up!
m920163.私たちの取りうる手段の内、最善を選んだのです。\n今はただ、人の手が天界にも\n:
We have chosen the best course of action available to us.
For now, let us press forward, confident that human hands can reach even the heavens.
m920163.私は気が気じゃないですよぉ！？\nニミュエ！ そっちに怪我人がいます！\n回収し:
I'm on edge over here!
Nimue! There are wounded over there!
Please go retrieve them!
m920163.私も助力しましょう。\n神を裏切った身ゆえ、退魔の力は失ってしまいましたがね。:
I will assist as well.
Though, having betrayed the gods, I have lost my power to exorcise demons.
m920163.立ち去れ、ここは余の庭である。\n物質界にて安穏と、偽りの平和を甘受せよ。:
Leave. This is my garden.
Remain in the material world and accept your false peace.
m920163.結界が、今この瞬間にも書き換えられている。\nこちらが読むより速く、\n新しい結:
The barrier is being rewritten at this very moment.
It is constructing a new barrier
faster than we can even read it.
m920163.結界の術式を解析し、\n神の楔の力を逆方向に注ぎ込む。\nそうすれば、結界を破壊:
We will analyze the barrier's formula
and channel the God's Wedge's power in reverse.
That should allow us to break the barrier.
m920163.続きは助けが来てから聞きますね。\n優しいリコラ、あなたと友達になれて、嬉しかっ:
We'll continue this conversation once help arrives.
Sweet Ricola, I'm glad I got to be your friend.
—Now, go!!
m920163.興味で信念を歪めることは出来ない。\n我らには、弱き民を救う使命があるのだから。:
One cannot twist conviction for the sake of mere curiosity.
We are bound by a duty to protect the weak.
m920163.薬草師の――ローズのこと！？\nおじさん、ローズはまだ助けられるよね！？:
The herbalist's—Rose?!
Uncle, there's still hope for Rose, right?!
m920163.行きますよ王子、進軍です！！\nオリュンポスを目指しますよー！:
Let's go, Prince! Advance!!
We're heading for Olympus!
m920163.誰も……いない……？\nここがオリュンポスの結界、なんですよね？:
No one… is here…?
This is supposed to be Olympus's barrier, right?
m920163.責任を取って王宮薬草師をやめる、\nなんて言わないでくださいね？\nローズさんは:
Please don't say you'll take responsibility
and resign as the Royal Herbalist.
Rose is a valuable asset.
m920163.貴様にも、分かっているのだろう？\n自分が決して、正しい道を歩んでいるわけではな:
You know it, don't you?
That you are not walking the truly right path.
You simply have no choice but to walk it,
believing it is the best you can do.
m920163.貴様の指をすり抜け落ちた、\n救えなかった幾千、幾万の者たちにこそ、\n偽りであ:
It is for the thousands, the tens of thousands
who slipped through your fingers and could not be saved
that they need peace from a god,
even if that god is a false one.
m920163.貴様も理解していよう。\n民にとって、英雄とは毒にしかならないということを。:
You must understand.
To the people, a hero is nothing but a poison.
m920163.身柄さえ確保すれば、私の術で\n精神支配を解除できるということです、フィナンよ。: It means that once we secure her, I can use my magic to lift the mind control, Finan.
m920163.近くに王国軍が陣を張っているでしょう？\nリコラなら、そんなことになる前に\n助:
Isn't there a Royal Army camp nearby?
You, Ricola, should be able to reach them
and call for help before anything like that happens.
m920163.違いない。\n――王子、軍団の指揮は任せた。\nオリュンポスまであと少し……切り:
Exactly.
――Prince, I leave the command of the legion to you.
We're almost at Olympus…… let's break through!
m920163.離せアトナテス！\nこいつは僕が……ッ！！:
Let go, Atnates!
This one is mine to deal with……!!
m920163.面白い。貴様がそこまで言うのなら、\nその真実とやらは覚えておこう。\n――して:
Interesting. If you are so insistent,
I shall keep this "truth" of yours in mind.
—Now then, what is it that you love?
m920163.魔力を狙っている、ということ？\nけれど彼らは、異教の聖地や神殿を狙っていたので:
So they're after the mana?
But weren't they targeting heretical holy sites and temples――
m920163.（……もはや、この精神支配を解くのは不可能か。\nせめて解呪の手がかりくらいは掴:
(……Is it truly impossible to break this mind control now?
I only wished I could have found some clue to the curse……)
m920163.（ああ、王子よ、アレクシアよ、\nあとは……任せたぞ……）:
(Ah, Prince, Alexia,
I leave the rest to you……)

m920196.――いなかった。\n私の昼寝タイムは！？:
……She wasn't there.
What about my nap time?!
m920196.――くっ、命が、消えていく……。\nボクの力が、心が……。:
――Ugh… my life force… it's fading away…
My power… my heart…
m920196.――さて、挨拶もまだ半ばですが、\n私はそろそろ崑崙へ戻らねば。:
――Now, our introductions are only half done,
but I must return to Kunlun soon.
m920196.――さて、王子。\nそろそろ例のお手伝いをしてもらいましょうか。:
—Now then, Prince.
It is time for you to lend us a hand with that task.
m920196.――そうそう、そんな荷物を背負っていたら、\n最速の名が泣くってものだ。\nさぁ:
――Oh, that's right. Carrying that much baggage?
Your reputation for being the fastest would cry.
Well then, you've run out of places to hide.
m920196.――とーう！ オリュンポス第２階層とうちゃーく！\nって、あっ、あれぇ！？\nい:
――Ta-da! Welcome to the second floor of Olympus!
Wait, wha... What's that?!
Why is it sparking all of a sudden?!
m920196.――はぁ……はぁ……っ。\nくっ……もういい、俺を置いてひとりで逃げろ。:
――Haa... haa...
Grr... Forget it. Leave me behind and run.
m920196.――まったく、自暴自棄になってもここまでやるとは、\n愛情というものは、心底扱い:
――Honestly, to throw yourself into despair and still go this far…
Love is truly a troublesome thing, down to its very core.
m920196.――何をやり遂げたような顔になっているのですか！\n立ちなさい！\nそれでも華の:
—And why do you look so pleased with yourselves?
Stand up!
Is this the attitude of immortals who support the Flower Kingdom from the shadows?
m920196.――分かりましたか。\n己がどれだけ未熟なのか、どれだけ驕っていたのか。:
――Do you understand now?
Just how immature you are, and just how arrogant you have been.
m920196.――普賢、謝りなさい。\n他国にまで迷惑をかけるとは何事ですか。:
――Puxian, apologize.
What kind of behavior is it to cause trouble for other nations?
m920196.――然り。\nされどこの地は余の庭に非ず。\n仙人ならば感じるだろう、この仙力の:
――Indeed.
But this land is not my garden.
An immortal would surely sense the melody of this divine power.
m920196.――遅かったですね。\n封神はすでに完了しましたよ。:
――You're late.
The Fengshen is already complete.
m920196.…………ッ！！\nもういい、潰れろ、壊れろッ！\n十天君が亡骸に蹂躙されて死んで:
……Grrr!!
Enough! Let it all crumble! Let it shatter!
Let the Ten Heavenly Lords be trampled into death!!
m920196.…………封神される覚悟はできましたか？\nでは、参りましょう。:
…………Are you prepared to face the sealing of your divinity?
Then, let us proceed.
m920196.…………聞忠と、誅子のことですか？: ……Is it about Wen Zhong and Chushi?
m920196.……あなたのそういうところ、\n本当に、本気で、心の底から大嫌いですよ。:
……That side of you,
I truly, sincerely, and from the bottom of my heart, despise.
m920196.……これは、華の国の街並み？\nいえ、華の国の都そのものでしょうか。:
...Is this the streets of the Flower Kingdom?
No, I believe this is the capital itself.
m920196.……ちっ。\n何が何も残っていない、だ。:
…Tch.
What are you talking about, having nothing left?
m920196.……っはぁ！\nはぁっ、はぁ……やっと身体を取り戻せたか……。:
……Haa!
Haa, haa… I finally got my body back…
m920196.……なぜ、なぜ分かってくれない。\n聞忠よ、お前だけは余の友で\nいてくれると思:
……Why won't you understand?
Wen Zhong, I thought you were the only one
who would be my friend.
m920196.……また煽りましたね、太公望。: ……You stirred him up again, Taigong Wang.
m920196.……も、う、脚に力が、はいらな……。: ……My, my legs… have no strength left…
m920196.……クソ亜神？\n封神計画を進めているのは元始天尊様では？:
...Damn sub-god?
Isn't it Master Yuanshi Tianzun who is advancing the Fengshen plan?
m920196.……十天君、すべて絶命しました。: ……The Ten Heavenly Lords are all dead.
m920196.……無駄だ。\nこいつは騙されている。\n今の元始天尊は、かつてのそれではないん:
...It's futile.
He's being deceived.
The Yuanshi Tianzun of today is not the one of the past.
m920196.……納得はしていないが、承服しよう。\nだが、この様を見れば、俺が教えるまでもな:
...I'm not convinced, but I'll go along with it.
However, seeing this state of affairs, I think I don't need to explain much.
m920196.……聞忠、甘やかさぬように。\n愛と過保護の違いを見極めるのも、\nこの旅の目的:
……Wen Zhong, don't spoil her.
Learning to distinguish between love and overprotection
is one of the purposes of this journey.
m920196.……華の国は、急速に復興作業が進み始めました。\n私は書類を振り分け、指示を出す:
……Reconstruction in the Flower Kingdom has begun to progress rapidly.
I'm only sorting documents and issuing orders,
but the people on the ground are eager to rebuild the nation.
m920196.……迅天君、逃げろ。\nお前だけなら生き延びられるだろう！:
...Jinten, run.
You might be able to survive if you're alone!
m920196.……邪仙には向いてないよ、お前は。\n無事に逃げ延びて、どこかの村にでも転がりこ:
...You're no good at being a heretical immortal.
Escape safely, and end up in some village or other.
m920196.「封神台」もその亜神の企みですか？\n仙人の仙力を集め、束ねるという……。:
Is the "Fengshen Altar" part of that demi-god's plot too?
Gathering and binding the immortals' power…
m920196.あ、兄者ァ……！\n私の力を持っていくのだ……！:
Ah, brother…!
I'm taking your power with me…!
m920196.あぁっ！？ 誅子！ 大丈夫ですか！？: Ah!? Zhuzi! Are you all right!?
m920196.ああ、ああ……！！\n兄者よ、最後の戦いへ、我らが死地へ、共に……！！:
Ah, ah…!!
Brother, let us go together… to our final battle, to our place of death…!!
m920196.ああ、いま話しかけても無駄だ。\nこの元始天尊様は、抜け殻みたいなものだからな。:
Ah, talking to him now would be a waste of breath.
This Yuanshi Tianzun is nothing but a hollow shell.
m920196.ああ、なるほど……。\n仕方ありません。\n分かりました、王子の決めたことであれ:
Ah, I see...
Very well.
If it is your decision, Prince, I will accept it.
m920196.ああ、応えてやろうとも！\nグフフフ、これぞ因果応報なり！！:
Ah, let me answer their call!
Gufufufu, this is the law of cause and effect!!
m920196.ああ、王子、王子ィ……！！\n身体をヨコセ……ボクに、キミの身体をぉ……！！:
Ah, Prince… Princee…!!
Give me your body… give me, your body…!!
m920196.あとは、元始天尊様の介抱と、\nここで何が起きたのか、事情を聞くだけですか……。: So, all that's left is to look after Yuanshi Tianzun-sama and hear what happened here, right?…
m920196.あとは叩き潰すだけってことかな？\nさぁ王子、あの分からずやをぶっ叩いてあげよう:
So all that's left is to crush them, I suppose?
Come on, Prince. Let's smash that stubborn fool!
m920196.あなたが間違えようと、正しかろうと、\n国が滅ぶ時は滅ぶものです。\n勝手に悲劇:
Whether you're right or wrong,
a nation falls when it falls.
Could you please stop playing the tragic hero?
m920196.あなたはすぐ、面倒事を私に押し付けますね……。\nではフェイロン、急いで国に戻り:
You always try to push your troubles onto me…
Very well, Fei-Long, let's return to the country immediately.
m920196.あの、でも、できるだけ早く帰ってきてください。\n国が回っていることと、主君らが:
Um, but please come back as soon as you can.
The fact that the country is running smoothly and the fact that our masters are unnecessary
are not the same thing.
m920196.あらやだ、お肌が荒れちゃったわぁ……。\nハァ……もっともっと、\n愉快な計画を:
Oh my, my skin has gotten all rough…
Haa… I had so many more
fun plans to make, and yet…
m920196.あれは……普賢……！？\nそれに十天君の迅天君に、東天君まで。:
That's... Puxian...!?
And Jinten of the Ten Sky Lords, and East Sky Lord, too.
m920196.あーあーあー、まったく、\n私の戦場をめちゃくちゃにしてくれたな。:
Aaah, aaah, aaah, seriously,
you've completely messed up my battlefield.
m920196.いかにも。\nああ、元始天尊様は憂えておられる……。:
Indeed.
Ah, Master Yuanshi Tianzun is deeply troubled...
m920196.うん、ありがと王子くん♪\nフーコ、お姉ちゃんも手伝うよ。\nほら、一目連は逃げ:
Good, thanks, Prince♪
Fuuko, I'll help out too.
Look, Ichimokuren isn't trying to run away!
m920196.えぇ、人は過つものでしょう。\nですが、そこに何の問題が？\nむしろ、道を踏み外:
Yes, humans do make mistakes.
But what's the problem with that?
If anyone has strayed from the path, it's you, Wen Zhong.
m920196.えぇ、今度は成功しました。\n対話とは、壁を作ったままではできないものですから。:
Yes, it worked this time.
One can't have a conversation while walls are still up.
m920196.えぇ、何らかの、膨大な力を必要とし、\n集め続けているようです。:
Yes. It appears they are amassing
an immense amount of power for some purpose.
m920196.えぇ、私は仙人である以前に、亜神ですからね。: Yes, before I was an immortal, I am a demi-god.
m920196.えぇ、華の国を紡いだ者として、\nその子らの性根を叩き直すのは、私の役目でしょう:
Yes. As the one who wove the Flower Kingdom together,
it is my duty to straighten out their natures.
m920196.えっ、いや、だって、\nこうでもしないと戦力が足りな――いたたたた！？:
E-eh? No, it's just,
if I didn't do this, we wouldn't have enough fighting strength―― ow ow ow!
m920196.お、おい、やめろ、何のつもりだ……！: W-wait, stop! What do you think you're doing...!
m920196.お、おうこくまで引っ張り出してごめんなひゃい……。: S-sorry for dragging all the way to Oukoku……
m920196.おう、じ……？\n元始天尊様、いったい何をするつもりで――:
Y-Yes, m…?
Yuanshi Tianzun-sama, what exactly do you intend to—
m920196.おぉっと、サービスはここまでだ。\n良かったな誅子、聞忠に死ぬほど愛されて。\n:
Oh, my service ends here.
You're welcome, Chushi. You're so deeply loved by Wen Zhong that
he'll keep you safe, even if you can't fight.
m920196.おっと、おしゃべりがすぎるなぁ太公望。\nしかし今回ばかりは、天才道士殿の思考速:
Oh my, you're talking too much, Taigong Wang.
But this time, it seems we outsmarted
the thinking speed of our genius Taoist.
m920196.お前たち、旅にでも出たらどうだ。\n見聞が狭すぎるんだ、誅子も、聞忠も。:
How about you two take a trip?
Your horizons are far too narrow, Zhuzi and Wen Zhong.
m920196.お前には、家族がいる……。\n俺にはもう、何も残っていないからな。:
You have a family...
I have nothing left anymore.
m920196.かの者の策謀にかかり、\n私はその心を縛られてしまいました。:
I fell prey to that being's schemes,
and my mind was bound.
m920196.くぅっ……宝貝さえ、砕けていなければ……。: Grrr... If only my treasures hadn't shattered...
m920196.こいつを蹴散らし、\n一刻も早く「封神台」へ向かわなくては……。:
We need to crush him
and head to the "Fengshen Platform" as soon as possible...
m920196.ここまで利用させてもらったんだ。\n何も隠し事はしない。: We've taken quite a bit of liberty with this place. We're not hiding anything.
m920196.こっちも色々大変なんだぞ？\n私を邪魔したその罪、思い知ってもらおうか！:
I've had my own share of trouble, you know?
Let me show you the price for getting in my way!
m920196.この抜け殻で無能でなーんにも考えてない状態が続くと、\nそこの聞忠と誅子みたいな:
If this hollow, incompetent, empty-headed state continues,
tragedies like the ones involving that Wen Zhong and Shuzi
will keep piling up like mountains.
m920196.さぁ、来いよ普賢ッ！ 速度こそが世界を砕く！\nあらゆる嘆きを切り裂くものこそ我:
Now, come at me, Puxian! Speed is what shatters the world!
My thunderclap is what cuts through all sorrow!
I'll burn my immortal power, my life, everything I have!
m920196.さぁ、立ちなさい華の国の子らよ！\n英雄王を継ぐ者の胸を借り、\n己の未熟さを思:
Now then, rise, children of the Flower Kingdom!
Borrow the strength of one who has inherited the Hero King's mantle,
and learn just how immature you truly are!
--- scene: Special Training by the Intellectual Brawler (battle, end) ---
m920196.さぁて、こんなところか。\n――って、おいおい誅子、もうバテたのか？:
Well, that's about it.
――Wait, Chushi, are you already exhausted?
m920196.さて、ここまで場を誘導し、整えたんだ。\n我が主、元始天尊様の魂を解放するため、:
Now, I've guided the situation this far and set the stage.
To free my master, Yuanshi Tianzun's soul,
I'll need your help.
m920196.しかし、収穫もありました。\n仙力の流れは、たしかにオリュンポス上層へ向かってい:
But we did gain something.
The flow of power was indeed heading toward the upper levels of Olympus.
This confirms that our enemy is definitely in Olympus.
m920196.しかし、後始末が大変だな……。\n華の国を助ける義理はないが、\n聞忠のやらかし:
But the cleanup is going to be a pain…
I have no obligation to help the Flower Kingdom,
but I can't just leave Wen Zhong's mess alone…
m920196.しかし、私の目論見通りに動いてくれたか。\n結果だけ見れば、考えうる最上級の結末:
But you moved exactly as I planned.
Looking at the results alone, this is the best possible outcome.
m920196.そいつの首はくれてやる！\n煮るなり焼くなり殺すなり、好きにするがいい！:
I'll give you his head!
Boil it, roast it, or do whatever else you want with it!
m920196.そう、か……。\nそうだろうな、分かっていたことか。:
I see…
I suppose that's how it is. I knew it, really.
m920196.そういうわけですから、\n王子、この子をよろしく頼みますね？:
So, as it turns out,
Prince, I leave this girl in your care.
m920196.そうですね……。\n何から話せばよいか……。:
Yes…….
Where should I even begin…….
m920196.そこに、あいつが現れた。\n名も知らぬ、ただ権能のみが知られた亜神が。:
That's when he appeared.
A nameless demi-god, known only by his authority.
m920196.そして事実、亜神ディアスが\n物質界すべてに影響を及ぼし始めました。:
And indeed, the demi-god Zeus began
exerting his influence over the entire material world.
m920196.その心の内に巣食ったクソ亜神の魔術を、\n徹底的にぶっ壊せ。:
Shatter the magic of that wretched sub-god
that has nested itself in his heart.
m920196.その狂気やよし！\n余の呉鉤剣にて生命を散らす栄誉をくれてあげよう！:
How delightful madness!
I shall grant you the honor of scattering your life with my Wu Gou Sword!
m920196.そも、私が神仙郷を離れたのは、\n本来の領地たるオリュンポス第２階層へ戻るためで:
To start, the reason I left the Immortal Realm was
to return to my original domain, the Second Layer of Olympus.
m920196.それに対抗すべく、\nこちらも第２階層崑崙にて、\n戦力を蓄えていたのですが……:
To counter this,
we were amassing our forces at the Second Layer, Kunlun,
but……
m920196.それはもはや、忠義に非ず。\nあなたの行いは、\n華王をペットのように愛玩してい:
That is no longer loyalty.
Your actions are nothing more than
keeping Hanaou as a pet.
m920196.ただ、ちょっと手を借りていいか？\n元始天尊様をひとりで運ぶの、結構たいへんだか: But could I trouble you for a hand? Carrying Yuanshi Tianzun-sama alone is quite a feat.
m920196.ただ、王子には少し、\n手伝ってほしいことがあるのですが……。:
However, there is something I would like
to ask the Prince for help with…
m920196.だから、さっさと俺を置いて逃げろと――: That's why I told you to leave me and run, and――
m920196.ちっ……もう追いついてきたか。\n格好がつかないな、速度の果てで散るどころか、\:
Tch... So you've caught up.
This is embarrassing. I was going to die at the pinnacle of speed,
but now I'm going to be killed by a girl while carrying cargo...
m920196.って、あっ、どこ行くの！？: Hey, w-wait, where are you going!?
m920196.つまりフェイロン、あなたには、\nしばらく馬車馬のように働いてもらいますので。: In other words, Fei-Long, I'll be relying on you to work like a mule for a while.
m920196.ですが、もう一度だけあがいてみせましょう。\n王子、その生命力、いただきますよォ:
But let me struggle one last time.
Prince, I'll be taking that life force of yours!!
m920196.でも、アチキの最期が王子っていうのは、\nなかなか悪くないかもねぇ♪:
But dying at the hands of the Prince?
That's not a bad way to go, I suppose♪
m920196.どういうこと。\n元始天尊様に何をしたの？:
What do you mean?
What did you do to Yuanshi Tianzun?
m920196.どうして、建前をぶっ壊してから\n話し合えって言えないのかなぁ……。:
Why can't you just talk things through
before tearing down the pretenses…?
m920196.どうやら私の精神支配が解けたことを察して、\n封神台に蓄えられた仙力は回収されて:
It seems they sensed my mental control had broken,
and the power stored in the Fengshen Altar was reclaimed…
One more move. If only I had been faster…
m920196.なぁ、フェイロン、国は無事に動いているか。\n私など必要ないくらいに。:
Hey, Fei-Long, is the country running smoothly?
Smoothly enough that we aren't needed, I mean.
m920196.なっ……僕は政治に向いてな――あっ、太公望様ー！？: W-What? I'm not cut out for politics at all—Ah! Taigong Wang-sama!?
m920196.ならば、ここを少しでも知っているキミに、\n情報源になってもらうのは妥当な選択じ: In that case, isn't it a reasonable choice to have you, who know this place somewhat, serve as our source of information?
m920196.ならば、どうすればいいというのですか！\nもう華の国は崩壊を待つしかない！\n私:
Then what am I supposed to do!
The Kingdom of Flowers is already on the brink of collapse!
It's because I... because I lost my way!!
m920196.なるほど、では華王が十天君の討伐に打って出たのは、\n大罪人を罰するためではなく:
I see. So the King of Flowers launched the campaign against the Ten Sky Lords
not to punish the great sinner,
but to gather immortal power for the Fengshen Platform...
m920196.なるほど、普賢、あなたの思惑は理解しました。\nですが、我々に何を望むつもりです:
I see. Puxian, I understand your intentions.
But what exactly do you expect of us?
m920196.ねぇ王子くん、ちょっと相談なんだけど……。\nこそこそ……。:
Hey, Prince, can I ask you something?
Psst...
m920196.はぁ……はぁ……っ！\nくっ……なぜだ、余では届かぬというのか……。:
Haa... haa...!
Grrr... Why can't I reach him...?
m920196.はぁ……また追いかけっこか……。\n王国軍！ お前たちが邪魔したせいだぞ！:
Haa... Another game of chase...
Royal Army! This is all your fault for getting in the way!
m920196.はい、誅子。\nあぁっ、また服が乱れて……！:
Yes, Zhuzi.
Ah! My clothes are all messed up again…!
m920196.はっ……？ 聞忠が……？\n余に、いったい何を……。:
Hah...? Wen Zhong...?
What did he do to me...?
m920196.ははは、さすがは元始天尊様。\n愛の鞭はまったく衰えていませんね。:
Hahaha, typical Yuanshi Tianzun-sama.
Her rod of love has certainly not lost its edge.
m920196.ははは！ 馬鹿王か！\nよし、ならば出立を急ぐとしよう。\n聞忠、これより旅に出:
Hahaha! A foolish king!
Very well, then let us set out quickly.
Wen Zhong, we are going on a journey!!
m920196.ふぅ……ようやく一段落だな。\nさぁて、肩の荷も降りたことだし！\n崑崙でめくる:
Phew… finally, a breather.
Well, now that the weight is off my shoulders!
A dizzying nap time awaits me on Kunlun—
m920196.ふざけるなぁあぁぁぁッ！！\n普賢、元始天尊っ、聞忠……っ！！\nどうして、余は:
Don't you dare make fun of me, you idiot!!
Puxian, Yuanshi Tianzun, Wen Zhong...!
Why is it always... why do I always...
m920196.ふざけるな！\n二度もお前を盾にしろと！？:
Don't be ridiculous!
You want me to use you as a shield twice?!
m920196.へ、平気だ……。\nそれより聞忠、余を甘やかすな！:
I'm fine…
Besides, Wen Zhong, don't coddle me!
m920196.まぁ、仕方ないか。\n聞忠のやつ、貴様が封神されないように、\nあれこれ仕込んで:
Well, I suppose that's to be expected.
It seems Wen Zhong went to great lengths
to make sure you wouldn't be included in the Fengshen.
m920196.まだ、まだです……。\n私は……誅子を……守……。:
I'm not ready… not yet…
I have to… protect Shuzi…
m920196.まだ、国号を変えるには早すぎます。\n民も、我らの馬鹿王はいつ戻るんだと\n笑い:
It's still too early to change the name of the kingdom.
The people are waiting for you two, joking about
when our foolish king is going to come back.
m920196.まったくです。\nというより、この知性派きっての武闘派、\n元始天尊様を倒すとは:
Indeed.
More importantly, this intellectual brawler,
Yuanshi Tianzun-sama… who is the high-ranking sub-deity that defeated her?
m920196.もちろん、特訓です。\n王子、全力でこの子たちを叩きのめしてくださいね。:
Of course, special training.
Prince, please beat these two down with all your might.
m920196.もはや、私は封神台に頼るしかない。\n華の国は必ず、私が元通りに――:
I have no choice but to rely on the Fengshen Altar.
I will surely restore Hanaou to the way it was――
m920196.もはや人の王に任せてはおけぬと、\n御自ら、華の国を書き換えんとしてくださったの:
Deciding that the King of Men could no longer be trusted,
He Himself has chosen to rewrite the Flower Kingdom.
m920196.やっぱ亜神ってのは信用ならない！\nくそっ、どうしてこうなったぁ！？:
I knew it! Demi-gods can't be trusted!
Damn it, how did things end up like this?!
m920196.よ、余とて、いつも最前線に……！！: I-We are always at the front lines too…!!
m920196.よく言われます。\n憎まれ役というのも大変ですね。:
I get told that a lot.
Playing the villain is quite the burden, isn't it?
m920196.オリュンポスとは、世界の設計図、原初の実験場。\n魔王ガリウスが没した後には必ず:
Olympus is the world's blueprint, the primordial testing ground.
After the Demon King Galious perished, someone was bound to
use its functions to scheme for evil.
m920196.オレだってそうしたかったさ！\nまさかお前が、\nオレを庇って傷を負うような男だ:
I wanted to do the same!
If I'd known you were the type to throw yourself in front of me like that!
m920196.クーコまで……！？\nくそ……いったい、どういうつもりなんだ……。:
Even Kuuko...!?
Damn it... What is the point of all this...?
m920196.グフフ……おぉ、おぉ、死が見えるぞ……。\n我が手にかけてきた死者たちが、\nこ:
Gufufu… Oh, oh, I can see death…
The countless souls I have claimed
seem to be beckoning me!
m920196.フッ……実に楽しい人生であった！\n願わくば、最後の戦いもまた、\n心躍るもので:
Pfft… What a delightful life it has been!
I only hope that this final battle
will be just as thrilling!!
m920196.フーコ……？\n俺に、近付くな……俺はもう、かつての一目連では……。:
Fuuko...?
Stay away from me... I'm no longer the Ichimokuren you knew...
m920196.フーコさん、危険です！\n相手は十天君ですよ！？:
Fuuko, it's dangerous!
He's one of the Ten Sky Lords!
m920196.一目連くん、何か忘れてないかなぁ？\nキミはさ、邪仙であると同時に、\n妖怪でも:
Ichimokuren-kun, aren't you forgetting something?
You're an Evil Immortal, but at the same time,
you're also a Yokai, right?
m920196.世界を知らずして為政者にはなれない。\n戦う相手、味方とする相手、救うべき相手、:
You cannot be a ruler without knowing the world.
Without seeing who you fight, who you ally with,
and who you must save, what kind of king are you?
m920196.人は分かりあえない。\n友でいてくれるというのも、\nあなたの願望と勘違いに過ぎ:
People cannot truly understand each other.
The idea that someone would be your friend
is merely your own wishful thinking and delusion.
m920196.人は過つもの。\n正しき道を歩むためには、仙人の助力が必要だと。:
Humans make mistakes.
To walk the right path, they need the aid of immortals.
m920196.今の華の国に必要なのは、王ではありません。\n物資と人員だけです。:
What the Flower Kingdom needs right now is not a king.
It needs supplies and manpower.
m920196.仙人より先に、人の子がこの特訓の真意を\nつかんでいるではありませんか。\n聞忠:
Before the immortals, it is the human who has grasped the true meaning of this training.
Wen Zhong, how can you call yourself a wicked immortal with that attitude!?
m920196.仙力が……尽き……て……。: My immortal power… is… running out…
m920196.何もかもを無かったことにする。\nただ、ただ平和な時代が続いてきたという、\n正:
Erasing everything that has happened.
Rewriting history so that only a peaceful age
has ever existed!
m920196.俺を案内役にしようとは……。\nどこまで甘いんだ、王国軍は。:
You want to use me as a guide...
How naive the Royal Army is.
m920196.元始天尊様、それくらいで。\n――それで、いったい何が起きたというのですか？:
Yuanshi Tianzun, that's enough for now.
――So, what exactly happened?
m920196.元始天尊様のお力により、\nここに集った力が華の国を再び編み上げる……。:
By the power of Master Yuanshi Tianzun,
the power gathered here will weave the Kingdom of Flowers anew...
m920196.元始天尊様は、魔物復活以降、\n神仙郷を離れて何かを計画していたようですが……。:
It seems Yuanshi Tianzun has been planning something
away from the Immortal Realm ever since the monsters were revived……
m920196.共に戦うと決めたなら、\n半端な甘さを見せず、その背中を頼りなさい。:
If you have decided to fight together,
do not show any half-hearted leniency, and rely on their back.
m920196.共に華の国の礎となろう。\n余らは復興にただ力を尽くし、\n我らへの判断は、すべ:
Let us become the foundation of Hanaou together.
We shall devote ourselves solely to the nation's recovery,
and leave all judgment of us to the people.
m920196.分かっている……。\n宝貝はもう砕かれ、\n反射の仙術も使えないが、なんとかして:
I understand...
My treasure is already shattered,
and I can't use my reflection technique, but I'll try my best.
m920196.分かりました、ならば、\nここで王国軍を駆逐し、悪しき仙人共を封神し、\nそのあ:
I see. Then,
let us drive out the Kingdom's army here, seal away those wicked immortals,
and then we can talk it through.
--- scene: Selfish Wishes ---
m920196.分かりやすいのはいいことね。\nそいつも、ディアスも、\nオリュンポスにいるとい:
Well, that's convenient.
So both that one and Zeus are in Olympus.
m920196.十天君じゃない。\n一目連は、一目連だから。:
He's not a Sky Lord.
He's Ichimokuren. That's who he is.
m920196.参ったな……。\nおい太公望、こういうのは専門分野だろう。\n華の国で内乱とか起:
This is troublesome…
Hey, Taigong Wang, this is your area of expertise, right?
A civil war might break out in the Flower Kingdom.
m920196.口答えは我が刃を\n受け止められるようになってからです！\nそれまでは行動で応え:
You may only talk back once you can withstand my blade!
Until then, answer with your actions!!
m920196.向いてないのはお前もだ。\nはぁ……しかし、このままではふたりとも――:
You're no good at it either.
Haa... But if we stay like this, both of us will――
m920196.命を救われた借りを返そう。\n王子、俺の力を使うがいい！:
Let me repay the debt of my life being saved.
Prince, use my power!
m920196.国王不在の緊急事態、国民からの信望が最も厚い者が、\n臨時で指示を出す必要があり:
In an emergency with the king absent, the person who commands the most trust from the people
must issue temporary orders.
