m920219.お前、こういう話の通じないやつ苦手だよな。: You really don't get along with people who can't reason, do you?
m920219.お前が言うなにゃ。: And you have no right to say that, nya.
m920219.お前の先祖も神だろうが！: Your ancestors were gods too, you know!
m920219.お前も先祖をたどれば神の血が流れてるだろうがよ。: If you trace your lineage far enough, you've got god's blood in your veins too, you know.
m920219.くっ、アンデッドどもめ、また現れたか。: Tch, those undead… They've appeared again.
m920219.け、喧嘩はだめですよぉ！？\nせめてもっと知的な争いをぉ……。:
P-Please, no fighting!
At least let's settle this with a more intellectual contest…
m920219.け、喧嘩はやめてくださいぃぃ。\nねっ、アマツちゃん？\n早く王国へ戻って、一緒:
P-Please stop fighting!
Come on, Amatsu-chan?
Let's head back to the kingdom and build a ship together, okay~?
m920219.ここが、太陽の女神が姿を隠した天の岩戸。\nこいつをこじ開けて、\n神代の遺物と: This is the Heavenly Rock Cave where the sun goddess hid. Our goal is to force this open and take the so-called relic of the divine age.
m920219.ここしばらくの間、\nヌンではアンデッドが出現するようになったのだ。\nすまない:
For some time now,
undead have been appearing in Nun.
I'm sorry, but the feast will have to wait a while—
m920219.ここに隠れた太陽の女神さまが、\n「外に陽光出さないようにしよー」って考えたら、:
The Sun Goddess hiding here must have thought,
"Let's keep the sunlight from getting out,"
and in this otherworldly place, she really can cut off the influence.
m920219.ここはオリュンポスのタカマガハラで……。\nそ、それより怪我とかないですか！？:
This is the Takamagahara of Olympus…
Wait, are you hurt? Please tell me if anything's wrong!
m920219.こちらから、管理者をひとり送り込む。\n人類への貸与ではなく、\n天の磐船を持っ:
I will send one administrator from my side.
This is not a loan to humanity, but a dispatch of a demigod wielding the Heavenly Rock Ship to your side.
m920219.ことの重大さ、分かるだろう？\n本来一緒にいるはずがない連中が、\nわざわざここ: Have come all this way, getting along just fine.
m920219.この船が完成すれば、\n再び要塞宮殿に乗り込むことができる。:
Once this ship is complete,
we'll be able to board the Fortress Palace again.
m920219.この風景と同じく、\n襲ってくる魑魅魍魎もまやかしなんだろうね。:
Just like this scenery,
the demons attacking us are probably illusions.
m920219.この風景は、おそらくまやかしね。\n本当はもっと違う見た目の場所なのだと思うわ。:
This scenery is probably an illusion.
I imagine it looks quite different in reality.
m920219.これが天の磐船……。\n試験駆動なのにこの出力……。\nでも規格が違いすぎるなぁ:
So this is the Heavenly Rock Boat…
The output is incredible, even for a test run…
But the specs are way off… This is my chance to show off my skills!
m920219.これはいわば、世界の壁を破壊するもの。\n女神ケラウノスが施した障壁どころか、\:
This is, in a sense, something that destroys the walls of the world.
It is a ship that pierces not just the barrier placed by the goddess Keraunos,
but the very boundary between the Material World and the Heavens.
m920219.これは空を征く船や、軍勢を運ぶ木馬とは、\nその本質からして異なるものなのだ。:
This is fundamentally different from a ship that conquers the sky
or a wooden horse that carries an army.
m920219.さぁ誰だ！ 誰から来る！\nフン！ フン！ ドスコーイ！！:
Well then, who is it! Who comes first!
Hmph! Hmph! Let's go!!
m920219.さて、そろそろこの洞窟も終わりよ。\n最深部――見せかけの終着点が、\nこの先に:
Now, this cave is nearly at its end.
The deepest point—the false destination—
should be waiting for us ahead.
m920219.さて、ちょうどタカマガハラに\n力を消耗して眠りこけているやつがいたな。\nかつ:
Well, there happens to be someone in Takamagahara who is sleeping off their exhaustion.
Former enemies are useful in times like this.
m920219.さて、世話をかけてしまったな。\n遅くなったが、歓迎の宴をさせてくれ。:
Well, we've put you to quite a bit of trouble.
It's late, but please allow us to host a welcome feast.
m920219.しかし、神は己の律法に従わねばならん。\n自らに課した、世界を人類へ譲るという契:
However, a god must abide by its own laws.
I cannot break the contract I imposed on myself—to yield the world to humanity.
m920219.しかし、神代の遺物を人類に託すことはできない。\n「天の磐船」は、今の時代であっ:
However, I cannot entrust the relics of the Age of Gods to humanity.
The “Heavenly Rock Ship” is a force beyond human capability,
even in this era.
m920219.しっかりと、理解しているようだな。\nお前にならば、神代の遺物も託せよう。:
It seems you understand the gravity of the situation.
Very well. I shall entrust you with the relics of the divine age.
m920219.じゃ、しばし待とうか。\n大丈夫、タカマガハラの連中は、\n意固地ではあるけど、: Are stubborn, but they're not unreasonable.
m920219.じゃあ……相手をするのは、\n私たちじゃないと、いけないですよね。:
So… it's us who have to face them,
right?
m920219.じゃあ、さっきから聞こえるこの戦闘音は、\n模擬じゃなくてガチのやつか。:
Then what are those sounds of battle I've been hearing
since we got here? Is that a real fight?
m920219.じゃあ、案内した手前、\nここは私たち亜神組が――:
Well, since I offered to guide you,
the demigods here will—
m920219.じゃあ、知的に解決しようぜ。\nぶっ倒した数の多い方が勝ちだ。:
Then let's settle it intellectually.
Whoever takes down more enemies wins.
m920219.そ、そうですよぉ……。\nいきなり過ぎて、馬もびっくりしちゃいましたし。: It was so sudden, even my horse was startled.
m920219.そういうこと。あの当時、\nタカマガハラは他階層も巻き込んだ大戦争の真っ只中で、: Exactly. At the time, Takamagahara was in the midst of a great war that involved other layers. Distressed, the sun goddess decided to withdraw.
m920219.そういうわけで、王国軍を引き連れて、\nわざわざここまで来てもらったというわけだ: That's why I brought the Kingdom's army all this way.
m920219.そういう揺らぎがあるからこそ、\n人類は人類たり得るのにゃ。:
It's precisely because of that wavering
that humans can be called human, nya.
m920219.そうも言ってられないんだよ。\nひとまず、話だけでも聞いてくれないかい？: At least, could you hear us out?
m920219.そのとおり。\nさらには他階層の太陽神も何柱か共謀してたから、\nそれはもう、世: Precisely. And several sun gods from other layers were in on it, so the whole world was in a real state of chaos.
m920219.それじゃあ出撃にゃー！\nあっ……都市警備用の猫神像には触っちゃだめにゃよ？\n:
Then let's get to it, nya~!
Ah, right… don't touch the cat statues used for city defense, nya!
If you harm them, they'll identify you as a threat and attack, nya!
m920219.それでは、先へ進みましょうか。\n王子、皆さん、足元に気をつけてくださいね。:
Then, let us proceed.
Prince, everyone, please watch your step.
m920219.それでは王子、急ぎ物質界へ戻りましょうか。: Then, Prince, we should return to the Material World as soon as possible.
m920219.それに、楽しい相撲もさせてもらったしな！\nガッハッハッハッハ！:
Besides, I got to enjoy a fun sumo match!
Gahahaha!
--- scene: The Gods of Takamagahara (battle, start) ---
m920219.それはもう、関係あるある。\nその時、神々が隠れた「天の岩戸」の奥こそ、\n私た: A lot, actually. The very place where the gods hid, deep within the "Heavenly Rock Cave," is where the relic of the divine age we seek is sleeping.
m920219.それは早計かな。\nむしろ――ディアスの計画を\n引き継いだ者がいるのかもしれな:
That would be premature.
Rather――there may be someone
who has taken over Zeus's plan.
m920219.そんな危ないもん停止させとけよ！: Just shut those dangerous things down!
m920219.たとえば、神が姿を消すような大事件が起きると、\n東の国でもその影響を受けてしま: So when a major event occurs, like a god vanishing, the eastern nation is affected by it too.
m920219.だぁぁぁぁぁッ！？\nなんだそれ！ ふざけてんのか！？:
Wha――at?!
What is that! Are you kidding me?!
m920219.だから――『亜神ディアスの下僕よ、\n我が子らを傷つけるのは、やめてもらおうか』:
So――"Servant of the Lesser God Zeus,
please stop harming my children."
m920219.だから、今後は隠し事はナシにしたのにゃ。\nヌンの民は、それでもあたしたちを信じ:
So, we've decided to keep no more secrets, nya.
The people of Nun still believed in us and offered their prayers, nya, but…
m920219.ちっ……逃げんなクソッ！！: Tch…… You can't just run, you bastard!!
m920219.つまり……昔話で太陽が消えたのは、\nタカマガハラで、太陽の神様が姿を消したから: So… the story of the sun disappearing was because the sun god hid in Takamagahara?
m920219.つまり、敵を蹴散らして進めってことだな。\nそういうのは分かりやすいぜ！:
So we just kick the enemies aside and push forward.
I like it when it's that straightforward!
m920219.どうやら、外にはじき出されたようですわね。: It seems we've been ejected to the outside.
m920219.どんどん怪力が増していくから、\nまぁ……気をつけるなり、\n力比べをするなり、:
His superhuman strength just keeps climbing,
so… watch out,
or try to outmuscle him. You do as you please!
--- scene: The Brave Humans' Challenge (battle, end) ---
m920219.なぁ嬢ちゃん、名前は？: Hey there, kid. What's your name?
m920219.なっ……この声、どこから――: W-What…? Where is that voice coming from—
m920219.なっ……僕らの勝ちだろう！？\n素直に渡せ！ 契約違反だぞ！:
Wha… we won, didn't we!?
Hand it over! This is a breach of contract!
m920219.なら、どうして今も、\n東の国には陽光が降り注いでいるの？:
Then why is sunlight still pouring down
on the Eastern Lands?
m920219.なるほど。\n決意を感じる戦い方だ。:
I see.
A battle fought with great resolve.
m920219.ね、ねぇっ、アマツちゃん！\nそろそろ思い出せませんか！？:
P-Please, Amatsu-chan!
Can't you remember now?!
m920219.はっ……いえ、何でもありません！\nそれより、私たちも急ぎましょう。\n宴は遅れ:
Hah… no, it's nothing!
Anyway, let's hurry.
A late feast is a dangerous thing.
m920219.はっ、お気になさらず！\nでもやっぱり、\nうーん……あまつ……みかぼ……うーん:
H-Hey, don't worry about it!
But still…
Hmm… Amatsu… Mikabo… hmm?
m920219.ははっ、すっかり懐かれてんな。\nそれにしても、亜神も記憶喪失とかなるんだなぁ。:
Hah, you've really won her over, haven't you?
Besides, I didn't know demigods could suffer from amnesia, too.
m920219.ひとまず、アマツちゃんと呼びましょうか。: For now, shall we call her Amatsu?
m920219.ふぃー……。\nアンデッドどもは片付いたみたいだな。:
Phew…
Looks like we've dealt with the undead.
m920219.ふぃー、アメノイワフネ関連の古文書、\nありったけ持ってきたよー。\n次は何の資:
Phew~ I brought every single ancient document I could find related to the Heavenly Rock Boat.
What kind of materials do you need next?
m920219.ふざけたことを……。\nタカマガハラの決定を忘れたのか。: Have you forgotten the decision of Takamagahara?
m920219.ふざけんな！ 一発ニ発じゃないんだぞ！\n死ぬまで感電させられて終わりだ！:
Don't be ridiculous! It's not just one or two hits!
I'll be electrocuted until I die!
m920219.ふふ、いい覚悟だ。\nしかし仲間はずれは寂しいし、\n軽く手助けくらいはさせてお:
Heh, a fine resolve.
But it would be lonely to be left out,
so allow me to lend you a small hand?
m920219.まぁ待て。\n貸さないとは言ってない。:
Now, hold on.
I never said I wouldn't lend it to you.
m920219.まっ、その見守ってくれてる神さまのところに、\n僕らはこれから乗り込んでいくわけ:
Well, we're about to barge right into
the home of that very goddess who's watching over us.
m920219.もう少しで王国ですし、\n到着したら癒し手の方々に診てもらいましょう。\nずっと:
We're almost at the kingdom.
Once we arrive, let's have the healers examine her.
It's a shame for her to remain without her memories.
m920219.もしや、この子がツクヨミ様の言っていた、\nお目付け役のような方なのでしょうか…:
Could it be that this is the person Tsukuyomi-sama mentioned?
The one who was supposed to be watching over us?
m920219.もっと、明るくて優しい場所だと思ってたけど……。\nまるで洞窟の中みたいだね。:
I thought it would be a brighter, gentler place…
It feels just like the inside of a cave.
m920219.やぁ、アメノタヂカラ。\nどういうつもりも何も、\nちょっと「天の磐船」を拝借し: I just came to borrow the “Heavenly Rock Ship” for a bit.
m920219.やはり、人の心というものは、己の意思とは\n関係なく揺れ動いてしまうものなのだろ: It seems the human heart is fickle, swaying regardless of one's will.
m920219.やはり、我らの選択は間違っていなかったぞ。\nタカマガハラの諸君。:
Indeed, our choice was not in vain.
My kin of Takamagahara.
m920219.よくやった！\n王子、兵の配置を急げ！:
Well done!
Prince, get your troops into position!
m920219.よし、このまま天使部隊を突破するぞ。\n周囲の警戒を怠るな！:
Good. We'll push straight through the angel squad.
Stay alert on all sides!
m920219.よし、ドスコーイの精神で！: Alright, let's go with the spirit of Doskoi!
m920219.よっし、ぶちかますぞテメェら！！: Alright, let's smash them to pieces, you bastards!!
m920219.わぁっ！？ で、デッカイ船が出てきましたよ！？: W-Whoa! L-Look, a huge ship is coming out!
m920219.わっ……こ、この子は……？\n気を失ってますよ！？ 大丈夫ですか―！？:
Wha… w-who is this…?
They're unconscious! Are you all right—!?
m920219.わっ……転送！？ どこかに飛ばされ――きゃー！？: W-Wha… Teleportation?! I'm being flung somewhere—Kyaa!
m920219.わっ、あのっ、ツクヨミさま！\nもう少しお話を……！:
W-wait, Tsukuyomi-sama!
Please, let me say a little more…!
m920219.わっ、えっ、さ、最近は大丈夫だったのに！？: Wha, wh-what? I've been fine lately!
m920219.わーっ！？\nえぇっ、まだ上がるのこれ！？:
W-What?!
Eh, it still goes up?!
m920219.わー！？\n戦闘準備！ 戦闘準備お願いします！！:
Waa!?
Combat readiness! Get ready for battle!!
m920219.んん……？\nあっ、むしろ自分が姿を隠せば、\n世界規模で「争ってる場合じゃない: Hmm…? Ah, maybe by hiding, she wanted to make the whole world realize, "There's no time for fighting!"
m920219.アキレア、全部受け止められるか！？: Achillea, can you keep it all contained?!
m920219.アキレアは心が蛮族だからな。\n純粋な視線には耐えられないんだ。:
Achillea, your heart is barbaric.
You can't withstand a pure gaze.
m920219.アマツちゃんは、アマツちゃんだよ？\nでも、ミカボシちゃんもいいかも。:
Amatsu-chan is Amatsu-chan, okay?
But Mikaboshi-chan is nice too, I guess.
m920219.アマツちゃんは可哀想じゃなくて、\nとっても可愛いだよねー♪:
Amatsu-chan isn't pitiful,
she's just super cute, right~♪
m920219.アマツミカ……じゃなかった、\nアマツちゃん、後ろに隠れててくださいね！:
Amatsu-Mika… no, that's not it,
Amatsu-chan, hide behind me!
m920219.アメノタヂカラの性質には用心したまえよ。\n力自慢なのは見れば分かるが、\n奴は:
Be careful of Ameno Tajikara's temperament.
You can see he's all about showing off his strength,
but the more damage he takes, the angrier he gets.
m920219.アランか……。\n同じ月の神と言えど、肯定することはできない。:
So it is you, Aran…
Even if we are both moon gods, I cannot agree with you.
m920219.イヨなやみごと？\nアマツ、相談のるよ？:
Is something on your mind, Iyo?
Amatsu is here to listen.
m920219.ウム。\n極めて重大な理由がある、ということは承知した。:
Mm.
I've taken note that you have an extremely grave reason.
m920219.ウム！ 無理やり押し通るのなら、\n正々堂々、真正面から相手をしてやろう！:
Mm! If you insist on forcing your way through,
then I shall face you head-on, fair and square!
m920219.オレはタカマガハラの力自慢、\nアメノタヂカラである！！\nフン！ フン！ 行く:
I am Ameno Tajikara, the boastful powerhouse of Takamagahara!!
Hmph! Hmph! Here we go… Let's go!!
m920219.オレ達は、人類に世界を譲った。\n正しく成長を続ける人々の未来に、\n神の力など: Divine power would only be a hindrance.
m920219.ゼクメトが歓迎の宴も用意したにゃ。\n絶対に「歓迎といえば模擬戦だァ！」とか\n:
Zekmet has prepared a welcome feast, nya.
I was sure he'd say "A welcome party means a sparring match!"
but I talked him out of it, nya.
m920219.タカマガハラの神々は、\n人類の成長し続ける未来を夢見て、\nこの世界を譲ってく:
The gods of Takamagahara dreamed of a future where humanity would keep growing,
and that's why they yielded this world to us.
m920219.タカマガハラの神には、建前というものが必要なのだ。\n他の階層よりも、契約を重視:
The gods of Takamagahara need a facade.
We value contracts above all other strata.
m920219.ツクヨミ、物質界の現状は把握しているのでしょう？\nあなたの愛する人類の成長、デ:
Tsukuyomi, you must be aware of the current state of the Material World, yes?
If Dias's scheme succeeds, the growth of the humanity you love
will be lost forever.
m920219.ツクヨミというのは、どんな神さまなんですか？: What kind of deity is Tsukuyomi?
m920219.ツクヨミ様……ですよね？\nお願いします、力を貸してください！:
Tsukuyomi-sama… is that you?
Please, lend us your strength!
m920219.ヌンと王国は協力関係にありますから。\n困っている時に、それを見過ごしたりはしま:
Nun and the kingdom are allied.
We can't just turn a blind eye when you're in trouble.
m920219.ハリンヘイム様、何かありましたか？\nなんというのか、悩んでいるようなお顔を……:
Harinheim-sama, is something the matter?
You look… troubled, somehow.
m920219.プロメ、私はお前ほど、\nすべての人類を信じることはできない。: Prome, I cannot trust all of humanity the way you do.
m920219.ホウ……。\nならばまずは、そのふたりを代表と認めよう。\n名乗れ、勇敢なる人類:
Hm….
Then I shall recognize those two as your representatives.
State your names, brave humans!
m920219.主神の不在を……ヌンにはもはや、\n太陽神がおらぬことを、民に打ち明けたのだ。:
We told the people the truth about the absence of the chief deity…
That Nun no longer has a sun god.
m920219.人の子らは、立派に己の道を選び、\nその両脚で歩み続けている。:
The children of men have chosen their own path with dignity,
and they continue to walk it on their own two feet.
m920219.人の手に余る遺物など、\nいびつな進歩をもたらすだけだ。: Relics beyond human capability would only lead to twisted progress.
m920219.人は人と争うことで、切磋琢磨し、\n次なる時代を築いていくものだ。: People strive against one another, pushing each other to grow, and build the next era.
m920219.人類には、世界を譲ったのだ。\n見事守り抜き、その未来を築き上げよ。:
We have handed the world over to humankind.
Guard it well, and build its future.
m920219.人類にはまだ早い、自分たちのその脚で、\n同じ技術の高みに至るまで待つべきだ、で: That it's still too early for humanity, and we should wait until they can reach the same heights of technology on their own feet, right?
m920219.人類に世界を譲ってなお、\n陽光がないと困るだろうからって\n少しだけ手を貸して:
Even after yielding the world to humanity,
that goddess thought they'd be in trouble
without the sunlight, so she's been lending a little help.
m920219.人類の力、あの月神に見せてやってください。: Show that moon god the strength of humanity.
m920219.今考えてる！\n王子、とにかく距離をとれ！\n雷雲の包囲が完成する前に突破だ！:
I'm thinking!
Prince, put some distance between us and them!
We have to break through before the thundercloud encirclement is complete!
m920219.他のオリュンポスと縁深い地域だって、\nきっと似たようなものだと思うよ？:
I imagine regions with strong ties to Olympus
are in a similar situation.
m920219.何かきっかけがあれば……。\nうーん……あめのいわふね……あめのたぢから、つくよ:
If we can find a trigger for her memories…
Hmm… the Heavenly Rock Ship… the power of the heavens… Tsukuyomi…
Do you remember any names, perhaps?
m920219.何か覚えていないか。\nたとえば……天の磐船がどうとか。:
Is there anything you can recall?
For instance… something about the Heavenly Rock Ship.
m920219.信じてる、信じたいと思っていても、\n心に疑念が生まれるのは止めようがないにゃよ:
Even if you believe, or want to believe,
you can't stop doubts from forming in your heart, nya.
m920219.信仰にわずかな陰りが生まれ、\n夜になり、陽光の加護が弱まると、\n今夜のように:
When even a shadow of doubt creeps into their faith,
and the sun's protection weakens with the coming of night,
undead begin to appear, as they did tonight.
m920219.僕は例外だ。\n――それで、何が条件があるんだろう？:
I'm the exception.
—So, what are the terms?
m920219.先日までは、こんな状況ではなかったと思うのですが……。\nいったい何があったので:
I don't think things were this bad just a few days ago…
What on earth happened?
m920219.前回は――太陽の女神が隠れた時には\nどうやってここを開けたの？: Last time—when the sun goddess hid—how did they open it?
m920219.前線、騎兵隊で突破します！\n付いてきてください！:
I'll break through the front line with the cavalry!
Follow me!
m920219.参ったと言っただろう？\nオレはここを守るため立ちはだかり、敗北した。\nこれで:
I said I was beaten, didn't I?
I stood in your way to guard this place, and I lost.
Now I can let you through without a care.
m920219.同じく、ボウライダーのマーガレットですわ。: Likewise, I am Margaret the Bow Rider.
m920219.君はやたらと頑丈だから経験がないだろうが、\n亜神もまた、ひとつの生物には違いな:
You're unusually durable, so you probably haven't experienced it,
but a demigod is still a living being.
A severe enough shock can wipe out their memories.
m920219.天使部隊で王国軍本隊を殲滅する気とは、\nさすがにテメェらを過大評価しすぎだぜ？:
Planning to wipe out the royal army's main force with just an angel squad?
You've got a bit too high an opinion of yourselves, don't you?
m920219.妨害を確認。\n対象を含め、全域の抹殺を執行します。:
Obstruction confirmed.
Executing total annihilation of the area, including the target.
m920219.子に頼られれば嬉しいものよ。\nさぁ、奥の分からず屋どもも、\nその実力でねじ伏:
It's a joy to be relied upon by one's children.
Now, you stubborn fools in the back,
go on and crush them with your true strength! That's the Doskoi spirit!
m920219.当然だともー。\n星を司る我が彗星の力も加えたからねー。\n星を砕くのはいつだっ:
Naturally~.
I've added the power of my comet, the one that governs the stars~.
After all, it takes the power of stars to shatter them~.
m920219.我らはヌンを守るため、民を守るために、\n嘘に嘘を重ねてきた……。\nそれが歪み:
We have lied upon lie to protect Nun and its people…
But those lies bred distortion, leading to incidents like the one just now.
m920219.断る！ だって、だってこの子は……。: I refuse! Because, because this girl is…….
m920219.昔話に聞いたことがありますな。\n確か千年戦争より昔、\nいつの時代のことかも分: I've heard that tale before. It was a story from before the Millennium War, from an age so distant its era is unclear.
m920219.東の国――あの辺り一帯の大地は、\nオリュンポスの「タカマガハラ」をもとに\n生: The eastern nation—the entire region was created based on Olympus's "Takamagahara."
m920219.物質界は、我らオリュンポスに座する者にとって\n我が子のようなものだぞ？:
The Material World is like our children
to us who sit on the Olympian throne.
m920219.王国軍の者たちならば、\n模擬戦の歓待をきっと喜んでくれると思ったのだが……。\:
I thought the members of the Kingdom's army
would surely appreciate a sparring match as hospitality…
Bastis, you really need to learn more about the human heart—
m920219.王子、包囲されてんぞ。\n総員戦闘準備！ 武器を構えろ！！:
Prince, we're surrounded!
Everyone, prepare for battle! Weapons up!!
m920219.王子、気をつけてください。\nツクヨミはああ言っていますが、\nおそらく手加減す:
Prince, be careful.
Even if Tsukuyomi says that, she likely has no intention of holding back.
m920219.王子よ、なにかと面倒をかけるな。: Prince, do not cause me any more trouble.
m920219.発言は許可されていません。\nその少女を引き渡しなさい。:
Speech is not permitted.
Hand over that girl.
m920219.知性への冒涜だぞ、アキレア。\nとはいえ、この状況では戦わない選択肢はないか。:
That's a blasphemy against intelligence, Achillea.
Still, in this situation, fighting seems to be the only option.
m920219.確か、前にタカマガハラに来た時、\nあまつみかぼし様が言っていました。:
I remember when we visited Takamagahara before,
Ama Tsu Mikaboshi-sama said…
m920219.神に道理を期待するな、胃に穴が開くぞ。: Don't expect gods to reason with you. It'll give you an ulcer.
m920219.神の権能とは、己を律する法と表裏一体。\n契約をたやすく覆すようでは神とは呼べぬ:
A god's authority and the laws that bind it are two sides of the same coin.
A being that overturns a contract so lightly cannot be called a god.
m920219.神の片付けるべき問題を、\n人の手に委ねてしまっているだろう？: You've left a problem meant for the gods to the hands of a human, haven't you?
m920219.神代の遺物は、人類にはまだ早い。\nあれは数千、数万年後に匹敵する技術だろう。\:
Relics from the Age of Gods are still too advanced for humanity.
That technology is on par with what will exist thousands, tens of thousands of years from now.
Honestly, I'm against handing the Heavenly Rock Boat over to humanity.
m920219.移ろう幻影、様々な姿を取るこれらのまやかし。\nおそらく私たちの\n相手をしてく:
Shifting phantoms, taking on all sorts of forms.
I believe the one facing us
is Tsukuyomi.
m920219.良いだろう。\nならば最後に、その実力を我が前にて示せ。:
Very well.
Then, for the last time, show me your true strength.
m920219.要塞宮殿は天界の超高空に存在するもの。\nあの場所に到達するには、\n高度と、世:
The Fortress Palace exists in the uppermost reaches of the Heavens.
To reach that place, you'll need a ship that can break through both the altitude and the walls of the world.
m920219.見守ると、決めたのか。: So you've decided to watch over them?
m920219.記憶のない小娘を殺すために派遣されてきたってか。\n不意打ちで暗殺とは、ちょっと:
So they were sent to kill a girl with no memory.
An ambush assassination… that's a pretty dirty way to do things!
m920219.諸君、戦闘準備だ。\nアメノタヂカラが言っていたとおり、\nここから先は無理やり:
Everyone, prepare for battle.
Just as Ameno Tajikara said,
we'll have to force our way through from here on.
m920219.警備用は常時動いてることに意味があるにゃよ！\n触らなきゃいいだけにゃー！！:
The whole point is that they're always on duty, nya!
Just don't touch them, that's all, nya!!
m920219.超古代文明の飛行能力に、神獣ユニコーンの船体。\nそして天の磐船の持つ超出力機関:
The flight capabilities of a super-ancient civilization, combined with the body of a divine unicorn.
And the super-powerful engine of the Heavenly Rock Boat…
My heart is pounding a little.
m920219.逃げ場がなさすぎる……。\n雷雲をぶち抜くにしても、\n部隊を展開する隙間すらな:
There's no way to escape…….
Even if we try to punch through the thunderclouds,
there's no room to deploy the unit…….
m920219.長い行軍で疲れているだろう？\n今宵はこのヌンにて、\nゆっくり心と身体を休めて:
You must be weary from the long march.
Tonight, please rest your mind and body here at Nun
and take it easy.
m920219.間違っても雷雲の下に向かわせるなよ？\nあの下は落雷だらけだ。\nお前の指揮能力:
And for the love of all that's holy, don't send them under those thunderheads!
It's a lightning storm down there.
Show me what you've got as a commander!
m920219.頭の良さを発揮できる絶好の機会なんだから！\nほら、一緒に叡智でぶん殴りにいくよ:
It's a perfect opportunity to show off my intelligence!
Come on, let's smash through it with wisdom!
Next time we're going even deeper, so it'll be a one-week course!
m920219.（…………あーあ。\n天の磐船、手に入れちゃったのか）:
(…………Ah, damn.
So they've gotten their hands on the Heavenly Iwafune.)
m920219.（……なるほど。\nそれでは、アマツちゃんとお呼びしますね？）:
(……I see.
Then I shall call you Amatsu-chan, shall I?)
m920219.（……ヌンは、前に進んでいるんだ。\n色々な困難に立ち向かいながら）:
(…Nun is moving forward.
Facing all kinds of difficulties)
m920219.（……人が、人の手で己の未来を掴みに行く、か）: (…People, grasping their own future with their own hands, huh)
m920219.（あんなもの手に入れて、\n人類の未来が大丈夫か心配ではあるけど――）:
(I can't help but worry whether humanity's future is safe
with something like that in their possession――)
m920219.（せっかく芽生えた新たな自我だ。\n自身のこととはいえ、上書きするのは忍びない）:
(A new self has finally begun to sprout.
Even if it's my own, I can't bear to overwrite it.)
m920219.（それより大変なのは、要塞宮殿のあいつらか。\nま、報告だけはしてあげようかな、:
(But the real trouble will be those guys at the Fortress Palace.
Well, I suppose I'll send a report. I am a messenger, after all.)
m920219.（アスガルドも、未来のことを考えないと。\n後ろばかり見ていたら、皆に笑われちゃ:
(Asgard needs to think about the future, too.
If I keep looking back, everyone will laugh at me)
m920219.（ツクヨミめ、これを見せたくて――\n否、共にこの熱を体験させるために、\n我が:
(Tsukuyomi, did you create this small vessel for me
to show me this—
No, to let me share in this passion?)
m920219.（当然よ。だって、見捨てられたんじゃなくて、\n見守ってくれているってことだもの:
(Of course. It means we weren't abandoned.
It means she's watching over us.)
m920219.（昔話に出てくる、空飛ぶお船だね）: (The flying boat from the old stories?)
m920219.（月の神性を持つ子って、性質が似るのかしら？）: (Do children with lunar divinity tend to have similar natures?)
m920219.（記憶、完全に戻ってそうねぇ……）: (It seems her memories have fully returned……)

m930024.……ここまで来ればもう大丈夫かな？: ……If we've made it this far, we should be safe now, right?
m930024.……そうかい、やっぱりシズカを助けてくれたのは君か。: ……I see. So it was you who saved Shizuka after all.
m930024.……帝は会談の申し出を受け入れられる。: ……The Emperor has accepted the proposal for a meeting.
m930024.……汝らも、どこへなりとも行け。: ……You may all go wherever you please.
m930024.──口は禍の元とはよく言ったものよな。: ──"The mouth is the source of disaster," as they say.
m930024.あの御方は幼いが、決して愚かではない。\n正しき道さえ示せれば、名君となられる器:
That one is young, but by no means foolish.
If shown the right path, they have the potential to become a great ruler.
m930024.あまり勘違いをしてくれるなよ、東夷風情が。\nどうして近衛大将たる予が汝らを救わ:
Don't get the wrong idea, you Eastern barbarians.
Why should I, the Grand General of the Imperial Guard, be saving you?
It was merely a measure to keep Douman from growing overconfident.
m930024.あれは私が未熟ゆえの不始末。恨みなどない。: That was my own clumsiness. I hold no grudge.
m930024.ここだけの話、帝は王子に憧れているって話よ。: Between us, the Emperor is said to look up to you, Prince.
m930024.しかし、帝の御父君は──\n先の帝は京を襲った妖怪の手にかかった。\nその怒りが:
However, the Emperor's father──
The previous Emperor fell to the hands of the demons that attacked the capital.
Do not forget that their anger is justified.
m930024.それでも押し通るというのであれば、予を越えてみせよ！: If you intend to press on regardless, then try to get past me!
m930024.だったら要するに敵は同じなんだし、見逃してくれない？: Well, if that's the case, we're fighting the same enemy. Can't you just let us go?
m930024.ではカラスマル殿、お達者で。: Then, Lord Karasumaru, take care of yourself.
m930024.どうした獣、この期にいつぞやの恨みを晴らすか？: What is it, beast? Is this not the chance to settle that old grudge?
m930024.なら、歩きながら今後の流れについて説明しようか。: Then, let me explain the plan of action while we walk.
m930024.ならば疾く失せよ、不愉快だ。貴様の匂いは鼻につく。: Then be gone. You are unpleasant. Your scent gives me a headache.
m930024.ならん、汝は朝廷に対する蛮行を宣言した。: No. You have declared war on the Imperial Court.
m930024.はいはい、ひでぇ言われようだな。: Yeah, yeah, you're really harsh, you know.
m930024.まっ、確かに間違ってはおりませぬが。: Well, you're not entirely wrong, I suppose.
m930024.やあやあシズカ殿、随分と早い再会でしたなぁ！: Oh my, oh my, Lady Shizuka. What a swift reunion!
m930024.よい、予の負けだ。腕が鈍ったな。: Very well. This is my defeat. My skills have grown dull.
m930024.セイメイめ、しくじったら許さぬぞ。: Seimei, don't think I'll forgive you if you fail.
m930024.マサムネに、ムラサメまで……！\n道理で急に姿が見えなくなったわけね。:
Masamune, and even Murasame…!
That's why they suddenly vanished.
m930024.予は夜の散歩中に辻斬りに襲われたのだ。\n負傷して動けず、あの廃寺で一夜を明かす:
I was simply ambushed by a cutpurse on a night walk.
I was injured and unable to move, so I spent the night in that abandoned temple.
The culprit's face was lost in the darkness of the night.
m930024.人間、平和になるほど近くに敵を見出し始めるからさ。: Humans tend to start seeing enemies nearby the more peace they have, you know.
m930024.似たような境遇から世界の英雄に至った存在だからなー。: He's a figure who rose from a similar background to become a hero of the world, after all.
m930024.作戦の決行日はまだ未定だけど、\n当日は二手に分かれて行動する予定。:
The date for the operation hasn't been set yet, but
we intend to split into two groups on the day.
m930024.内裏からの追っ手の気配は皆無かと～。: I can't sense any pursuers from the palace at all~.
m930024.刀が入用だったら呼んでくれ。安くしとく。: If you ever need a blade, just give me a call. I'll knock off the price.
m930024.分かったってもう……また、戦場で。: Got it, got it… See you on the battlefield again.
m930024.受けてくれるかどうかは正直半々だけど、\nドウマンの反対さえなければ大丈夫なはず:
Honestly, it's fifty-fifty whether they'll accept, but
as long as Douman doesn't oppose it, it should be fine.
m930024.受けてもらえた場合はハッタリでいいから強気にね。\nドウマンも今の戦力で王国と事:
If they do accept, be bold, even if it's just a bluff.
Douman surely doesn't want to start a conflict with the kingdom with his current forces.
m930024.帝と離れて陰陽寮に戻る瞬間があいつの最期よ。: The moment he separates from the Emperor and returns to the Yin-Yang Academy is his end.
m930024.帝に仇なす者、その全てが予の敵である。: Anyone who defies the Emperor is my enemy.
m930024.帝の玉体に傷一つでもつけてみろ、予は汝らを殺す。: If you lay a finger on the Emperor's royal person, I will kill you.
m930024.悪いな、大将には世話になってるんでね。: I'm sorry, we've had your help, Commander.
m930024.敗北しておいて見逃すも何もなかろう。: Having just been defeated, there is no "letting go" about it.
m930024.最悪断られたとしても問題はないよ。\n仲裁をしようとした事実は主張できるし、\n:
Even if they refuse in the worst case, it's no problem.
We can claim we attempted to mediate, and
that will change how other nations view us.
m930024.汚名覚悟の王国と全面戦争になった場合、\n朝廷の戦力では抵抗も難しいですからね～:
If it comes to a full-scale war with a kingdom prepared to bear the infamy,
the court's military strength wouldn't be enough to resist~.
m930024.汝らが奴と潰し合うのを期待してのことよ。: I was simply hoping you two would wear each other out.
m930024.王国関連の書物を熱心に集めていたり、\n王子の武勇伝を歌う詩人を呼び寄せたり。\:
He's been fervently collecting books related to the kingdom,
and even inviting poets to sing of your exploits.
Don't let his appearance fool you; His Majesty is quite the enthusiast.
m930024.王子が帝とドウマンを引き付けている隙に、\n私たちが内裏に潜入して暗殺の準備を進:
While you, Prince, keep the Emperor and Douman occupied,
we will infiltrate the palace and prepare for the assassination.
m930024.王子たちは朝廷に改めて会談を申し入れてほしい。\n公家と武家の仲裁って名目で、可:
I want you, Prince, to formally request another audience with the court.
Under the pretext of mediating between the nobles and the warriors, make it as grand as possible.
m930024.王子としては気分が悪い話だろうけど、\n今後はこういう交渉も増えていくと思う。:
It's probably not a pleasant thought for you, Prince, but
I think negotiations like this will become more common going forward.
m930024.用済みだ。予は秩序と安寧を尊ぶ、いかれは要らん。: You are no longer useful to me. I value order and peace; I have no use for madmen.
m930024.薄汚い野鼠どもの戯れに興味はないが、\n御所への狼藉とあらば止めねばなるまい。:
I have no interest in the games of filthy rats, but
if it's an outrage against the palace, I must stop it.
m930024.見逃してくれるのかい？: Are you going to let us go?
